notes.title: Pre-Order Chronicles: Alexander the Great for Age of Empires II: DE
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=n6eQGE3ZLtI;full][/previewyoutube]
Step into the sandals of history’s greatest conqueror with the next chapter of the [i]Chronicles[/i] saga – [i]Chronicles: Alexander the Great[/i] comes to [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] [b]on October 14th[/b] for Steam! Embark on a sweeping, narrative-driven campaign that traces Alexander the Great’s rise from precocious youth to world-shaking ruler. [i]Chronicles: Alexander the Great[/i] is now [b]available for pre-order on Steam[/b], plus includes 15% off for a limited time!

Created by our development partner, CaptureAge, [i]Chronicles: Alexander the Great[/i] introduces [b]three new civilizations[/b] – Macedonians, Thracians, and Puru – in an [b]18-scenario grand campaign[/b], brought to life through[b] animated mosaic cutscenes[/b], a [b]customizable campaign army[/b], with [b]visual and audio upgrades[/b], and so much more!
[hr][/hr]
[b][i]Chronicles: Alexander the Great[/i] is available for pre-order now on Steam[/b] with 15% off for a limited time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3793540/Age_of_Empires_II_DE__Chronicles_Alexander_the_Great/

[quote][h2]Included in this DLC[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/d471ec69a3951ad8bd943eb44c5b43a86739b667.jpg[/img]
Experience Alexander’s legendary exploits, from his bold teenage ambitions to his triumphant march across Persia, his audacious expedition to South Asia, and his dramatic return journey. Crafted with the well-known [i]Chronicles[/i] narrative flair and meticulous historical authenticity, this expansion delivers an immersive campaign experience brimming with drama, strategy, and replayability.

[h3]Key Features[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Expansive Grand Campaign:[/b] 18 richly detailed scenarios – 16 as Alexander’s Macedonians, plus two unique Thracian and Puru scenarios – to chronicle every pivotal moment of his life. 
[*] [b]Animated Mosaic Cutscenes:[/b] Stunning, artful cinematics bring each chapter to life, blending classical aesthetics with modern animation techniques. 
[*] [b]Three New Civilizations:[/b] Command the disciplined Macedonians, the swift-raiding Thracians, or the elephant-riding Puru, with two new architecture sets for distinctive visual flair. 
[*] [b]Customizable Campaign Army:[/b] As you progress in the campaign, unlock 16 bonus units – including Achaemenid chariots and Puru elephants – and 4 bonus technologies that can be used in future scenarios. Unleash the full might of your expanding empire. 
[*] [b]Visual & Audio Upgrades:[/b] Overhauled siege unit graphics heighten the immersion for which [i]Chronicles[/i] is celebrated, while 13 new music tracks for both campaign and skirmish modes provide a thrilling soundtrack for your empire’s rise. [/list][/quote]
[quote][h2]The Grand Campaign[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1b14829015dde81ac90e70e5570a030249cb628a.jpg[/img]
The [i]Alexander the Great[/i] campaign is fully focused on that main character’s life. Five or six scenarios would hardly do justice to his incredible feats! 

In the grand campaign, play as the Macedonians in 16 of the 18 scenarios, with the Puru and Thracians each getting one scenario which intersects with Alexander’s story from a different perspective. 

Across the campaign, unlock new technologies and units – including the Puru, Thracian, Athenian, and Achaemenid unique units – and train them in future scenarios with a customizable campaign army. There are 16 bonus units and 4 bonus technologies which to acquire! Coupled with the [i]Chronicles[/i] philosophy of unique level designs and diverse mechanics, experience a deeply varied and highly replayable campaign.[/quote]
[quote][h2]Three Legendary Civilizations [/h2]

[table noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/bebc048cc39dc05dedb164308b2e5f87fa5e3d27.png[/img][/td][td][h3]Macedonians [/h3][/td][/tr][/table]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1fdcd4dbf9dc59bba66ba82b002f6f2cf9fc4bf8.jpg[/img]
Conquer the world with the highly-drilled Macedonian army. Use the long pikes of their Phalangite infantry to pin the enemy in place, then crush them with the mighty Companion cavalry! Build Fortified Outposts to stage lightning assaults and move your units to the frontlines faster. 

[table noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/7c1f1540ed73a0fa2dc37256256c9f7f17b8a3f5.png[/img][/td][td][h3]Thracians[/h3][/td][/tr][/table]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/76f490bf8f605e2331259185497741325141716f.jpg[/img]
Launch devastating raids with your swift Rhomphaia Warriors, and profit from them with unique technologies that generate gold from combat. A variety of bonuses and technologies turn Thracian skirmishers from neglected trash units to deadly fighters!
 
[table noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/dccd5b1f51f686bc3190ece34e68b14b5d915ebf.png[/img][/td][td][h3]Puru[/h3][/td][/tr][/table]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/af015b80773aa774289acc588117f263e30cd236.jpg[/img]
Unleash the elephants! The Puru, a powerful Punjab people, can call upon these extraordinary beasts to flatten their foes. Build an army that combines brute force with precise ranged support with archers who wield devastating bamboo longbows.[/quote]
[quote]At its core, [i]Chronicles[/i] remains a series dedicated to narrative and historical immersion, primarily with a single-player focus. To build upon this goal and to continue exploring additional possibilities, the [b]Macedonians, Thracians, and Puru civilizations introduced with [i]Chronicles: Alexander the Great[/i] will not be available in ranked gameplay.[/b][/quote]
[h2]Pre-Order Chronicles: Alexander the Great Now![/h2]
[b][i]Chronicles: Alexander the Great[/i] is available for pre-order now on Steam[/b] with 15% off for a limited time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3793540/Age_of_Empires_II_DE__Chronicles_Alexander_the_Great/

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition – Minor Update 155976
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/c6a7284f55826c9223b711d61aca2e8febb1fa5b.jpg[/img]
Welcome to a small update for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]! This is the second of two small patches originally planned to address issues reported in the most recent update.

Today’s patch addresses gameplay issues and bugs reported by the community. Please check out our Known Issues page to see a list of these issues.

[quote]💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-ii/] Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires] The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]

Thank you again to our amazing community members, all of whom have helped to make [i]Age of Empires[/i] what it is today!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team
[hr][/hr][code][h1]     ◆ Minor Update 155976 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[quote][h2]Game[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1db5c65a88bbfe0c20e6ed2d39eb75f446dc5dc4.png[/img]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where Microsoft Store / Game Pass on PC failed to recognize installed DLC.[/list]

[h3]Stability & Performance[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where launching the game from CaptureAge with Steam not running triggered an assertion and crash instead of gracefully handling the Steam initialization error.[/list]

[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where 3D Water rendering failed to display, showing flat water even with the 3D Water option enabled.[/list]

[h3]UI[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where civilizations remained hidden to spectators even after the match started when Hide Civilizations and a spectator delay were enabled.[/list]
[h3]Hotkeys[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where the Elite Cannon Galleon lacked a training hotkey after researching the upgrade, preventing production via hotkey.[/list]
[h3]Consoles[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where appropriate player usernames were incorrectly censored.[/list][/quote]
[quote][h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f01db334b35fb1ed5d41ae3a06734068b5fb90f1.png[/img]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where units could skip subsequent shift-queued attack targets if an earlier target was destroyed.
[*] Fixed an issue where Onagers could stop after the first target when given shift-queued attack orders.
[*] Fixed an issue where chickens and their variants could be lured/pushed to the Town Center instead of remaining unlurable as intended.
[*] Fixed an issue where deleting a Scorpion mid-shot could let its projectile destroy resource nodes.
[*] Fixed an issue where farms could gain infinite food.
[*] Fixed an issue where Poles bonus gold generation while mining stone was inconsistent.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Cenotes map failed to spawn the standard four starting sheep near the player.[/list][/quote]
[quote][h2]Campaign[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/29e798e94ebd2862b429d5d8e3aaf68e854e1667.png[/img]
[list][*] A[b]ttila the Hun #1: ‘The Scourge of God’:[/b] Fixed an issue where choosing to save Bleda failed to trigger the follow-up event after the Iron Boar, blocking mission progression.
[*] [b]Liu Bei #1: ‘The Oath of the Peach Garden’:[/b] Fixed an issue where the scenario objective to destroy enemy hideouts failed to complete even after the hideouts were destroyed and the enemy resigned.[/list][/quote]
[quote][h2]Chronicles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/93840df3976cba8c760f272c75adcd3d891ce89b.jpg[/img]
[h3]Campaign[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Grand Campaign #5: ‘Chasing Smoke’:[/b] Fixed an issue where the various ambush sites would not trigger their intended abilities when activated.
[*] [b]Grand Campaign #7: ‘Earth and Water’:[/b] Fixed an issue where the Hall of Emissaries on Delos could not be constructed because the foundation disappeared when builders approached.
[*] [b]Grand Campaign #14: ‘The Fruits of Empire’:[/b] Fixed an issue where it was impossible to construct a Wonder on Delos because the foundation disappeared when builders approached.[/list][/quote]
[quote][h2]Modding[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/a730e627af8e1b64dbe18c802e66e9ea7d3d7f05.png[/img]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where data mods containing an English strings file failed to load, unless the English file was duplicated across every language.[/list][/quote]
[quote][h2]Ongoing...[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/caa99c8a5cbf0e5f35516859a6a3a1089c41195f.png[/img]
[h3]Investigation[/h3]
As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates.

For other known issues, please visit [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/articles/360049490811]this page[/url] to see what’s being tracked![/quote]
[quote][h3]:alertalert: [b]DISCLAIMER[/b][/h3]This list is subject to change and should not be considered a comprehensive list of all the known issues we’re tracking. The above is to inform you of the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].
[/quote]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition – Update 153638
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/9977eafe0cf0161642a1283c42219f0d2b0b58cd.jpg[/img]
Welcome to a small update for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]! This is the first of two small patches planned in the near future to address issues reported in the most recent update.

Today’s patch addresses key stability issues on console. Our teams are already working on a second patch to address gameplay issues and bugs. Please see our known issues page to see a list of these issues.

[quote]💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-ii/] Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[quote][h2]Game[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1db5c65a88bbfe0c20e6ed2d39eb75f446dc5dc4.png[/img]

We are actively investigating out of sync issues reported for all our platforms, but at times these are very tricky to reproduce internally. In recent updates we’ve increased our logging to help us investigate this further, and we’re hopeful that the added detail from the new logs will help us get to the bottom of this issue!

As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates.

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition – Update 153015
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/399b35e79390782483f0eb97fc5e869ae51ecf46.jpg[/img]
Welcome to an exciting update for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]! This patch addresses many pathfinding issues, also implementing a new “runaway/escape” feature, and improving the overall player experience. We are aware though, that the improvement will be an ongoing process and want to view this as the first of two major pathfinding patches. Be sure to dig down into the post below to get all of the smaller details before hopping in-game and checking them out firsthand.

While there are plenty of notable fixes and features to which to look forward in today’s build, here’s some of the big highlights coming with this month’s update:
[list][*] Bug fixes based on your feedback!
[*] Pathfinding improvements based on your feedback!
[*] Balance changes!
[*] New Maps and Map Updates!
[*] Quality of Life Features![/list]

[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][/td][td][url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-ii-definitive-edition-update-153015/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e0c0552e7cd0baf003bee7b6aa3e7b974956b776.png[/img][/url][/td][td][/td][/tr][/table][/quote]
[quote]💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-ii/] Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires] The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]

Thank you again to our amazing community members, all of whom have helped to make [i]Age of Empires[/i] what it is today!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team
[hr][/hr][code][h1]        ◆ Update 153015 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[quote][h2]Game[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1db5c65a88bbfe0c20e6ed2d39eb75f446dc5dc4.png[/img]

[h3]Stability & Performance[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed a crash occurring when trying to launch the game when Steam is closed.
[*] Fixed a crash which could occur in prolonged games with AI players.
[*] Fixed an out of sync issue which was occuring on Great Wall real world map when playing with players on different game platforms.[/list]
[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list][*] Added a new running animation for Jaguars.
[*] Adjusted idle and walk animation settings for several animals to improve their appearance.
[*] Improved the fire visuals on Tarkan’s and Elite Tarkan’s torches.
[*] Herdable animals no longer lose their player color upon death.
[*] Added a chance for Hunnic Horse to use different Horse graphics instead of always using Horse A graphics.
[*] Terrain cracks graphics (eye candy object) can no longer appear above unit graphics.
[*] Updated the texture of “Ice, Navigable” terrain.
[*] Fences on Pastures no longer receive outlines when they are behind other buildings.
[*] Pastures placed on mangrove terrains now use rice farm terrain textures.
[*] Sheep graphics can no longer turn invisible in Return of Rome.
[*] Snow graphics are now correctly displayed on buildings placed on all types of snow terrains, as well as on terrains with layered snow terrain.[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list][*] Reduced the volume and frequency of The Three Kingdoms hero unit selection and command sounds.
[*] Adjusted the variation, frequency and volume of Chicken sounds.
[*] The Tarkan attack sound effect has been updated to use an enhanced version of the legacy effect (also known as “thump”), which is more audible than the previous one.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the Narrator dictating the text in the Technology Tree menu.
[*] Narrator will now pronounce character-based words more consistently.
[*] Fixed issues with screen narration handling on the Multiplayer Lobby screen, Quick Taunts Selection screen, Clans screen, Mods screen, Credits screen, Help Index screens, Quick Play and Ranked screens.
[*] Cleaned up the menu narration system to improve menu narration.
[*] Fixed many minor narration issues.[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list][*] Added negative regeneration rate display on UI for indication of lasting damage applied to the unit.
[*] Fixed an issue where an incorrect number of queued farms and fish traps was displayed when having several Mills or Docks selected.
[*] Fixed several instances of item display issues in the Technology Tree.
[*] Adjusted the frame colors for regional buildings in the Technology Tree to be more distinct from common buildings.
[*] The additional anti-building bonus of garrisoned rams is now correctly reflected in values in the attack tooltip.
[*] Monks and Warrior Priests with Relics now display all stats on their interface, same as when not carrying Relics.
[*] Resource gauge bar is no longer displayed for resources that are not being gathered, preventing it from being shown for decaying animals.
[*] Updated Change to Melee Weapon icon and tooltip to be more generic and applicable for both Rathas and Immortals.
[*] Fixed an issue where the auto-scout button was not displayed on the UI for animal scout units (Horses and Camels).
[*] The auto-scout button is now always located in the same slot as the Stop button.
[list][*] Now the scout unit must be idle before auto-scout can be activated for it.[/list][*] Random map seed is now displayed in the Objectives screen in single player and finished multiplayer games.
[*] Updated the appearance of the loading screen when starting a game:
[list][*] The map icon and description are now displayed.
[*] The most important settings are displayed with new icons.
[*] Only enabled checkbox settings are now visible.[/list][*] Updated the appearance of Tech Tree Preview panel:
[list][*] Swapped positions of icons and civilization description.
[*] Reorganized labels to better represent the tech tree.
[*] Slightly reduced the panel size.[/list][*] Fixed accessibility issue with focus handling ensuring that button focus is indicated by button visual style as well as highlight color.
[*] Fixed issue where multiple buttons/tabs could appear to be focused at once.
[*] The colors of players mentioned in the Scouts tab in scenarios are now correctly named when a colorblind mode is enabled.
[*] Improved the button selection visual display when highlighting the DLC navigation icons on the main menu.
[*] Added a text marque to places where the text became very small due to its length e.g. in the Taunts and Diplomacy menus.
[*] Changed Civilization Set dropdown in lobbies to radio buttons for the available civilization sets.
[*] Player and clan names in multiplayer lobbies now have a higher contrast ratio to the background.[/list]
[h3]Settings[/h3]
[list][*] Added a new option which enables a visual and sound alert when queuing and training units with less than 5 remaining housing headroom.[/list]
[h3]Hotkeys[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue preventing research hotkeys from functioning when the “Select All Lumber/Mining Camps” hotkey is the same as “Select All Mule Carts”.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented villagers from being ungarrisoned with the corresponding hotkey.
[*] The “Select All Town Centers” hotkey now also selects Town Center foundations.[/list]
[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
[list][*] Spectators are no longer able to see the chosen civilizations before a match starts if the “Hide Civilizations” setting is enabled.
[*] Added a checkbox to filter full lobbies in the Lobby Browser.[/list]
[h3]Xbox[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where the Blast Radius stat could not be displayed on the UI for buildings.
[*] Keyboard controls are no longer displayed on various menus when playing on controller.
[*] Fixed an issue that made UI elements overlap on certain languages.
[*] Fixed an issue that swapped Fast Castle and Booming tooltips in the Art of War campaign menu.
[*] Fixed a crash occurring when switching from Standard to Advanced interface while in a match.
[*] Voiceover audio will now correctly play for non-English languages after downloading the Language Pack.
[*] Prevented users from seeing player’s Clan Name/Tag when certain privacy settings are enabled.
[*] Added controller hotkeys for Dromons and Lou Chuans.
[*] Added a Command Menu Shortcut for Khitans villagers to build Pastures.
[*] Fixed an issue where the military units added in [i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] DLC were not counted in the military unit category display.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the player to join a Multiplayer game after accepting a game invite from the main menu.[/list]
[h3]PlayStation[/h3]
[list][*] Improved navigation hints on the Game Settings screen.
[*] Fixed menu narration so that where a language is supported it chooses the correct language narrator and when it is not it disables the narrator.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player chat color in the multiplayer lobby was cached from the previous session.
[*] Fixed a number of minor UI rendering issues.
[*] Fixed a number of minor text issues, with incorrect text displaying.
[*] Updated localized voice overs to fix some missing lines and a few minor bugs.[/list][/quote]
[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

Fixed a crash which could occur in prolonged games with AI players.
Fixed an out of sync issue which was occuring on Great Wall real world map when playing with players on different game platforms.

tags.feature: Added a new running animation for Jaguars.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted idle and walk animation settings for several animals to improve their appearance.
Improved the fire visuals on Tarkan’s and Elite Tarkan’s torches.

tags.bug: Herdable animals no longer lose their player color upon death.

tags.feature: Added a chance for Hunnic Horse to use different Horse graphics instead of always using Horse A graphics.

tags.bug: Terrain cracks graphics (eye candy object) can no longer appear above unit graphics.

tags.balance_change: Updated the texture of “Ice, Navigable” terrain.

tags.bug: Fences on Pastures no longer receive outlines when they are behind other buildings.

tags.balance_change: Pastures placed on mangrove terrains now use rice farm terrain textures.

tags.bug: Sheep graphics can no longer turn invisible in Return of Rome.

tags.balance_change: Snow graphics are now correctly displayed on buildings placed on all types of snow terrains, as well as on terrains with layered snow terrain.
Reduced the volume and frequency of The Three Kingdoms hero unit selection and command sounds.
Adjusted the variation, frequency and volume of Chicken sounds.
The Tarkan attack sound effect has been updated to use an enhanced version of the legacy effect (also known as “thump”), which is more audible than the previous one.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue preventing the Narrator dictating the text in the Technology Tree menu.

tags.balance_change: Narrator will now pronounce character-based words more consistently.

tags.bug: Fixed issues with screen narration handling on the Multiplayer Lobby screen, Quick Taunts Selection screen, Clans screen, Mods screen, Credits screen, Help Index screens, Quick Play and Ranked screens.

tags.balance_change: Cleaned up the menu narration system to improve menu narration.

tags.bug: Fixed many minor narration issues.

tags.feature: Added negative regeneration rate display on UI for indication of lasting damage applied to the unit.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where an incorrect number of queued farms and fish traps was displayed when having several Mills or Docks selected.
Fixed several instances of item display issues in the Technology Tree.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the frame colors for regional buildings in the Technology Tree to be more distinct from common buildings.
The additional anti-building bonus of garrisoned rams is now correctly reflected in values in the attack tooltip.
Monks and Warrior Priests with Relics now display all stats on their interface, same as when not carrying Relics.

tags.bug: Resource gauge bar is no longer displayed for resources that are not being gathered, preventing it from being shown for decaying animals.

tags.balance_change: Updated Change to Melee Weapon icon and tooltip to be more generic and applicable for both Rathas and Immortals.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the auto-scout button was not displayed on the UI for animal scout units (Horses and Camels).

tags.balance_change: The auto-scout button is now always located in the same slot as the Stop button.

tags.bug: Now the scout unit must be idle before auto-scout can be activated for it.

tags.feature: Random map seed is now displayed in the Objectives screen in single player and finished multiplayer games.

tags.balance_change:
Updated the appearance of the loading screen when starting a game:
[*] The map icon and description are now displayed.
[*] The most important settings are displayed with new icons.
[*] Only enabled checkbox settings are now visible.

Updated the appearance of Tech Tree Preview panel:
[*] Swapped positions of icons and civilization description.
[*] Reorganized labels to better represent the tech tree.
[*] Slightly reduced the panel size.

tags.bug: Fixed accessibility issue with focus handling ensuring that button focus is indicated by button visual style as well as highlight color.
Fixed issue where multiple buttons/tabs could appear to be focused at once.

tags.balance_change: The colors of players mentioned in the Scouts tab in scenarios are now correctly named when a colorblind mode is enabled.
Improved the button selection visual display when highlighting the DLC navigation icons on the main menu.

tags.feature: Added a text marque to places where the text became very small due to its length e.g. in the Taunts and Diplomacy menus.

tags.balance_change: Changed Civilization Set dropdown in lobbies to radio buttons for the available civilization sets.
Player and clan names in multiplayer lobbies now have a higher contrast ratio to the background.

tags.feature: Added a new option which enables a visual and sound alert when queuing and training units with less than 5 remaining housing headroom.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue preventing research hotkeys from functioning when the “Select All Lumber/Mining Camps” hotkey is the same as “Select All Mule Carts”.
Fixed a bug that prevented villagers from being ungarrisoned with the corresponding hotkey.

tags.balance_change: The “Select All Town Centers” hotkey now also selects Town Center foundations.

tags.bug: Spectators are no longer able to see the chosen civilizations before a match starts if the “Hide Civilizations” setting is enabled.

tags.feature: Added a checkbox to filter full lobbies in the Lobby Browser.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the Blast Radius stat could not be displayed on the UI for buildings.
Keyboard controls are no longer displayed on various menus when playing on controller.
Fixed an issue that made UI elements overlap on certain languages.
Fixed an issue that swapped Fast Castle and Booming tooltips in the Art of War campaign menu.
Fixed a crash occurring when switching from Standard to Advanced interface while in a match.

tags.balance_change: Voiceover audio will now correctly play for non-English languages after downloading the Language Pack.

tags.bug: Prevented users from seeing player’s Clan Name/Tag when certain privacy settings are enabled.

tags.feature: Added controller hotkeys for Dromons and Lou Chuans.
Added a Command Menu Shortcut for Khitans villagers to build Pastures.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the military units added in [i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] DLC were not counted in the military unit category display.
Fixed an issue preventing the player to join a Multiplayer game after accepting a game invite from the main menu.

tags.balance_change: Improved navigation hints on the Game Settings screen.

notes.title: Celebrating Age in 2025 and What’s Still to Come This Year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/3764ab90b69179fe95efca71ebd861c072542482.jpg[/img]
It has been an incredibly busy 2025 so far for World’s Edge and the [i]Age of Empires[/i] and [i]Age of Mythology[/i] franchises, and as we cross the halfway mark together, we’d like to celebrate the amazing journey we’ve taken this year alongside our players. From record-breaking launches to community milestones and platform expansions, your passion and support have made the first half of the year nothing short of legendary.

Together, we’ve reached a new milestone: over 65 million players! This is more than just a number—it’s a testament to your passion, creativity, and support as a global community. Whether you’re commanding armies in [i]Age of Empires IV[/i], growing your civilization in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], living the legend in [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i], or strategizing on the go with [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i], you are a part of something truly special.

With your incredible support for the [i]Age of Empires[/i] franchise, we’ve already released three remarkable expansions and brought both [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] and [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] to PS5. 

[h3]Let’s take a closer look at what you’ve helped bring to life so far in 2025:[/h3]

[list][*] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/immortal-pillars-now-available/][i]Immortal Pillars[/i][/url] for [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] introduced an entirely new Chinese pantheon, the all-new Pillars of the Gods campaign, and seven new maps.
[*] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/new_dlc-age-iv-knights-of-cross-and-rose/][i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i][/url] for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] delivered two new civilizations, the Knights Templar and House of Lancaster, as well as ten new maps for skirmish and multiplayer, and a new game mode: Historical Battles.
[*] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/new-dlc-available-now-the-three-kingdoms/][i]The Three Kingdoms[/i][/url] for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] brought five new civilizations: Shu, Wei, Wu, Jurchens, and Khitans, and three new campaigns exploring the epic Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
[*] PlayStation 5 releases: We created more opportunities for you to engage with the [i]Age[/i] franchise wherever you choose to play when we welcomed new players with the release of [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/pre-order-age-of-empires-ii-definitive-edition-on-playstation-5/][i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i][/url] and [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/early-access-for-age-of-mythology-retold-on-playstation-5-starts-today/][i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i][/url] on PlayStation 5.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/4c95adeb7564096f2113926582720812792034fa.jpg[/img]

We didn’t just make history in-game this year—we made it in the real world, too! As the first-ever gaming partner of the legendary Louvre Museum, we joined forces to bring the epic story of the Mamluks (1250–1517) to life in a way never seen before. This groundbreaking collaboration is all about celebrating the golden age of medieval history and inspiring curiosity far beyond the screen.

With everything we packed into the first half of 2025, we still have so [b]much more[/b] to come, and the second half is shaping up to be even bigger! We’re so grateful you’re with us for every twist and turn, and we couldn’t do it without you.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]A New Pantheon Rises! Limited-Time 15% Off Pre-Order for Heavenly Spear – Launching September 30![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/2adedfcadd9a5e143b36d6e28046f8cc6ffe765f.jpg[/img]
As part of the Xbox Showcase in June, we announced the next expansion for [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] will be [i]Heavenly Spear[/i]. For the first time in [i]Age of Mythology[/i] history, we’re bringing Japanese mythology to life! For the first time in [i]Age of Mythology[/i] history, we’re bringing Japanese mythology to life and invites you to immerse yourself in the legends, gods, and heroes of Japan – introducing a brand-new Japanese Pantheon, an epic 12-mission campaign, and mythic powers never before seen in the franchise.

To celebrate this milestone, we’re offering a limited-time 15% discount when you pre-order [i]Heavenly Spear[/i] before launch. This is your chance to be among the first to experience this vibrant new world and save!

[b]Remember, if you’ve purchased the Premium Edition of [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i], you’ll be able to access [i]Heavenly Spear[/i] at launch.[/b]

[hr][/hr]
Want to find out more about [i]Heavenly Spear[/i]? We’ve got you covered!

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][/td][td][url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/pre-order-heavenly-spear-for-age-of-mythology-retold/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/b288483a3fc3fcda23e3e5b206efaae9ea3506ab.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][/td][/tr][/table]
[hr][/hr]
We’re thrilled to share new screenshots from the expansion, including our heroic Yasuko and the formidable villain Magumo—both of whom captured your imagination during the Xbox Showcase.

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/3ceb7f7e8a439e7e2d08b4b5991eced7a924609f.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/5778a56af69801a73f148538d2a9eb0a12f4ed63.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][/table][table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/eb3376277ded4689f63706de083f008969be359f.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/528b6a314eb2cc5b62bfbb631627fa8ca0c53520.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

Don’t miss out—pre-order [i]Heavenly Spear[/i] now and be part of our most exciting adventure yet!
[hr][/hr]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2991180/Age_of_Mythology_Retold__Heavenly_Spear/
[hr][/hr]
If you’re coming to Gamescom, be sure to join us at the World’s Edge booth to be one of the first to play [i]Heavenly Spear[/i] and experience the wonder of the Japanese pantheon!

[h2]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition continues to grow![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/4fa3fc3d986cf87474001ee29df911c5b6c78e50.jpg[/img]

This has already been a humongous year for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]! In April, we released the game’s [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-ii-definitive-edition-update-141935/]biggest update yet[/url], including our largest balance pass, additional units for civilizations, new regional visuals for units and buildings, new maps available to all our players, and much more.

In May, we welcomed [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/available-now-age-of-empires-ii-definitive-edition-on-playstation-5/]new players on PlayStation 5[/url] and launched the fastest selling Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition expansion to date, [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/new-dlc-available-now-the-three-kingdoms/][i]The Three Kingdoms[/i][/url]!

The year isn’t over yet, and today we’re teasing our next expansion for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], coming later this year. While we can’t reveal the details at this stage, we can share a couple of images that chronicle this great upcoming adventure.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/43df71f901950de056bab21b6a11e3748ebf1cdc.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/21979a92c4f13bc61bf26224dfd3013b0e969d52.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/5a6e5b420f24d0273dcd6ce4beb7f8500591ffc0.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
Stay tuned for a more in-depth look very soon!

[h2]Knights of Cross and Rose led the charge in Spring 2025, and Fall will bring more battles and content for Age of Empires IV[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/2f794033c4f64f0503d1edc503af2536b8297adf.jpg[/img]

In April we launched [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i], the second expansion for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] and one of the best-selling expansions ever for the [i]Age of Empires[/i] franchise! We’ve been thrilled to hear your feedback, see your new strategies, and watch gameplay as you’ve marched into battle with the Knights Templar and House of Lancaster.

In February 2025, we revealed this year would bring two new expansions for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]. With [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i] already available, we are excited to share that the next big release will come in the Fall of 2025.

Our focus for content this year was to expand on existing concepts, as well as experiment with shorter and more repeatable experiences. While the Historical Battles included in [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i] provided one avenue for shaking up our formula by fusing more traditional narrative-driven elements of a campaign mission with a scoring system and levels designed to promote more exploration, we’ve continued to push things even farther with a new game mode we’ll be unveiling with this next expansion. In fact, while there will be plenty of the [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] gameplay you know and love to revel in, you might recognize core elements from other genres making their debut as well. We’re pretty sure you’ll like what you see, and there’s so much more to share!

While we aren’t ready to go into the exact details yet, we do hear rumblings that a previously mentioned event in Cologne later this summer would be a great moment to stay tuned to the [i]Age of Empires[/i] channels.

[h2]Age of Empires Mobile: PC Edition is coming, play first at Gamescom[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e2181c0dd353081bc93000207ef8d1f9a5ba04ff.jpg[/img]

In October 2024 we launched [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i] and millions of players around the world have been building cities, recruiting heroes and winning battles with their alliances.

Today we’re excited to announce that we’re bringing the title to PC. This new PC Edition brings rapid pacing combined with PC elements that players demand: optimized mouse control and settings, full keyboard navigation, refined UI, enhanced 4K visuals, and seamless Steam and Xbox Live integration.

We’ll have more details on the title soon including release date, but visitors to the [i]Age of Empires[/i] booth at Gamescom will be the first to get to play [i]Age of Empires Mobile: PC Edition[/i] and we can’t wait to see you.

[h2]Competitive Age Continues to Flourish in 2025![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/51cb7fa0dfefbcd1987efd427bab1639b91e0647.jpg[/img]

Players in the [i]Age of Empires[/i] Esports scene are competing harder than ever before, creating exhilarating moments for fans around the globe. With over $200,000 awarded to players in S-tier events alone so far in 2025, we still have many events and surprises upcoming in the second half of the year. Including a LAN event in Germany and China!
[list][*] Congratulations to our S-tier [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] champion:
[list][*] Hera continued his dominance in the T90 Titans League 4, The Garrison, and Warlords IV.[/list]
[*] Congratulations to our S-tier [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] champions:
[list][*] Beasty in the EGC Masters Winter.
[*] MarineLorD in The Elite Classic III.
[*] loueMT in the EGC Masters Summer.
[*] MarineLorD in the Masters of Steel.[/list]
[*] Congratulations to our S-tier [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] champions:
[list][*] TheMista in Clash of Immortals.
[*] Kvothhh in Mythic Wars.[/list][/list]

Thank you to our incredible and dedicated tournament organizers who turn these thrilling spectacles into reality, and to our devoted players who continue to master the titles of the [i]Age[/i] franchise.

For more information on upcoming [i]Age of Empires[/i] Esports events, please see our [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/eventscalendar/]Events Calendar[/url] to watch along live and support your favorite players!

[hr][/hr]

This is only a sneak peek at what’s still to come for [i]Age of Empires[/i] and [i]Age of Mythology[/i]. We can’t wait to share more and hope it sparked your excitement for everything coming in the second half of the year.

The best way to stay informed on everything [i]Age[/i] is to follow our official channels below, we’ll be sharing more details as soon as we can. For now, please continue to send us your feedback, your thoughts and what you’d like to see next across our social channels, forums, Discord, and Steam.

Wololo!

Join the [i]Age[/i] Community Channels:

notes.title: 26 years later, Age of Empires 2 update makes a life-saving early game change
notes.content:
Long-running RTS games like Age of Empires 2 are notoriously well-optimized. Picking up set build paths and strategies is crucial, even as a total newbie, or else you'll quickly fall behind the tempo of the lobby. When every second counts, so too does every morsel of food and splinter of wood you can gather early on. This typically includes having your villagers dance around a boar or two, which can quickly descend into chaos, and a spree of murdered townsfolk, if you have a tough time kiting the peeved off pigs. Fortunately, a new update is empowering your collective action, making the risky maneuver a thing of the past.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Gorgeous new expansion proves Age of Empires 2 is the greatest RTS of its kind
After 26 years, Age of Empires 2 returns to rule over medieval RTS games
New Age of Empires 2 update is the biggest ever, makes the RTS feel young again

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/da618c35e07ed9747d94ba55bffcddc5360aef12.png[/img]

Welcome to another update for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition! This will bring some balance changes and bug fixes based on your feedback.

[quote]💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-ii/] Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires] The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Thank you again to our amazing community members, all of whom have helped to make [i]Age of Empires[/i] what it is today!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team
[hr][/hr][code][h1]        ◆ Update 147949 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[quote][h1][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/8873961bef2e9d3d640a08de144983256b446a60.png[/img]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*] Fire Lancer attack increased from 8 → 9.
[*] (Elite) Fire Lancer cost reduced from 40 wood 50 gold → 40 wood 45 gold.[/list]

[table noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/37c3b855b62cca694b8e47bf261c0d31136b8965.png[/img][/td][td][h3]Jurchens[/h3][/td][/tr][/table][list][*] Grenadier
[list][*] HP increased from 35 → 40.
[*] Cost reduced from 35 food 70 gold → 35 food 65 gold.
[*] Attack increased from 11 → 12.[/list]
[*] Iron Pagoda
[list][*] Ability recharge reduced from 60 seconds → 40 seconds, Elite 50 seconds → 30 seconds.
[*] Upgrade cost reduced from 950 food 750 gold → 950 food 550 gold.[/list][/list]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e558b6f7a5ab13a33a9d38b63fddc04d9559a2e7.png[/img][/td][td][h3]Khitans[/h3][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Shepherds and Herders generate +10% additional food civilization bonus removed.

notes.title: New Age of Empires 2 update is the biggest ever, makes the RTS feel young again
notes.content:
Age of Empires 2 is eternal. Like Half-Life, Fallout, Doom, and Deus Ex, it remains one of the foundational pillars that holds PC gaming aloft. Originally released in 1999, the best AoE game in history - and one of the greatest RTS games of all time - is still going strong a quarter of a century later. It always looked great, but the Definitive Edition makes it shine even brighter. With regular tweaks, upgrades, enhancements, and new material, the revised version of Age of Empires 2 remains the perfect homage to the game's legacy, and now, somehow, it's getting bigger. The largest update in AoE 2: Definitive Edition's history has just arrived, with more civilizations and campaigns on the way courtesy of a new DLC.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Pre-Order Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition – The Three Kingdoms
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e6fe5fb1e8732e7aaf0e13a5ed2a0db699ec49ff.jpg[/img]
We are thrilled to announce the next DLC for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] – [i]The Three Kingdoms[/i], a riveting and holistic expansion, [b]coming May 6th![/b] Dive into China’s epic Romance of the Three Kingdoms, where history and legend collide in a battle for supremacy.

[i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] introduces five fascinating new civilizations, each with their own unique units and technologies: the Shu, Wei, and Wu, who represent the legendary Three Kingdoms; and the Jurchens and Khitans, who exemplify the struggle for power in northern China beyond the Three Kingdoms period. Challenge your friends in skirmish matches or battle your way across China with three new campaigns, commanding the forces of fabled heroes such as Liu Bei, Cao Cao, and the Sun Clan. These campaigns feature unprecedented features such as devastating special hero abilities, an interactive decision system allowing you to blaze your own trail, and more!

We have been delighted to work with Forgotten Empires to bring you [i]The Three Kingdoms[/i]. Whether you are a passionate historian, an admirer of compelling narratives, a longtime fan of the [i]Age of Empires[/i] franchise, or all of the above – [i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] will bring you endless hours of joy and fun!


[i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] is now available for pre-order with 15% discount on Steam - releasing May 6th!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3080080/Age_of_Empires_II_DE__The_Three_Kingdoms

[quote][h2]What is The Three Kingdoms? [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/028403eeb6b85465545abdc321a0a8b1c6728a1c.jpg[/img]
[quote][i]“The empire, long divided, must unite; long united, must divide. Thus it has ever been. 

In the dying days of the Han dynasty, the empire was like a precious vase knocked off its pedestal. As it fell towards the ground, some refused to accept the inevitable and imagined that the worst had passed. 

The more far-sighted positioned themselves to pick up the pieces.”[/i][/quote]
Created by Forgotten Empires, the passionate team bringing you [i]Age of Empires[/i] content for over a decade, [i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] is a DLC set in China primarily during the early medieval period, but also featuring two civilizations who rose and fell hundreds of years later. China’s Three Kingdoms, extremely advanced for their time, offer [i]AoE II: DE[/i] players the game’s core unit roster along with several unique and region-specific units highlighting the iconic features of each kingdom. Veterans and newcomers alike will enjoy approachable, powerful, and immersive new civilizations!

The story of [i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] opens with three intertwining narratives spanning roughly 25 years. Totaling 15 missions across 3 campaigns with branching narratives and dynamic, far-reaching decisions that offer a level of replay value never before seen in [i]Age of Empires[/i], [i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] offers a tour par excellence through China’s most fabled and beloved period of history from the viewpoints of all three kingdoms’ founders. Experience storied battles such as Guandu, Changban, and Red Cliffs, and relive the dashing exploits of the honorable and benevolent Liu Bei, the conniving yet brilliant Cao Cao, and the resilient, vengeful Sun Clan![/quote]
[quote][h2]Included in this DLC[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/3a6074b1fce098c497ff6c0265939fc9aefa5ca0.jpg[/img]

[h3]5 New Civilizations[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/8582e5c252fb1918aead3e88278257852ed50e7e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/760be843c6506e723cc43d2c1e017dccc5b16946.png[/img][/url] [b]Shu[/b]
Take the reins of the Kingdom of Shu and fulfill Liu Bei’s dream of restoring the Han dynasty. The Shu unique units are the [i]White Feather Guard[/i], an infantryman that slows down units it attacks, and the [i]War Chariot[/i], a vehicle that fires barrages of bolts from a large repeating crossbow.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/bfa0538d60f499dd12f22d1595db1ce7d2bd4b09.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/d15f3d40971d5d09b1598eae2472ac3ec632485a.png[/img][/url] [b]Wei[/b]
Step into the shoes of Cao Cao and dominate China with massive cavalry armies and nefarious schemes. The Wei unique units are the [i]Tiger Cavalry[/i], a horseman that levels up as it kills units, and the [i]Xianbei Raider[/i], a cavalry archer that fires storms of arrows into the enemy ranks.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/c7ef27724ace05f643ea500446a0b7c9e0c477b0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/5000ebe6b9aad265d1cd92a239d2a4408eadb022.png[/img][/url] [b]Wu[/b]
Lead the Sun Clan to glory through infantry and naval prowess. The Wu unique units are the [i]Fire Archer[/i], a ranged soldier that fires incendiary arrows, and the [i]Jian Swordsman[/i], a heavy infantry unit whose shield offers immense protection – until it breaks.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/bf4ebdb94954a24d4b9b8bfa390b047c9a32566c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/55e4bd6ad9395a6cb571fd5793d96da29ab67b8d.png[/img][/url] [b]Jurchens[/b]
Dominate the rugged terrain of northeast China with the skilled hunters, armored cavalry, and gunpowder weaponry of the Great Jin dynasty. The Jurchen unique units are the [i]Iron Pagoda[/i], a cavalryman that occasionally blocks melee attacks, and the[i] Grenadier[/i], a foot soldier who hurls deadly incendiary bombs at his enemies.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/3d02a8c453fd226274ae347402c1efd94237ae12.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/74e237f16f8625566f83449ddc6d4cb992c1d377.png[/img][/url] [b]Khitans[/b]
Relive the glory of the Liao dynasty and Kara-Khitai, terrorizing your enemies with mobile hordes and diabolical weapons. The Khitan unique units are the Liao Dao, an infantryman whose lethal sword slashes cause lasting damage, and the [i]Mounted Trebuchet[/i], a powerful siege engine carried around by camels. Additionally, instead of farming, the Khitans gather food from [i]Pastures[/i], which can be tended by two Villagers instead of just one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/af0bbfee5b0af92d690b0ebfcad5e9fa0da1c91f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Several new units and unit-lines for increased immersion in Chinese history:[/h3]

[list][*] [i][b]Hei Guang Cavalry[/b][/i] — a heavily armored horseman. Regular and Elite Hei Guang Cavalry replace Knights, Cavaliers, and Paladins for the Shu, Wei, and Wu.
[*] [i][b]Traction Trebuchets[/b][/i] — deadly, mobile engines that provide the Shu, Wei, and Wu an excellent long-ranged siege option on land in the Imperial Age.
[*] [i][b]Lou Chuans[/b][/i] — literal floating fortresses that excel against other warships and buildings alike. Available to the Chinese, Jurchens, Shu, Wei, and Wu.
[*] [i][b]Fire Lancers[/b][/i] — spear-wielding infantry who occasionally use an explosive ranged attack. Available to the Chinese, Jurchens, Khitans, Koreans, and Vietnamese.
[*] [i][b]Rocket Carts[/b][/i] — this siege engine replaces Mangonels, and instead fires a volley of incendiary rockets at enemies. Available to the Chinese, Jurchens, Khitans, and Koreans.
[*] [i][b]Dragon Ships[/b][/i] — the deadliest Fire Ship in the game, exclusive to the Chinese![/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/028403eeb6b85465545abdc321a0a8b1c6728a1c.jpg[/img]

[h3]3 New Campaigns:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Liu Bei (Shu)[/b] — In the midst of a bloody civil war, the sandal maker Liu Bei and his sworn brothers fight to restore the ailing Han dynasty. Can this honorable commoner save the empire, or will it fall into the hands of the ruthless warlord Cao Cao?
[*] [b]Cao Cao (Wei)[/b] — The greatest warlord of his time, Cao Cao rises from a mere cavalry commander to the true power behind the throne of China. Will his ambitious schemes and tactical skill be enough to place his own dynasty on the throne of the Middle Kingdom?
[*] [b]The Sun Clan (Wu)[/b] — After their father is murdered, the sons of the Sun Clan fight for revenge while building themselves up to be the rulers of southern China. Will their struggle make them worthy of the Mandate of Heaven, or are they doomed to become footnotes in history?[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e9c7b874e1deffd7d1cb0881ce01198b0fd269d4.jpg[/img]

[h3]As you venture through these campaigns, you will: [/h3]
[list][*] [b]Relive fabled events:[/b] like the [i]Oath of the Peach Garden[/i], the [i]Yellow Turban Rebellion[/i], and the [i]Battle of Red Cliffs[/i] – from up to three different perspectives!
[*] [b]Encounter legendary characters:[/b] such as the notorious [i]Lü Bu[/i], the wise [i]Zhuge Liang[/i], and the exalted [i]Guan Yu[/i].
[*] [b]Unleash their deadly heroic abilities:[/b] like [i]Green Dragon Strike[/i], [i]Superhuman Aim[/i], and [i]Exploding Bolt[/i].
[*] [b]Train your favorite heroes:[/b] from the Three Kingdoms era in the new Hall of Heroes building.
[*] [b]Experience unprecedented gameplay and narrative value:[/b] as you use an interactive system to make key decisions that shape each campaign.
[*] [b]Choose from two new difficulty levels:[/b] [i]Easiest[/i] offers a leisurely cruise through the story, while [i]Legendary[/i] could test the mettle of Cao Cao himself!
[*] [b]Marvel at an array of new flora, fauna, and other atmospheric visuals:[/b] that will fully immerse you in China’s Three Kingdoms era.[/list][/quote]
[quote][h2]All 5 New Civilizations Available in Ranked Play![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/b400b3fb93c9d8b00c65bb55d76bbb52d64fa808.jpg[/img]
While [i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] era sits on the edge of [i]AoE II: DE[/i] traditional timeframe, Forgotten Empires was committed to delivering a product with content for everyone at all levels, styles, spheres, and preferences of the [i]Age of Empires[/i] experience. Research and design exploration quickly showed that Three Kingdoms China was extremely advanced for its time, making it an easy fit into the [i]AoE II: DE[/i] technology tree and design mould. With this in mind, we committed ourselves to the goal of making this DLC fully available in ranked gameplay.

With an instantly recognizable [i]Age of Empires II[/i]-feel, plenty of flavor to satisfy the appetites of avid [i]Romance of the Three Kingdoms[/i], fans and the innovative features that [i]AoE II: DE[/i] fans have come to expect from each new addition to our beloved game, T[i]he Three Kingdoms[/i] has something for everyone.[/quote]
[quote][h2]A Message from Forgotten Empires[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/b28c8eed89f241b388cadbd68c164488325a5023.jpg[/img]

[i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] represents something a little different than we’ve done in our prior work on [i]Age of Empires II[/i]. Although authenticity, fun, and innovation have always been hallmarks of the Forgotten Empires brand, [i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] pushes each of these farther than our past [i]Age of Empires II[/i] releases. Our goal for [i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] is to inspire new and longtime players alike to revel in the [i]Age of Empires[/i] experience, and we hope it does justice to the game we all know and love – as well as to each and every one of its fans!

Whenever we at Forgotten Empires set ourselves to creating [i]Age of Empires[/i] content, we ask ourselves two fundamental questions: “What got you started playing [i]Age of Empires[/i]?”, and “What kept you playing [i]Age of Empires[/i]?”, which are part of the navigational toolset we use to guide us on that quest.

While there can be as many answers to those questions as there are grains of sand in an hourglass, one is that China’s Three Kingdoms era lends itself particularly well to is a compelling campaign experience. While we’ve told many compelling stories through our historical campaigns over the past decade, we’ve also always asked ourselves the question: “How do we raise the bar further still?” With an epic, detailed, riveting, and thoroughly renowned narrative that is to China as Shakespeare is to the western world, [i]The Romance of the Three Kingdoms[/i] offered us an ideal setting to tackle that challenge.

With entertaining new civilizations, stunning new visuals, innovative concepts, fun and varied mission designs, and a gripping narrative with unprecedented depth, all brought to you in the time-proven [i]Age of Empires II[/i] gameplay experience, we welcome you to the incredible world of Three Kingdoms China. We hope you enjoy playing [i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] as much as we delighted in creating it, and as always, we appreciate your continued passion for this incredible franchise![/quote]
[h1]Pre-Order The Three Kingdoms Now![/h1]
Dive into the epic history and legends of China with [i]The Three Kingdoms[/i]! Lead five new civilizations – Shu, Wei, Wu, Jurchens, and Khitans – through an era where history and legend collide in a battle for supremacy. Fight your way across China with three new campaigns, commanding the forces of Liu Bei, Cao Cao, and the Sun Clan, each with their unique units, technologies, and heroes with devastating abilities!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3080080/Age_of_Empires_II_DE__The_Three_Kingdoms

[b][i]The Three Kingdoms[/i] is now available for pre-order with a 15% discount on Steam – releasing May 6th![/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/886a7bea9c018ebaffa9efe1518f8e277a485af5.jpg[/img]
Last month, we teased that not only would [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] be coming to PlayStation 5, but a new expansion is planned as well. To put a cherry on top, we will also be releasing one of the biggest updates [i]Age II: DE[/i] has ever had!

While we continue working on getting all of this incredible content and fixes ready for you, we wanted to provide a preview of our work in progress. Why so early? These patch notes are long – [b]legendarily long[/b] – and we wanted to give you an early look to take it all in.

Everything you see outlined and described below is what will come in the next update to [i]Age II: DE[/i]. We don’t have an exact date to share for this update just yet, but you can save the date for [b]mid-April![/b]

Now, we know these notes are already HUGE. There is a surprise reveal about the expansion for anyone who makes it to the end. Pay close attention and you will notice a whole bunch of hidden treasures throughout hinting about what’s to come. We hope this has you as excited as us for the future of [i]Age II: DE[/i]!

While there are plenty of notable things to look forward to in the notes below, here’s some of the big highlights coming with the next update in mid-April:
[list][*] Bug fixes based on your feedback!
[*] New Visuals for Castles, Elite Unique Units, Monks and Monasteries!
[*] Technology Tree UI updates!
[*] Balance changes!
[*] New Maps!
[*] New features and content to support:
[list][*] Random Map Scripting
[*] Scenario Editor
[*] Modding[/list][/list]
[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires] The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]

Thank you again to our amazing community members, all of whom have helped to make [i]Age of Empires[/i] what it is today!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team
[hr][/hr][code][h1]   ◆ New Content & Update Notes◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[quote][h1][b]What's on the Horizon?[/b][/h1]
Hey [i]Age of Empires[/i] Community!

It’s been a minute since we’ve provided some thoughts and teasers toward everything that’s happening with [i]Age II: DE[/i], and the last time we did we were in the middle of launching [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] – the newest DLC for [i]Age II: DE[/i] from our friends at CaptureAge. 

If you haven’t played [i]Battle for Greece[/i] yet, it’s definitely worth taking a peek at what others are saying, especially if you love Campaign content and historical narrative. We’ve been thrilled to see the reaction from everyone and we’re keeping our eyes on your feedback – thank you so much for joining us on this journey!

But let’s not bury the lead, we’re sure you have some questions right now.

The last time you heard from World’s Edge, we made the surprise announcement that [i]Age II: DE[/i] will be coming to PlayStation 5! Or maybe, back to PlayStation? It definitely feels like a full circle moment and we got some chuckles out of the [i]Age of Kings[/i] PS2 conversations that popped up. We know you’re curious and want details, but this one needs to wait a bit longer – we’ll have more to say about this very soon!

Today, we’re doing something a little different with our patch notes. Usually, you get these on the same day that an update is being released, but this time we’re providing patch notes in advance. We’re not yet ready to say exactly when this update is dropping, but you can expect to hear from us in mid-April. 

For anyone that was wondering when we’d be back with something new for our competitive players, this is our love letter to you. We wanted to give you some time to digest it all and get hyped while we finish up the work on one of our biggest updates ever!

We’re excited to reveal some pretty big surprises in these notes, including an absolutely massive list of new balance changes, bug fixes, feature updates, new maps, scenario editor updates, and a lot more! 

We can’t wait to see your reaction to those sweet new Castles and the many other visual updates on their way to all players of [i]Age II: DE[/i], absolutely free, when our next update launches.

We’re forgetting something aren’t we?

During that PlayStation 5 announcement, we also mentioned that there’s an exciting new expansion coming to [i]Age II: DE[/i]! We even provided a couple of images to give you an opportunity to sleuth and debate what we’re cooking up. It’s been fun for us to see what everybody is guessing at! We’re not yet ready to share the full details, so keep your eyes peeled for a future announcement with a complete breakdown of everything included in the new expansion.

For those that study today’s patch notes carefully, you’re likely to find some clues. We’re not telling you where this information exists and we’re not doing much to draw any attention to it, but it’s there. It won’t tell you everything, but it’ll provide some entertainment while we wait for a more official roll-out.

Oh, and maybe we can share this too…

The next expansion for [i]Age II: DE[/i] will include FIVE brand NEW Civs, all playable in Ranked Multiplayer. Yes, you read that correctly. Five! Is that all the DLC includes? Nope. We’ll be following up soon with more details regarding PlayStation 5, the next DLC, and news on the availability of this exciting update! 

We like to end these things by reminding everyone how thankful we are for you – the [i]Age[/i] Community – and that it’s our absolute privilege and joy to be able to develop this game and franchise for you! We love it as much as you do, and we’re glad you’re here!

Wololo!

Welcome to a minor update for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] focused on a few Xbox stability fixes. Be sure to dig down into the post below to get all of the smaller details before hopping in-game and checking them out firsthand.

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[quote][h1]Xbox[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1db5c65a88bbfe0c20e6ed2d39eb75f446dc5dc4.png[/img]

[h2]Stability & Performance[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed a crash that could occur when disconnecting from Voice Chat.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur during the intro video.
[*] Fixed various crashes related to playing through multiple campaign missions.[/list][/quote]
[quote][h2]Ongoing...[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/caa99c8a5cbf0e5f35516859a6a3a1089c41195f.png[/img]
[h2]Investigation[/h2]
As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates.

For other known issues, please visit [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/articles/360049490811]this page[/url] to see what’s being tracked![/quote]
[quote][h2]What’s on the Horizon?[/h2]
[h3]COMING UP…[/h3]
Hey there Community!

It’s been a minute since we’ve provided an idea of what’s coming your way. Since we last teased what’s on the horizon, you got the surprise announcement and launch of [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i], the newest DLC for [i]Age II: DE[/i] developed by CaptureAge. Since then, we’ve been watching everyone play and gathering plenty of feedback, so don’t be surprised to see updates and fixes coming for [i]Battle for Greece[/i] in the near future.

Your feedback remains a north star for us and recently you heard about ongoing efforts around pathfinding. This is something that the team is constantly paying attention to, and we’ll often ship fixes related to this system in updates where we also make balance changes or launch other gameplay-centric features. With anything affecting gameplay and especially pathfinding or related areas of code like unit behavior or formations, we’re increasingly cautious about this process. It’s an area where it’s especially easy to create unintended consequences and new bugs, so changes here will happen slowly and over time even if the feedback and conversations happening around them are more immediate and topical. Please stay tuned regarding any updates in this area and please know that we’re definitely at work – we’ll have more to share when we know what kind of changes we can deliver and when, with our priority being to keep your experience as stable and performant as possible.

There’s also the challenge of all of the other things in our calendar 😉

We promised big surprises last year and those surprises are even nearer to being revealed now that we’re in the New Year (how is January already almost over!?) Unfortunately we can’t announce or spoil any of those things here, but you might not need to wait much longer. Watch this space.

Even with big surprises looming, there’s still plenty more that the team is busy with and a pretty exciting set of plans we’re constantly considering. None of this would be possible without this amazing Community that continues to show up and play this game we all love so much, which is something we remain incredibly thankful for. Today’s patch notes are obviously tiny, but we’ll be back pretty soon with more to talk about as our roadmap plays out – we’re excited about what’s waiting for you!

Wololo![/quote]

notes.title: New Public Update Preview - December Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/ece28d0ba764929180dc4b9672fc1d075d364d72.png[/img]Hello everyone!

Looking to see what's ahead for the next update? Try out the [b]Public Update Preview Program[/b] for our upcoming December Patch.

This PUP contains fixes to address stability and out of sync issues in multiplayer games. You can help make our release even better by playing the test build and reporting any new issues encountered! You can provide feedback in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/33/4629233123492631229/]our forums.[/url]

More information on [b]December's Public Update Preview Program[/b] can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/33/4629233123492631229/]here.[/url]

Please join us in strengthening the quality of [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] by sharing your voice on the official [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/33/]🛠 Public Update Preview[/url] forums. [i](Note that you must own the game and log in to Steam to access the PUP forum.)[/i] 

[h3]How to participate in the PUP[/h3]

Steam owners can download the [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] PUP by following the instructions below: 

[list]1. Navigate to your Steam library and right click on [i][b]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition.[/b][/i]
2. Select "Properties…" at the bottom of the menu.
3. Select the "Betas" tab on the left.
4. In the "Beta Participation" dropdown menu, select dec_pup.
5. The build will begin downloading—once complete, you are ready to play![/list]

We’re definitely listening, and looking for every opportunity to make this the game you love to play. :)

Thank you! 

- The World's Edge Team

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]How to Access [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i][/b]
[i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] is an immersive narrative expansion for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] that transports players to the world of classical antiquity. When launching [i]Age II: DE[/i], select the [i]Chronicles[/i] icon on the Main Menu to access this expansion.

[b]What is the Grand Campaign?[/b]
[i]Battle for Greece[/i] is the inaugural chapter in the Grand Campaign. This features a campaign spanning over a century of history, including the Ionian Revolt, the Greco-Persian Wars, and the Peloponnesian War. Encounter iconic historical figures like Artemisia, Themistocles, and Brasidas, brought to life through engaging voice acting and animated cutscenes.

[b]How to enable Antiquity Mode?[/b]
This mode can be selected in the Lobby and will enable Oysters and Wood Trading.

[b]Why am I seeing Dark Ages when playing in [i]Chronicles[/i]?[/b]
Only the Achaemenids, Athenians, and Spartans will have access to the Antiquity ages. Here is a guide of the equivalent ages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1376558632fe4e7bf42e6d375ac996f98af8373f.jpg[/img]

[b]Having trouble accessing [i]Chronicles[/i]?[/b]
Follow the steps in the [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402286154772-Trouble-downloading-an-Age-II-DE-DLC]Trouble downloading an [i]Age II: DE[/i] DLC[/url] article.

notes.title: Celebrate 5 Years of Age II: DE with a Fresh Deal for New Players
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f30307c4f024ab73c503730b6a43a6a11ff281aa.jpg[/img]
Today marks 5 years since we launched [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], breathing new life into the globally beloved game. Since then, the game and our player base have grown. In these first five years we’ve added: 
[list][*] 7 DLC and 3 animated icons packs 
[*] 10 civilizations to take into skirmish and ranked play 
[*] 17 civilizations in the [i]Return of Rome[/i] DLC 
[*] 3 civilizations in the [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] DLC 
[*] 16 campaigns 
[*] 19 scenarios in [i]Victors & Vanquished[/i] 
[*] 21 scenarios in [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] DLC 
[*] Multiple game modes – Empire Wars, Battle Royale & D3[/list]   
We’ve also released almost 100 game updates, fixing bugs, improving play and adding new features.

To celebrate, starting today new players can purchase [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] and will automatically receive three DLCs: [i]Lords of the West[/i], [i]Dawn of the Dukes[/i], and [i]Dynasties of India[/i]. By combining these DLCs with the base game, we’re offering a more complete experience to newcomers for only $34.99 (USD, please check stores for your local price).  

For players who already own [i]Age of Empires II: DE[/i] on Steam, we want to thank you for playing with us these past five years by automatically gifting you any of the three mentioned DLCs that aren’t already in your collection. You can find instructions on downloading additional content on our Support Site.

notes.title: The History Inside Chronicles: Battle for Greece
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/40634e9f337eb8a3990377d2dd7ecc01b78a5238.jpg[/img]
[quote][i]Here is displayed the History of Herodotus of Halicarnassus, made so that the deeds of humankind should not be forgotten in time, and that great and wondrous deeds – some displayed by the Hellenes, some by the barbarians – should not lose their glory, including among other things the cause of their waging war on each other. [/i]

– Herodotus, [i]Histories 1 [/i][/quote]
With the upcoming release of [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i], Dr. Ben Angell, Narrative Lead at CaptureAge has taken some time to talk about the inspiration and history you can look forward to experiencing on November 14th:

The [i]Age of Empires[/i] series holds a special place in my life: I’ve been playing this series since I was six years old, and it inspired a love of history that ultimately led to attaining a Doctorate in Ancient History from the University of Oxford. Now, I have the tremendous privilege of bringing my passion and expertise back to the series where my journey as a historian and writer started.  

The CaptureAge team has striven to immerse players in the ancient world with [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] through reworked visuals, historically-flavored dialogue, and vivid recreation of famous historical battles in new scenarios. 
[hr][/hr]
[i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] is available for pre-order now on Steam, Microsoft Store, and Xbox!
[b]Pre-order now for 15% off, and play on November 14th![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2805520/Age_of_Empires_II_DE__Chronicles_Battle_for_Greece/
[hr][/hr]
[h3]The Visual Overhaul [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/d85f24782abf5e99264fd82d69923eb068fdefc8.jpg[/img]
We needed to completely overhaul the look of the game to make it appropriate for classical antiquity. Units shared between the civilizations had to be remodeled and renamed – Knights, for instance, became Lancers – while [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/813780/view/4515514058306224257?l=english]naval combat has been fully overhauled[/url]. These units needed to be reasonably applicable to all of the civilizations, across the entire geographical and temporal span that [i]Chronicles[/i] covers – hence the Achaemenids, for example, have access to large warships whose visual design is inspired more by the Hellenistic and Roman eras.  

We were able to get more specific with our unique and regional units, such as the Achaemenid Immortal, or the Hoplite fielded by all the Greek civilizations. We also included 13 campaign-only units, including Cretan Archers, Scythian Axe Cavalry, and Rhodian Slingers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/4c4be90a715acce6292830d285a3ac4b3b6ce837.jpg[/img]

We also gave new names and icons to many technologies in the game. The Temple (the Monastery) provides many good examples. For instance, Redemption – which allows players to convert enemy buildings – has been replaced in [i]Chronicles[/i] by Evocatio, referring to a Roman ritual whereby the protective deities of a besieged city would be invited to abandon the enemy and come over to the Roman side. 

[h3]Dialogue[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/687fad01f4205ebc6a38d1c24045a86daaaaaa30.jpg[/img]
In [i]Chronicles[/i], we’ve tried to fill the dialogue with as much historical flavor as possible. Characters invoke the gods and promise them sacrifices; they discuss how they should behave by referencing examples from epic poems and mythological stories; they hurl authentic insults like “dog-faced” and use exclamations from Greek tragedy like “oimoi” and “euai”. 

History buffs might even notice some direct references to ancient sources. For instance, one character swears an oath “by Ares, Enyo, and blood-loving Phobos” – the oath sworn in Aeschylus’s [i]Seven Against Thebes[/i]. A particularly spine-tingling example is Leonidas, fighting until the end at Thermopylae, echoing the Spartan war poet Tyrtaeus’s exhortation to “make life your enemy and hold the black spirits of death dear as the rays of the sun”.

[h3]Scenarios[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/830894888fb6c44592204245969e9e703f7848d6.jpg[/img]
The [i]Battle for Greece[/i] campaign closely follows the events of the fifth century BCE, including vivid recreations of many of its most famous battles, such as Marathon, Thermopylae, and Salamis. We’ve creatively represented numerous features of the period: you’ll have to undermine the walls of Miletus with sapper tunnels, demand and collect tribute from the increasingly dissatisfied members of the Athenian empire, and flush rebellious agitators from helot villages as the Spartans.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/45e047d9066349637cdd75ffd6989bc6e72364bb.jpg[/img]
[i]431 BCE was a bad time to be an Athenian farmer.[/i]

As an example, the 15th scenario, “Within the Long Walls”, recreates the early years of the Peloponnesian War: the Athenians are trapped inside their city walls while hostile Spartans burn the fields beyond. Playing as the Athenian leader Pericles, you must maintain your political popularity while the vicious demagogue Cleon urges the people against you. Later, in the 19th scenario set during the Sicilian Expedition, the Athenians attempt to enclose the city of Syracuse within a stone wall – so the Syracusans and their Spartan allies build a counter-wall to stop them! 

[quote]This is just a small preview of the historical feast to come in [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i]. The new campaign is full of references and details to delight the history buffs among you![/quote]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Pre-Order Now![/h2]
[i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] is available for pre-order now on Steam, Microsoft Store, and Xbox!
[b]Pre-order now for 15% off, and play on November 14th![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2805520/Age_of_Empires_II_DE__Chronicles_Battle_for_Greece/
