notes.title: Expanding Naval Warfare in Chronicles: Battle for Greece
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/5134d120d9d97ae8b776b8cfbd1d9dbf4d433f35.jpg[/img]
[quote][i]Seamanship is an art, no different from any other art; it cannot be taken up occasionally as a leisurely pursuit – rather it is so exacting that it leaves leisure for nothing else!
[/i]
– Thucydides, The Peloponnesian War 1.142.9[/quote]
Hoist the sails, harangue the oarsmen, and pour libations for favorable winds, as CaptureAge prepares to lead you through the many [b]new naval features[/b] in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] – [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i].

Right from the start of the[i] Chronicles[/i] project, naval gameplay has been central to the vision. We wanted to expand the strategic depth of [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]’s naval gameplay, do justice to the importance of naval warfare in classical antiquity, and – most importantly – give players some exciting new toys to play with.

A little historical note: much like the other non-unique units which are shared across all civilizations, the designs of our ships are creative composites of styles from across the ancient world, and from across the time period that [i]Chronicles[/i] will eventually cover. Thus the Achaemenids, for instance, have access to large siege ships that are heavily inspired by the Hellenistic and Roman eras.

[hr][/hr]
[i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] is available for pre-order now on Steam! Pre-order now for 15% off, and play on November 14th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2805520/Age_of_Empires_II_DE__Chronicles_Battle_for_Greece/

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Two Naval Production Buildings[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1c280a7e00acb22d543e38dccfd1e3f2cf330fdf.jpg[/img]
Rather than recruiting all of your naval units from the Dock, in [i]Chronicles[/i] you’ll have access to two different naval buildings: the [b]Port[/b] and the [b]Shipyard[/b].

The Port is more focused on economic production: here, players can create Fishing Ships, Merchant Ships, Transport Ships, and our cheap scout ships, the Lemboi. Shipyards, on the other hand, are used to create military ships.

[h2]Six Military Ship Classes[/h2]

[h3]Lemboi[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/619dad4429f532df0ad5a794c072db2b53ca079d.jpg[/img]
[table equalcells=1][tr][td]Lembos [/td][td]War Lembos[/td][td]Heavy Lembos[/td][td]Elite Lembos[/td][/tr][/table]
Lemboi are small and cheap, requiring no gold to create. They are ideal for scouting, and players will receive a free Lembos when they construct their first Port. Lemboi are also effective against Galleys, hurling pots of boiling oil at their foes. The Lembos is the only military ship to be recruited from the Port.

[h3]Ramming Ships[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/70c738c9bd76272ed132325f6a4374d51cb615ce.jpg[/img]
[table equalcells=1][tr][td]Monoreme [/td][td]Bireme[/td][td]Trireme[/td][/tr][/table]
A common feature of ancient naval warfare was ramming: ships would smash into the sides of other vessels with metal rams attached to their prows. In [i]Chronicles[/i], these ships are highly effective against Lemboi, and will be essential for closing in on Catapult Ships.

[h3]Galleys[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/d8aa988f01abf28e1ed2d0905c74ce7cca6131ce.jpg[/img]
[table equalcells=1][tr][td]Galley [/td][td]War Galley[/td][td]Elite Galley[/td][/tr][/table]
The main ranged ship at your disposal is the Galley. These are effective against ramming ships – as long as you can keep them at a distance – and are essential for taking out those pesky incoming Incendiary Ships.

[h3]Incendiary Ships[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/149862b7d7500cc56f8708cdf729706e50403051.jpg[/img]
[table equalcells=1][tr][td]Incendiary Raft [/td][td]Incendiary Ship[/td][td]Heavy Incendiary Ship[/td][/tr][/table]
All [i]Age of Empires[/i] players love detonating a well-placed Demolition Ship. We couldn’t leave out such an iconic unit, so we made our own, inspired by ancient uses of burning rafts, such as at the Siege of Tyre in 332 BCE. If directed against large groups of enemy ships, an Incendiary Ship can be deadly – and oh so satisfying!

[h3]Catapult Ships[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/970a3d535a081b05d684850b52ed30754bdddea7.jpg[/img]
[table equalcells=1][tr][td]Catapult Ship [/td][td]Onager Ship[/td][/tr][/table]
Speaking of the dangers faced by large groups of ships, a well-timed volley from a Catapult Ship can devastate an unsuspecting enemy navy. Only available from the third Age (referred to in [i]Chronicles[/i] as the Classical Age), these large, expensive ships can turn the tide of tight fights.

[h3]Leviathans[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e544f555f17ab1fa3166077b72378c06e1be1351.jpg[/img]
[table equalcells=1][tr][td]Leviathan [/td][/tr][/table]
Finally, the siege ship, the Leviathan. Appropriately named after the mythical sea monster, the Leviathan is an enormous Imperial Age unit which can destroy buildings from long range. Make sure your Leviathans are protected – as well as their long-range attack, they also increase the attack rate of nearby ships.

[h2]Naval Economy[/h2]

[h3]Oysters[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1a7e9422006a964a29d574b84e43ec69cfd98dab.jpg[/img]
Oysters are a new naval resource, providing gold at sea. They can be collected by Fishing Ships or by Villagers, if the Oysters are sufficiently close to the shore.
[quote][b]Beware: Oyster grounds will be frequent sites of conflict with your resource-hungry foes![/b][/quote]
[h3]Merchant Trading[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/0570e403dd2e9a6613c693dab3f2cd586ae2a770.jpg[/img]
In [i]Chronicles[/i], your Merchant Ships (replacing Trade Cogs) bring back both wood and gold when trading with allied docks. You can adjust the ratio of wood to gold in the Port, allowing you to prioritize bringing in the wood you need for naval production, or gold for expensive units and upgrades.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/062c7247cf50f23ec63669d090e1964c80abb5d4.png[/img]
Mastering the seas will be essential to your success in [i]Chronicles[/i]. As our story unfolds, you will need to conduct combined land and naval operations to seize coastal fortresses, rely on maritime trade to feed besieged cities, and force your enemies into submission through relentless naval artillery bombardments.

[hr][/hr]
[h3][i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] is available for pre-order now on Steam! Pre-order now for 15% off, and play on November 14th![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2805520/Age_of_Empires_II_DE__Chronicles_Battle_for_Greece/

[previewyoutube=3YEPy8yIiEY;full][/previewyoutube]
We are excited to announce the next DLC for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] – [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i], an immersive narrative expansion that transports players to the world of classical antiquity. [b]Coming November 14th[/b], [i]Chronicles[/i] builds upon classic gameplay with a reimagined visual experience and a focus on epic, character-focused storytelling.

The first chapter, [i]Battle for Greece[/i], introduces [b]three new civilizations[/b]: Achaemenids, Athenians, and Spartans – in a [b]21-scenario campaign[/b], brought to life through engaging [b]voice acting, animated cutscenes[/b], and much more!

We have been thrilled to work with CaptureAge to present [i]Battle for Greece[/i], the first installment of [i]Chronicles[/i]. This new epic narrative experience is a must-play for strategy lovers and history enthusiasts alike.
[hr][/hr]
[b][i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] is available for pre-order now on Steam! Coming November 14th![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2805520/Age_of_Empires_II_DE__Chronicles_Battle_for_Greece
[hr][/hr]

[h2]What is Chronicles?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/062c7247cf50f23ec63669d090e1964c80abb5d4.png[/img]
[quote][i]A sharp breeze surges across the Aegean. The dockyards of Athens thrum with activity, the air filled with the acrid smell of pitch, slathered across the hulls of a hundred waiting warships. In the mess halls of Sparta, wolf-eyed warriors slurp bitter black broth, their arms still aching from the day’s exercises. On the shores of the Hellespont, the Great King of Persia watches as a vast host assembles before him, drawn from a hundred different lands. The battle for Greece is about to begin.[/i][/quote]
Created by CaptureAge, a team of [i]Age of Empires[/i] veterans, [i]Chronicles[/i] is a series of DLCs set in the ancient world, taking the core gameplay and balance of [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] and then pushing it a step further by adding multiple new features inspired by the time period, along with a complete visual overhaul!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f83f681283dc9fed7a617014cafa7330810d35a3.jpg[/img]
The story of [i]Chronicles[/i] begins with [i]Battle for Greece[/i]. Spanning over a century of history from the Ionian Revolt, through the Greco-Persian Wars, to the end of the Peloponnesian Wars, the 21-scenario campaign contains some of history’s most famous and consequential battles, including Marathon, Thermopylae, and Salamis. Meet fascinating historical figures such as the ruthless Spartan admiral, Lysander, the wise statesman, Pericles, and the fearless warrior queen, Artemisia!

[h2]Included in this DLC[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/9da8be881f585e6a5f317e08e7a0b77426279d36.jpg[/img]
[i]Chronicles[/i] will also feature a complete naval overhaul with six types of military ships, new trading options with merchant ships, and a new gold resource which can be gathered at sea: Oysters! Plus, use special civilization mechanics, such as the ability to enact government policies and individually upgrade Town Centers to fine-tune the control over your empire. Innovative gameplay, including a unique naval combat system, and new technologies are all ready for you to explore and enjoy!
[list][*] [b]New graphical models:[/b] including 55 new land units, 19 new naval units, and 85 new buildings
[*] [b]A 21-scenario campaign covering over a century of history[/b]
[*] [b]A fresh approach to storytelling with animated cutscenes, new music, and voice acting[/b]
[*] [b]Three ancient civilizations:[/b] Achaemenids, Athenians and Spartans (not available in ranked play)
[*] [b]Overhaul of naval combat:[/b] with six military ship types, including ramming and catapult ships
[*] [b]Unique civilization mechanics:[/b] including customizable Town Centers and government policies
[*] … and much more![/list]
[h2]Achaemenids, Athenians, and Spartans NOT Available in Ranked Play[/h2]
[quote]The Achaemenids, Athenians, and Spartans will [b]NOT[/b] be available for Ranked Play. 
You can read more about this decision below.[/quote]
At its core, [i]Chronicles[/i] is a new series for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], dedicated to narrative and historical immersion, primarily with a single-player focus. To build upon this goal and explore additional possibilities, early in development we made the decision that the three new civilizations introduced with [i]Battle for Greece[/i] would [b]not[/b] be available in ranked gameplay.

Separating the three new civilizations from the standard balance pool has allowed us to develop fun and creative mechanics, a fresh take on the standard technology tree, and overhaul certain parts of the game such as naval gameplay. These options wouldn't have been possible and would not play in a balanced manner alongside the current [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] civilizations.

We've worked with our partners at CaptureAge who have a deep understanding and interest in the competitive scene - they've been supporting it since before the Definitive Editions released! We unanimously agreed with them that keeping these fresh and experimental civilizations separate from competitive play is the best option, for both our community members who want a unique and expanded single player experience, and those who enjoy well balanced competitive play.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]A Message From CaptureAge[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/29a4af146e1b352248225f375d98afafa0f7c4c2.jpg[/img]
[i]Chronicles[/i] is the first full release from CaptureAge! As a development studio, we've prided ourselves on providing top-quality spectator software across the [i]Age of Empires[/i] franchise. From a small team of fans, CaptureAge has grown into a studio packed with [i]Age of Empires[/i] community veterans, as well as AAA talent.

We’re passionate about this franchise, and wanted to create something that the community would love. Inspired by the popular Rome at War mod – whose creators are now part of the CaptureAge team – we chose the rich world of classical antiquity for our setting.

Campaigns have always been central to [i]Age of Empires[/i], and fans of the series continue to hunger for more. We therefore decided to make campaign content central to [i]Chronicles[/i] – and we’re approaching campaigns in our own unique way, with a strong narrative focus, a new presentation style, and an exciting variety of gameplay styles. Together, the [i]Chronicles[/i] DLCs will tell a unified story spanning the ancient world!

We can’t wait to share more details about [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] with you over the coming weeks. For all of us at CaptureAge, this project has been a labor of love, and we couldn’t be more excited for you to join us on this fresh, ambitious, creative new adventure.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]What's on the Horizon[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/930fe08d5bd0a22d6f747c694ea534a275560955.jpg[/img]
Hello [i]Age[/i] Community and welcome to the [i]Battle for Greece[/i]!

The road to today and the announcement of [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] - [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] has been a long time coming, and the unlikely path that led us here is worth an explanation. That’s because it’s not just a story about CaptureAge, but also YOU – the Community – and how the passion of players that love [i]Age of Empires[/i] can turn into some wild and unlikely adventures.

First let’s talk about CaptureAge. Here at World’s Edge, we started our relationship with CaptureAge several years ago, with a focus on getting their amazing spectator tool (also called CaptureAge) working for [i]AoE II: DE[/i]. That tiny project forged some new friendships and confidence, and led to exploring different ways that the CA team might be able to contribute to [i]AoE II: DE[/i] outside of what they were already known for. For many years now, they’ve been working rather silently on many small projects within the game, helping to deliver on new features and systems that have been part of the Updates you’ve been receiving over time. It’s been a wonderful collaboration and we’ve been genuinely delighted to watch them grow as a company – talented new people continue to join the CA team, and they’ve been able to express their passion for [i]Age of Empires[/i] in new and exciting ways.

But then, as any good story goes, we reached a point of once-upon-a-time when collectively many on the [i]AoE II: DE[/i] team took notice of Romae ad Bellum (Rome at War) – a promising mod being developed by a small group of people. Among the many things that caught our attention, they were doing beautiful work with building and unit design, and they were experimenting with gameplay in ways we felt were interesting. Eventually we connected with the Rome at War team to talk about their mod and their creative aspirations, and the vibe was the right one – we liked how they were thinking about [i]AoE II: DE[/i] gameplay in a different time period, and it got us thinking about whether or not there was a path to working with them as a content partner. There were big gaps in what they’d be able to take on, but they had the thing that mattered most – a love for [i]Age of Empires[/i] and enough passion to push through ambiguity and create something that people were talking about.

So now we have these two teams in the mix, mostly focused on very different things BUT… they both had the same ambition. They both wanted to be developing a true and ambitious content project. And they were both teams that originated in Community, made of people that played [i]AoE II: DE[/i] personally, passionately, and daily – and wanted to be doing something interesting and different for the game.

As time went on and conversations continued, what started to emerge was one of those exciting moments where stars align and the opportunity to do something really cool becomes real. With the help of World’s Edge, CaptureAge invited the Rome at War team to join them, and together they became the strongest version of CaptureAge yet – just in time to journey into their first DLC project culminating in today’s surprise for all of you. It was an ambitious and heart-felt effort to launch, because while [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] - [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] is definitely inspired by previous mod work from the team, this meant getting to work on a completely new DLC experience, authored entirely from scratch and built from the ground up, together with PhD Historians we added to the team and a desire to build a new type of experience players hadn’t quite seen before. They’ll have much more to say about that story in their own words over the weeks and months to come, but it’s worth highlighting here for a very specific reason.

[i]Age of Empires[/i] isn’t just a World’s Edge endeavor – it’s something that belongs to all of us, and it’s been as much a part of your life and story as it has been ours. The examples of Forgotten Empires and CaptureAge teams demonstrate that a vibrant path exists, and for those of you interested in making your mark on [i]Age[/i], we’re watching! We’re fans too and excited to see the things you create! From mods, to music, to cosplay, to fan art – all of it makes us smile because we think it’s as cool as you do! When people and teams pop up in our Community that we can find a way to work with, we’re thrilled! Our connection to our Community is what guides the work we do and the choices we make, and whenever we can grow those efforts by inviting our Community to join us in delivering on the future of these games, it’s a fit like no other! That’s a lot of exclamation marks but also a lot of truth. Not every gaming franchise is like this and the [i]Age of Empires[/i] Community stands out as a unique and positive place where this many years later people can still find opportunity in the things they love, and we think that’s pretty awesome.

So this is another encouragement for you to dream big and imagine possibilities. To pick up that editor and speak with your mods. Don’t be afraid of failure, don’t be afraid to get it wrong – it’s a supportive Community! People are there to give you feedback and you might even find others to join you in whatever quest you’ve created for yourself. Just go for it! Because you never know what will happen. You might just get spotted by a Dev, who tells a Producer, who tells a Business Manager, who sends an email, which starts a conversation, which leads to a blog, where we get to praise our Community for being full of amazing people that do amazing things. We genuinely feel that way.

Given the focus on Campaign content in [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i], alongside the fact that we [b]won’t[/b] be adding the new Civs (Achaemenids, Athenians, and Spartans) to Ranked, it seems important to mention that this [b]does not[/b] signal a departure from the types of DLC we’ve been delivering in the past that have been reliably adding new Civs for competitive play. In the case of [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i], we really wanted to try some unconventional things with gameplay, play around with the Tech Tree, and try some new things with Naval that weren’t going to harmonize with the balance in Ranked. So we make choices like this in order to (a) make room for that kind of creativity, (b) respect balance in Ranked, and (c) look for diversity in the types of content we can create for you. A little more about this, from a different angle –

What we’ve been doing with DLCs like [i]Animated Profile Icons[/i], [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i], and now [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i], is a bit of experimenting. The [i]AoE II: DE[/i] community is pretty big and spread out. Our most visible cohort tends to be our competitive community, tournament organizers, and streamers, but there’s a rather massive and understated majority of our players that show up week over week and month over month just to enjoy their favorite Campaigns. They love Campaign content exclusively, and they’re playing them over and over again – hard to blame them (that Attila Campaign, amiright???). There’s some Venn diagram overlap where many of you together are enjoying a lot of Skirmish matches, but the point is that it’s a big game with lots to do and therefore we’ve got many different interests to explore and service. It starts to become important for us to look for ways that we can push Campaign content and do new and interesting things, even if it means some variation in how we roll out a DLC (e.g. Civs not going into Ranked). So when we do something different like this, please don’t be alarmed – we’re just a happy tree growing new branches – the ones that have given you shade in times past are still there and we’ve got plenty of surprises waiting for you. Like, a lot. A lot a lot. Seriously. A lot a lot a lot.

[i]More to say about those surprises in the future![/i]

For now, it’s time to settle in for the Grand Campaign as [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] - [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i] presents an ALL-NEW experience, not available in any form anywhere else, crafted with love by CaptureAge, and ready to play in just a few weeks!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Pre-Order Chronicles: Battle for Greece Now![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/062c7247cf50f23ec63669d090e1964c80abb5d4.png[/img]
Conquer the ancient world with the inaugural chapter of [i]Chronicles: Battle for Greece[/i]! Claim victory across the entirely new 21 scenarios of the Grand Campaign. Experience new graphical models including 55 new land units, 19 new naval units, and 85 new buildings, and master three new civilizations - Achaemenids, Athenians and Spartans.

[i][b]Chronicles: Battle for Greece is now available for pre-order on Steam, Microsoft Store, and Xbox, releasing November 14th![/b][/i]

While there are plenty of notable things to look forward to in tomorrow’s build, here’s some of the big highlights coming with this update:[list][*] 1v1 Empire Wars is available again, replacing the Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado ladder.
[*] Several changes and fixes on [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i] scenarios.
[*] New QoL changes.
[*] Bug fixes based on your feedback.
[*] Balance changes.[/list]Be sure to dig down into the post below to get all of the smaller details before hopping in-game and checking them out firsthand.

[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team
[hr][/hr][code][h1]        ◆ Update 125283 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[quote][h1][b]Game[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1db5c65a88bbfe0c20e6ed2d39eb75f446dc5dc4.png[/img]

[h3]Stability & Performance[/h3]
[list][*] The game will no longer momentarily display a black screen on lower spec machines while switching between Age of Empires II and Return of Rome modes.
[*] Fixed an issue where a black screen softlock could be encountered when restoring a save file of a custom campaign.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would freeze in certain situations (was encountered mostly when playing custom scenarios).
[*] Fixed a crash which could occur when targeting movable objects on impassable tiles.[/list]
[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list][*] Bamboo tree graphics (including felled and stumps) are no longer reduced by Small Trees option.[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list][*] Menu narrator no longer plays if the window is out of focus.[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list][*] Bridges are now displayed on the minimap with the same color as shallows terrain.
[*] Corrected the 4v4 map size given in the Ranked Team Queue menu from “normal” to “large”.
[*] Civilization Selection
[list][*] The civilization selection dialog sports a new look! The new design includes the ability to mark civilizations as starred. On Console, the dialog now also uses a grid instead of a carousel, making it easier to select any civilization.
[*]Added the Custom civilization selection mode, which chooses randomly from starred civilizations.[/list][*] Fixed an issue where the game language was resetting to the system language at the game launch.[/list][h3]Hotkeys[/h3]
[list][*] Changed the default Drop Off Resources hotkey for HD preset from A to Z, preventing the conflict with Economic Buildings hotkey.
[*] In [i]Return of Rome[/i], changed the default Cancel build hotkey in HD hotkey preset to unassigned.[/list]
[h3]Xbox[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where the mouse could not be used in the settings menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where hotkeys could not be set via the mouse.
[*] Fixed an oversight where Fortified Churches were excluded from the “All Back to Work” button.
[*] Fixed an issue where 2013 Xbox One consoles were unintentionally able to join 3v3 and 4v4 ranked queues.
[*] Fixed an issue where Voice Chat to Text setting couldn’t be enabled without a game restart.
[*] The game no longer crashes on the load screen during the Launch Chunk while in ‘Ready to Play’ state of the install.[/list]
[/quote]
[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

notes.title: Announcing Our New Public Esports Tournament Calendar!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/51cb7fa0dfefbcd1987efd427bab1639b91e0647.jpg[/img]
We’re thrilled to announce a new and exciting feature for our community—starting today, the [i]Public Esports Tournament Calendar[/i] is live! Whether you’re a competitor or a fan, this calendar is your place for staying up to date with every exciting event in our competitive gaming scene.

Access the [i]Public Esports Tournament Calendar[/i] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/eventscalendar]here[/url]!

[h2]Why We’re Introducing the Public Tournament Calendar[/h2]
As the esports scene continues to grow, we’ve noticed the demand for a centralized place where all tournament schedules are readily available and shared well in advance. We understand that keeping track of multiple events across multiple platforms can be overwhelming.

That’s why we’re making it easier for everyone to stay in the loop – whether you’re a seasoned pro or a dedicated fan.

[h2]What does the calendar include?[/h2]
The calendar will include World’s Edge sponsored tournaments for:
[list][*] [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i][/list]
Be aware that some of the information displayed in the [i]Public Esports Tournament Calendar[/i] is incomplete right now, to let the tournament host share more information with you at their own pace. All of the information displays what we can share at this moment and is [u][b]subject to change[/b][/u].

[h2]Stay Connected![/h2]
With the launch of this new feature, we’re taking another step towards fostering a more connected and informed esports community. Whether you’re a competitor looking to plan your next big challenge or a fan eager to follow your favorite player or teams, this calendar will be your go-to source for all things esports.

We’re incredibly excited to roll this out and make esports even more accessible. Stay tuned for further updates and new features that will make following and participating in the esports scene easier than ever!

See you at the tournaments!
[hr][/hr]

Want a glimpse into all the upcoming World’s Edge sponsored esports tournaments? Have a look at the the [i]Public Esports Tournament Calendar[/i]!

notes.title: Temporary Reset of Empire Wars 1v1 Ladder During Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/adc89793636c4aa0ce245072971fcdb4153356b2.png[/img]
The 1v1 ranked ladder for Empire Wars will be temporarily shelved and replaced by a new 1v1 ranked ladder for the upcoming Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado tournament. This is a new ladder that levels the playing field as you compete for ELO and opportunity. The map pool is also being updated to the Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado tournament maps, providing the pool with a welcome refresh.

Fear not, however; some time after the tournament has concluded, the prior Empire Wars ladder will be restored and existing ratings and leaderboards will return to the state they were in before this swap-out. 

The Team Game ladder will also receive an update to the map pool, but the TG ladder is not associated with the tournament – only the 1v1 ladder. This means that your Empire Wars Team Game rating and statistics will remain unchanged during this period.

[h3]Why is the ladder being temporarily reset?[/h3]
The new ladder is being used as part of the upcoming Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado tournament as a method to qualify for the event. In order to ensure an even playing field for all competitors, the leader board has to be temporarily reset. [u][b]The four with the highest Elo rating achieved on the leaderboard by the 28th of July will be directly invited to the Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado event taking place at the Castillo de Almodóvar del Río in Spain.[/b][/u]

[h3]How does this affect you?[/h3]
Your experience will remain the same; however, you may find that your 1v1 rating will require a few games before it settles. With this change, you will be able to experience what it’s like to play on the settings and maps of one of the biggest tournaments for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. The ladder holds no restrictions, anyone is free to play on the ladder whether they intend to participate in the tournament or not.

Please be aware, there is a Controller Only ladder visible for Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado for those playing on Xbox. However, this ladder will not be eligible for qualification. Remember to enable crossplay, as qualification will only be available to those on the cross-play enabled ladder.

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/red-bull-wololo-is-back-in-2024/]Click for more information[/url] on the tournament.

[quote][h1][b]Build Spotlight[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/64018b57495ffdba99eecd98f0d6c9445638b284.png[/img]

[h3]Temporary Reset of Empire Wars 1v1 Ladder During Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado[/h3]

The 1v1 ranked ladder for Empire Wars will be temporarily shelved and replaced by a new 1v1 ranked ladder for the upcoming [b]Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado[/b] tournament. This is a new ladder that levels the playing field as you compete for ELO and opportunity. The map pool is also being updated to the Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado tournament maps, providing the pool with a welcome refresh.

Fear not, however; some time after the tournament has concluded, the prior EW ladder will be restored, and existing ratings and leaderboards will return in the state they were in before this swap-out.

The Team Game ladder will also receive an update to the map pool, but the TG ladder is not associated with the tournament – only the 1v1 is. This means that your Empire Wars Team Game rating and statistics will remain unchanged during this period.

[b]Why is the ladder being temporarily reset?[/b]
The new ladder is being used as part of the upcoming Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado tournament as a method to qualify for the event. In order to ensure an even playing field for all competitors, the leader board has to be temporarily reset. The four with the highest Elo rating achieved on the leaderboard by the 28th of July will be directly invited to the Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado event taking place at the Castillo de Almodóvar del Río in Spain.

[b]How does this affect you?[/b]
Your experience will remain the same; however, you may find that your 1v1 rating will require a few games before it settles. With this change, you will be able to experience what it’s like to play on the settings and maps of one of the biggest tournaments for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. The ladder holds no restrictions, anyone is free to play on the ladder whether they intend to participate in the tournament or not.

Please be aware, there is a Controller Only ladder visible for Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado for those playing on Xbox. However, this ladder will not be eligible for qualification. Remember to enable crossplay, as qualification will only be available to those on the cross-play enabled ladder.

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Update 107882
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/399b35e79390782483f0eb97fc5e869ae51ecf46.jpg[/img]
Welcome to an exciting update for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]! [b]Tomorrow, March 14th[/b], the new [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i] DLC it will officially be available to play - featuring nineteen epic scenarios. Play as Ragnar Lothbrok, Oda Nobunaga, Charlemagne, and more. Plus, now all previously event-exclusive cheat codes are now available to all players, and a new cheat code has also been added!

While there are plenty of notable things to look forward to in today’s build, here’s some of the big highlights coming with this month’s update:
[list][*] New QoL Features:
[list][*] Regrouping improvement: Units in line formation will only regroup into a column after a move or attack move command of more than 30 tiles, instead of 10 tiles previously. Patrol command keeps its previous behavior of always forming a column, regardless of distance.
[*] Military units now evenly spread themselves into nearby siege equipment or transports.
[*] Added a “Drop Off” command to villagers to automatically force-drop and return to work right away.
[*] Added a “Seek Shelter” command for villagers.
[*] Added an “All Back to Work” command to garrisonable buildings.[/list][*] Bug fixes based on your feedback
[*] Balance changes[/list]Be sure to dig down into the post below to get all of the smaller details before hopping in-game and checking them out firsthand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1db5c65a88bbfe0c20e6ed2d39eb75f446dc5dc4.png[/img]
[quote]
[h2]Stability & Performance[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed a crash which could occur when loading a saved scenario game.
[*] Fixed a desync that can occasionally occur with ranged unit animations on different framerates.
[*] Fixed a crash which would occur when a player joins a lobby and the host adds an AI.[/list]
[h2]Graphics[/h2]
[list][*] Fish Traps now display outlines when visually obstructed by buildings.[/list]
[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list][*] The correct music track now plays for Romans, Armenians and Georgians when having them selected in History section.
[*] Horse and Hunnic Horse move sounds no longer play at the edge of the map.
[*] Background music now correctly loops in Return of Rome campaign menu.
[*] After purchasing a DLC from the Store, its campaign audio will now correctly load without having to reboot the game.[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list][*] Updated the checkbox graphics for main and secondary objectives.
[*] The availability/upgrade level bars in technology tree preview now have more distinguishable colors.
[*] Relics no longer have armor display on their UI with Extended Unit Stats enabled.
[*] Javelina in Return of Rome now has correct icon.
[*] Pending Invitations screen no longer displays ‘Create Warrior Priest’ text instead of ‘Name’.
[*] The HUD will no longer display units garrisoned in transports if many land units are simultaneously selected.
[*] The names of map size options now display their base dimension.[/list]
[h2]Hotkeys[/h2]
[list][*] Ungarrison hotkey now consistently works for Rams when having several garrisoned and ungarrisoned Rams selected together.
[*] Convert hotkey for military units now functions correctly.[/list]
[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
[list][*] The match will no longer terminate for all players when one player in a game with more than two players goes out of sync – only the desynced player will be dropped.
[*] Fixed an issue where it was possible to pause the game endlessly in Multiplayer, instead of being limited to 10 pauses.[/list]
[h2]Xbox[/h2]
[list][*] Changed UI Crossplay checkbox to be un-interactable if the cross-network play is blocked in the Xbox privacy settings.
[*] Create lobby submenu now shouldn’t remain open if the player is disconnected after hosting game and before lobby browser is opened.
[*] When the Minimap Camera Lock Behavior is set to Fast Pan the [Y] display button on the minimap is no longer shown.
[*] The [Y] Quick Command does no longer appear when you try to build, but cannot afford a Lumber Camp using the site based radial menu.
[*] Conversion related warning messages about Atonement and Redemption are now shown in the notification area on the left on Xbox.
[*] Fortified Church is now shown correctly as age-up requirement for Armenians and Georgians in the Xbox version when using a controller.
[*] University now has the correct icon in the age-up requirement display.
[*] The Set Gather Point command is no longer shown in the Donjon’s radial menu on Xbox when using a controller.
[*] Buildings can now be commanded to attack enemy buildings.
[*] Fixed an issue on Xbox where “ Treason” was not available in the Castle’s radial menu in the Regicide game mode.
[*] Fixed an issue on Xbox where the [LT] button icon was not shown at the bottom of the Spectator Mode section in the Help Index.
[*] Fixed an issue where setting a hotkey for Delete Unit command wasn’t working correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue on Xbox where the game would crash when trying to select a “Granary”-object with Extended Unit Stats turned on.
[*] Fixed an issue on Xbox where players could bypass the pause limit on multiplayer matches.[/list][/quote][/quote]

notes.title: Ramsey Abdulrahim Talks Inspiration Behind Newest DLC for AoE II: DE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/8eb5c77152834f26dc4408f7c68a7e232fa45ae2.jpg[/img]
If you missed it, we recently announced the next DLC for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition: Victors and Vanquished[/i]! [b]Coming March 14th[/b], the newest DLC will feature 14 UGC-inspired and fully-updated, polished, and supported scenarios plus 5 exclusive all-new scenarios. Each scenario has been updated with full, professional voice acting, music, rebalancing, bugfixes, achievements, and quality of life improvements.

Recently, Ramsey Abdulrahim, Senior Business Manager at World's Edge who you may know better in the community by the username 'Filthydelphia', talked about the inspiration and history behind [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i].
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Pre-Order Now with 15% Off![/h1]
[i]Victors and Vanquished[/i] is available for pre-order now with a [b]15% discount[/b] on Steam. [b]Coming March 14th![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2805510/Age_of_Empires_II_Definitive_Edition__Victors_and_Vanquished/?beta=1

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Message From Ramsey Abdulrahim[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/943c44382743aa1c37f07abac514120b70492db3.png[/img]
First, thank you for the love and support I’ve received from so many members of the [i]Age[/i] community. I am thrilled and grateful that so many of you have enjoyed my campaigns, official or custom. So many of you have told me you’ve learned and been inspired by the histories in these scenarios.

I have been playing and designing custom campaigns for [i]Age of Empires[/i] since 1998—when I was only 13 years old! In 2015, I had the opportunity of a lifetime to join Forgotten Empires as a campaign designer for [i]The African Kingdoms[/i] expansion. For the next six years, I worked on campaigns alongside the amazing people at Forgotten Empires and World’s Edge for [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i], [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], and [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i]. Needless to say, 13-year-old me would have thought this was the coolest thing ever!

I hope that my latest project, [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i], will help introduce even more players to these incredible historical stories. I wanted to highlight two of the scenarios you will be able to play!

[h3]How Did You Seize Power in Medieval France?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/42509dd0c6451db35459c1bda0ac5520827c9065.png[/img]
We tend to associate kings with absolute power, but kingship in the early Middle Ages was much more nuanced. Successful kings had to maintain support from their nobles, and weak kings were challenged and sometimes even replaced. Notably, two French kings were deposed by two brothers, Odo and Robert, who seized power separately in 888 and 922 CE.

In [i]Robert (921)[/i], you decide how you will seize power. Assaulting Paris is direct, but the other nobles will come to their king’s aid. Better to win their support first—or at least the support of the ones who fit into your grand strategy.

Each noble is unique. Arnulf, Count of Flanders, despises Rollo and his Normans. War against Rollo would drum up Arnulf’s support. On the other hand, the pious Guillaume of Aquitaine has just finished building the famous Benedictine abbey at Cluney. Demonstrating your piety by collecting Relics will win his favor. Though you can also attack Guillaume, take his Relics for yourself, and turn his enemy, Garcia of Gascony, into your most fervent supporter. Alternatively, if catering to the complicated whims of counts and dukes is not your style, you could simply bribe whoever fits into your plans.

These counts and dukes are not passive, either - they also jockey for power. Over time, their houses will form marriage alliances for mutual protection. Your preparations to invade Burgundy could be upset by an ill-timed Burgundian marriage with Normandy. Even worse, Normandy may have an alliance with Aquitaine, potentially bringing all three into a coalition against you the moment you attack Burgundy. But, all hope is not lost! If you can first win Norman support—through generous bribes or demonstrating your military strength with a large army—the coalition will disentangle and put your plans back on schedule.

You will be king, after all—it’s just a matter of how. In [i]Robert (921)[/i], nothing will stop you.

[h3]How Did You Reach the Americas from Viking Europe?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e6d3e829416e9a43082aaa7c52da23470dbab505.png[/img]
Around 1000 CE, a Norse settler named Thorfinn Karlsefni reached Newfoundland in eastern Canada, a place the Vikings called Vinland. He followed in the footsteps of Leif Ericson and others who had ventured from Scandinavia to Iceland, Greenland, and the Americas. Sailing in boats no more than 16 meters (53 feet) long and open to the elements, Norse families crossed the cold, northern Atlantic to find new homes in the west.

In [i]Karlsefni (1000)[/i], you will make this unlikely and incredible journey. Your ships will not survive long on the open sea, so every crossing is perilous. Be thoughtful in deciding who and what you bring. Make the most of the resources you find along your journey. Food is scarce but a lack of wood will end your settlement. The search for wood will take you further and further west. And when you reach the west, you will encounter a culture very different from your own.

[i]Karlsefni (1000)[/i] is not your typical Age of Empires scenario. The scale of your settlement—in houses, people, and ships—is very small, but the map is massive. Every decision has consequences as you puzzle out how to survive in a harsh and unwelcoming landscape. If you overcome these challenges, you will have found new homes for your Viking families.

In [i]Karlsefni (1000)[/i], venture into the dangerous unknown and discover a whole new world.

[i]Robert (921)[/i] and [i]Karlsefni (1000)[/i] are only two of the 19 unique scenarios you can play in [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i]. From migrating across the dying Roman Empire to boarding Spanish galleons in the Caribbean, each scenario features immersive mechanics that bring the histories to life.

[h2]The Siege – Coming Soon![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/3cf9b526b68404907bc9c4bf422d203be2d7a517.jpg[/img]
On top of the release of [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i], Ramsey has also prepared an additional scenario in a similar vein to [i]Barbarossa Brawl[/i] and will be available to all [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] owners. [i]The Siege[/i] is a new multiplayer limited-time scenario. You will be able to play 2v2, co-op vs AI, or solo vs AI as the Turks or Byzantines at the epic 1453 Siege of Constantinople!

[i]The Siege[/i] will be available for a limited time, coming soon. However, you can get an early preview right now in the Public Update Preview on Steam!

[h1]Pre-Order Now with 15% Off![/h1]
[i]Victors and Vanquished[/i] is available for pre-order now with a [b]15% discount[/b] on Steam. [b]Coming March 14th![/b]

notes.title: New Year, New Age Show – the Rundown
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/5db528d48be80a0b766b4ac2be96d2f12325a90d.jpg[/img]
We on the [i]Age of Empires[/i] team want to say a huge thank you to our 50 million players around the world. 2023 was a huge year for our games and our community. We wanted to share a look at what there is to look forward to in 2024, and we’ve just wrapped our New Year, New Age show which did just that. If you watched, thank you for joining us! If you weren’t able to join us live, or you just want a reminder of all the things we covered, here’s a rundown of what’s coming this year.

[list][*] [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] new DLC – Victors and Vanquished – coming March 14th
[*] [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] coming to Xbox and PC in 2024
[*] [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i] first look
[*] New Year, New Age Sale with games and DLC up to 50% off
[*] [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] update and Season 7 coming early Spring
[*] New Year, New Age login reward for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] available now
[*] [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i] free to play now! New DLC coming end of 2024
[*] Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado coming later this year[/list]
[h1]New DLC for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/h1]
[h3][i]Victors and Vanquished coming March 14th: Pre-Order Now![/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/6d19fed5f4ec0e08e3add9da58270ee59e884d6d.jpg[/img]
[i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] had a landmark year in 2023 with the addition of the [i]Return of Rome[/i] and [i]The Mountain Royals[/i] expansions. More than four years after launch, the game continues to grow. Telling more stories from the world’s rich history as well as bringing more civilizations to play.

The next chapter for [i]Age of Empires II: DE[/i] will be the single player focused DLC [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i], [b]coming March 14th[/b]. Introduced in today’s show by its Creator, Ramsey Abdulrahim, this DLC will be like no other we’ve made before for [i]AoE II: DE[/i]. [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i] features 19 epic scenarios. Your strategy and choices will decide your fate: will you emerge as the ultimate victor, or fall as the vanquished? You’ll play as Ragnar Lothbrok, Oda Nobunaga, Charlemagne and more. Each scenario features professional voice acting, new music, achievement and the quality you’d expect from an official [i]Age of Empires[/i] scenario. 

[b]Pre-Order Now![/b]
[i]Victors and Vanquished[/i] will be launching soon, and you can pre-order today and receive a 15% discount! [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i] [b]comes to Steam on March 14th 2024[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2805510/Age_of_Empires_II_Definitive_Edition__Victors_and_Vanquished/?beta=1

[previewyoutube=2E721-vptOo;full]https://youtu.be/2E721-vptOo[/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Age of Mythology: Retold[/h1]
[h3]Coming to Xbox and PC in 2024 – Wishlist Now![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/7213894171ecbe692cda8392aa8f18e08ccabc14.png[/img]
[i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] is another title that got its debut at our 25th anniversary. Since then, we’ve continued to develop this exciting reimagining of fan favorite [i]Age of Mythology[/i].

Today Art Director Melinda Rose gave players worldwide their first look at [i]Retold[/i] via three in-game units, brought to life through amazing AR technology. Showcasing Medusa, Pegasus and Cerberus from the Greek pantheon, Melinda took us through how each unit has been updated, given completely new art and even had gameplay tweaks that will intensify their strengths and unique powers making them even more important in your strategy. They will be stronger, faster, bigger and bolder.

We are also beyond thrilled to announce that players do not have long to wait. [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] is coming to Steam in 2024 and is available to wishlist now!

If you want more information about what we showed today, be sure to follow the [i]Age of Mythology[/i] social channels and visit [url=http://www.ageofempires.com/]www.ageofempires.com[/url].

[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100086916204891][i]Age of Mythology[/i] on Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/ageofmythgame][i]Age of Mythology[/i] on Instagram[/url][/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934680/Age_of_Mythology_Retold/?beta=1

[previewyoutube=yj_I0fc3lrI;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Age of Empires Mobile[/h1]
[h3]The first look at a brand new [i]AoE[/i] world[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/04e81076b1fbfe05cba29e08b4d0ca5379d88ad4.png[/img]
At our 25th anniversary event we announced [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i] and we’ve been getting questions from intrigued and excited players ever since.

Today we’re so excited to unveil this partnership with the fantastic team at TiMi Studio Group, who are bringing this brand-new [i]Age of Empires[/i] world to life. [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i] is a mobile war strategy game where players will embark on an exhilarating adventure and forge unbreakable bonds with friends. Featuring rich real-time controls, stunning visuals and historical heroes on grand battlefields, this addition to the franchise has so much to offer.

The game features elements from [i]Age of Empires[/i] games, merged with brand-new and mobile-specific gameplay. You’ll engage in strategic resource management, develop unique technologies and train diverse armies to build and defend your kingdom.

In the New Year New Age show, we premiered the first gameplay trailer for [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i] as well as a behind the scenes look with the team at TiMi Studio Group.

You can pre-register now for [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i] on iOS and Google Play. For more information about the game, visit [url=http://www.aoemobile.com/]www.aoemobile.com[/url].

[previewyoutube=oPj3AzXpQbQ;full]https://youtu.be/oPj3AzXpQbQ[/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=LzqFAS47M8s;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]New Year, New Age Sale Now![/h1]
[h3]Celebrating 50 Million Players, Get Up to 50% Off Now![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/fff1fa9e9269ebf3082faeb66b64b2a6eb836568.jpg[/img]
With such a fantastic roster of titles, there’s never been a better time to complete your [i]Age of Empires[/i] collection! We’re celebrating our 50 million players with a New Year, New Age Sale on Steam! From today until the 29th of February, almost everything in the [i]Age of Empires[/i] catalogue is up to 50% off. Go on, treat yourself.
[hr][/hr]
[h1]New For Age of Empires IV[/h1]
[h3]Next [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] update and season coming soon, plus a limited time login reward[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/0cf565c8df3e9871b965f5c74b4114ab476c741d.png[/img]
In November, we launched the best-selling [i]Age of Empires[/i] expansion of all time, [i]The Sultans Ascend[/i], for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]. We’re so thrilled to see players enjoying the content, which included two new civs, four variant civs, and all new campaign, ten new maps and two new biomes.

If you haven’t yet experienced [i]The Sultans Ascend[/i], it’s available now! Buy now and receive a 10% discount for a limited time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959430/Age_of_Empires_IV__The_Sultans_Ascend/

Today we announced that [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] will receive its next major update. Coming in early Spring, it will also mark the launch of Season 7.

As an added thank you to our players, if you log in to the game now, you’ll be able to earn a limited time New Year, New Age reward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/b9c838ece568d150cb4782e17d2f61f66964d93b.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado[/h1]
[h3]Happening this year![/h3]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/4887141f8219f1079c00721f8b413be19730980a.png[/img][/td][td]The [i]Age of Empires[/i] eSports scene continues to flourish, and we couldn’t be more grateful to the tournament organizers, players and supporters who continue to create exciting events, mesmerizing moments and valiant victories year in, year out.[/td][/tr][/table]
Our partners and friends at Red Bull gave us the great honor today to announce that their next [i]Age of Empires[/i] event, Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado will be coming in 2024!

Whilst we’re not ready to share the details just yet, we recommend subscribing to [i]Age of Empires[/i] and Red Bull Gaming channels to be sure you don’t miss information when we share it in the not-too-distant future.
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/h1]
[h3]New DLC coming late 2024[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/baa9dcf2f46f65d6048e004bbe9db4d69b68a687.png[/img]
One final announcement for the show was that we’ll be bringing [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i] players another DLC at the end of 2024!

Whilst we can’t spill all of the details at this point, Director of Production Earnest Yuen was able to sneak in a couple of spoilers…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f36b4565d19604946667fdf1ba2eb4c12df37b29.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Thank you for a Fantastic 2023![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/175fceb1ee0d967f0b39d06cf3cc50948d176ac2.png[/img]
In 2023 [i]Age of Empires[/i]:
[list][*] Launched two titles on Xbox consoles and cloud
[*] Released the best-selling [i]Age of Empires[/i] expansion of all time, [i]The Sultans Ascend[/i] for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]
[*] Released the two fastest selling [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] DLC ever, [i]Return of Rome[/i] and [i]The Mountain Royals[/i]
[*] Managed 51 game updates
[*] Our players performed 200 million Wololos, built 350 million castles and employed 1.5 billion valiant scout sheep[/list]It was truly the biggest year for [i]Age of Empires[/i] yet! Thank you to over 50 million players worldwide who have joined us on our journey so far.

We have so much lined up for 2024 and can’t wait to bring you along with us.

[previewyoutube=FqPOlAJC3sQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
That’s the rundown of the show! Head to the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ageofempires][i]Age of Empires[/i] YouTube channel[/url] if you want to rewatch any of what we showed today.

A heartfelt thank you to each and every one who’s played [i]Age of Empires[/i] so far. It’s your love and passion that has kept this franchise going for the last 26 years and we can’t wait for these new chapters in our epic story in 2024.

notes.title: New Year, New Age Livestream Coming February 23rd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/6d8428c32661f365537c177c520b8085bb02cf56.jpg[/img]
It’s a new year and a time to reset, reflect and think about what the next few months has in store. 
 
Here on the [i]Age of Empires[/i] team, we’ve got a LOT lined up for 2024. Instead of trying to summarize it in a lengthy blog post, we decided to make a show of it! We’re excited to announce the “New Year, New Age” [b]livestream[/b] on [b]February 23rd at 10:00 am PT (1:00 pm ET / 18:00 UTC).[/b] 

With so much to come in 2024, we want to show our players around the world what to expect from the Age of Empires franchise this year. We’ll be revealing more information on some of our most anticipated titles for 2024 – so expect to see a sneak peek of [i][b]Age of Mythology: Retold[/b][/i] and a first look at [i][b]Age of Empires Mobile[/b][/i]. If you’re eager to know what’s next for our games already in your library, don’t worry, we’ll have updates for those titles too. 
[list]
[*] [i][b]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition:[/b][/i] We’ll reveal a brand-new campaign-focused expansion and an extended look at exclusive gameplay. 
[*] [i][b]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition:[/b][/i] After giving our players a new way to play for free in 2023, we are excited to reveal a new DLC with new civilizations.  
[*] [i][b]Age of Empires IV:[/b][/i] Coming off our best-selling expansion ever with The Sultans Ascend, we will share updates on an upcoming brand-new season and a new in-game reward. 
[*] [i][b]Age of Empires Mobile:[/b][/i] TiMi Studio Group, the award-winning developer, will share a first-time look at gameplay and give us a behind the scenes look into their studio. The team will share their passion for Age of Empires and their vision to bring the franchise to new and existing fans alike.  
[*] [i][b]Age of Mythology: Retold:[/b][/i] The team will take us behind the curtain in the studio to show how they are developing this beloved game for a new, modern experience. Fans can expect a unique unveiling of a few mythological creatures that you won’t want to miss. 
[/list]Lastly, making a return appearance after hosting our 25th anniversary show, Welyn, will be streaming the event on his Twitch channel. He’ll give his expert impressions and reactions to all the news, reveals, teases and gameplay.   

Mark your calendars for [b]February 23rd at 10:00 am PT[/b] to watch on the channels listed below: 
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/welyn]Welyn’s Twitch[/url]  
[*] [url=http://www.twitch.tv/ageofempires]Age of Empires Twitch [/url]
[*] [url=http://www.youtube.com/ageofempires]Age of Empires YouTube[/url] 
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/AgeOfEmpires]Age of Empires Steam Page [/url]
[*] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/]Age of Empires.com [/url]
[/list] We’re so grateful to get to spend another year bringing established and new players all over the world more [i]Age of Empires[/i] content. We hope you’ll join us at New Year, New Age as we take a look at what’s to come. 

Stay tuned to [i]Age of Empires[/i] channels for more details about the show over the next coming weeks.  

See you there! 

For more [i]Age of Empires[/i] information, visit [url=www.ageofempires.com ]www.ageofempires.com [/url]

notes.title: More Campaigns Now Available in Return of Rome
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/8921a8724bf316e68b51230a88b4f289d300bf0b.jpg[/img]
A previous update to [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] brought with it two additional campaigns for owners of the [i]Return of Rome[/i] DLC! Both of the campaigns selected by community vote; [i]Glory of Greece[/i] and [i]Voices of Babylon[/i] are now available for you to play and enjoy.

You can access the new campaigns by transitioning your game into [i]Return of Rome[/i], then navigating to Single Player and selecting the Campaigns option. From here, select the new ‘[i]Return of Rome[/i]‘ tab on the side of the campaign menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f2f7d9638690bed2c39f8b20321607b7c31e670f.png[/img]
You can read more details about the [i]Glory of Greece[/i] and [i]Voices of Babylon[/i] campaigns below!

[h3]All Campaigns Available in [i]Return of Rome[/i][/h3]
[list][*] Ascent of Egypt
[*] Trajan
[*] Pyrrhus of Epirus
[*] Sargon of Akkad
[*] The First Punic War
[*] [b]Glory of Greece (NEW!)[/b]
[*] [b]Voices of Babylon (NEW!)[/b][/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141580/Age_of_Empires_II_Definitive_Edition__Return_of_Rome/
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Glory of Greece[/h2]
Battle to establish the Greek Empire and create history as one of the world’s mightiest empires across 8 scenarios in the [i]Glory of Greece[/i] campaign. Set out and earn the reputation of the Greek Empire, take command of the mighty armies of Alexander the Great, and topple the walls of Troy during the Trojan war!
[quote]Follow the Greeks from their Bronze Age beginnings to the height of the Hellenic era. Step into the sandals of famous Greek heroes like Achilles, Pericles, Xenophon, and Alexander the Great to build a civilization spanning the ancient world from the Mediterranean to India.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f72d15969ccfd285c0018f19f011ab915afafab4.jpg[/img]
[h3]Glory of Greece Scenarios[/h3]
[quote][i]“War! The rivalry between Hellas and Persia has reignited after the irruption of the Macedonians into the region, and the Greeks have been united under you, Alexander of Macedon.”[/i][/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f35e17a3710f61fe5be12c39e30cef123cc7fafc.jpg[/img]

[*] Acropolis
[*] The Conquest of Crete
[*] The Trojan War
[*] Colonization of Ionia
[*] The Siege of Athens
[*] Xenophon’s March
[*] Alexander the Great[/olist][/expand]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Voices of Babylon[/h2]
Guide Babylon to power through her struggles, and onto greatness throughout 8 scenarios in the [i]Voices of Babylon[/i] campaign. Persuade the neighboring fledgling empires to join you, through persuasion or conquest when necessary. Defend the frontier cities from raiders, and liberate Babylon from the oppression of Assyrian invaders!
[quote]For centuries, Babylon was the envy of the world. Her Hanging Gardens and eminent ziggurats inspired legends that echoed throughout the ages. Her greatest king, Hammurabi, gave the world its first law code. Lead this majestic city from its remarkable rise to its staggering fall, and restore it once again to greatness.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/75646ba1d31142373e31649aa82f2ac7c1e0b1ac.jpg[/img]
[h3]Voices of Babylon Scenarios[/h3]
[quote][i]“An Assyrian General named Tiglath-Pileser has rebelled against his king and has taken the throne. He is willing to support our new King Nabonassar to retake land lost to the Aramaeans, our common enemy.”[/i][/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/526e54edfd5cb0544aec08f26a533c735da81562.jpg[/img]
[h3]=> Scenario List Here[/h3]
[expand type=details][olist][*] The Holy Man

[*] Lost
[*] I Shall Return
[*] The Great Hunt
[*] The Caravan
[*] Lord of the Euphrates
[*] The Conquest of Nineveh[/olist][/expand]
[hr][/hr]
We hope you enjoy the addition of the [i]Glory of Greece[/i] and [i]Voices of Babylon[/i] campaigns to [i]Return of Rome[/i]!

Welcome to an exciting sneak peek for the newest update for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]! The update will be [b]landing tomorrow, October 31st[/b]! This will be a huge one with pathfinding improvements, balance changes, bug fixes, and more, PLUS tomorrow [i]The Mountain Royals[/i] DLC will be live, AND new campaigns are coming to [i]Return of Rome[/i]!

While there are plenty of notable fixes and features to look forward to in today’s build, here’s some of the big highlights coming with this month’s update:
[list][*] The Mountain Royals DLC is now available!
[*] 2 New Campaigns in Return of Rome:
[list][*] Glory of Greece
[*] Voices of Babylon[/list]
[*] Balance changes!
[*] Pathfinding improvements!
[*] Bug fixes based on your feedback![/list]

Be sure to dig down into the post below to get all of the smaller details before hopping in-game and checking them out firsthand.

[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/preview-age-of-empires-ii-definitive-edition-update-95810/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e0c0552e7cd0baf003bee7b6aa3e7b974956b776.png[/img][/url][/quote]
[quote]💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-ii/] Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires] The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Thanks again to our amazing community members, all of whom have helped to make [i]Age of Empires[/i] what it is today!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[hr][/hr][code][h1]         ◆ UPDATE 95810◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/64018b57495ffdba99eecd98f0d6c9445638b284.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/0cde5878ce28a6f0ac027cd9bbc6a6e4704096b7.png[/img]

[h2][b]Game[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1db5c65a88bbfe0c20e6ed2d39eb75f446dc5dc4.png[/img]
[h3]Stability & Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where game crashes when creating a lobby using Restore Multiplayer Game.
[*] Fixed an issue where game sometimes crashes when clicking the Return of Rome Multiplayer button.
[/list]

[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a graphical issue where various Palm Trees have black sections in their textures.
[*] Fixed the issues with death and decay animations for Slinger, Man-at-Arms, Female Forager.
[*] Imperial Camel saddle cloth texture no is no longer incorrect on one of the angles.
[*] Magyar Huszar spear is no longer slightly cut off on several unit animations.
[*] Fixed a graphical issue where Chariot Archer had doubled bow.
[*] Male Woodcutters no longer lack idle animations on all except one angle.
[*] Babylonian Wonder destruction animation no longer turns invisible close to the end.
[*] Added visual trails to bullet projectiles.
[/list]

[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Priest has the wrong creation sound.
[*] Romans units no longer have slightly distorted voice audio.
[/list]

[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] The UI graphics and fonts filter which was introduced in Update 90260 and later known as WIDGETUI_FILTER, is now available as in-game options on PC platforms under the Graphics tab:
[list][*] [b]Anti-Alias UI:[/b] Select to smoothen graphics (such as icons) in certain parts of the UI, on resolutions other than 4K. Disabling may increase performance. (Medium, High, Ultra presets)
[*] [b]Anti-Alias Text:[/b] Select to smoothen text in certain parts of the UI, on resolutions other than 4K. Disabling may increase performance when Smooth Serif Font is off. (High, Ultra presets)[/list]
[*] Smooth Serif Font has been restored to its original look (from before Update 90260) when Anti-Alias Text is off.
[*] Sea walls now have their own icon.
[*] Army tents now have their own icon in Return of Rome.
[*] The Ranked UI button in Return of Rome now uses the intended artwork.
[*] Updated some wrong artworks from the History section with the proper ones.
[*] Added the “Off” and “High” volume indicators on the narrator volume bar.
[*] Chatbox is no longer visible in 1v1 quickplay games. Additionally, chatbox is now visible when in party with at least 2 members on the quickplay screen, to match with Xbox behaviour.
[*] Age of Empires campaigns now have a unique campaign group icon.
[*] Changed the color of buttons in Scenario Editor in Return of Rome mode to blue.
[*] All Return of Rome cheat units now have their own icons.
[*] Sogdian Cataphract icon no longer incorrectly indicates hero glow on the unit.
[/list]

[h3]Hotkeys[/h3]
[list]
[*] Toggle Health Bar hotkey no longer affects Idle Pointer display.
[/list]

[h3]Xbox[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that was occurring while accepting an invitation from another player under certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed an issue where randomizing lobby settings automatically scrolls down the Game Settings menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where the banned and preferred maps on the Quick Play menu disappear under certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI Difficulty is set back to Standard when starting a queue in Quick Play.
[*] Fixed a graphical issue on the Rally Point flag.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Quick Find Naval Units button for Transport Ships was not activating properly when relevant ships were on the field in Return of Rome.
[*] The Building Range Indicators are no longer drawn incorrectly and inconsistently.
[*] Spearman-Line units are now included in the Command Menu Shortcuts for Donjons as intended.
[*] Fixed an issue where Villagers queued in the Town Center were separated based on gender.
[*] The save and load game pages now show the remaining cloud capacity.
[*] Fixed an issue where Monk’s Heal command no longer heals units.
[*] Controller buttons in Return of Rome mode now have blue color (instead of red like in [i]Age of Empires II[/i]).
[*] Fixed an issue where Toggle Idle Pointers hotkey has no effect.
[*] Added the previously missing player icons which are rewarded for winning as Roman civilization.
[*] Fixed an issue where players are unable to repair transport ships.
[/list]

[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/preview-age-of-empires-ii-definitive-edition-update-95810/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e0c0552e7cd0baf003bee7b6aa3e7b974956b776.png[/img][/url][/quote]
[quote][h3]:alertalert: [b]DISCLAIMER[/b][/h3]This list is subject to change and should not be considered a comprehensive list of all the known issues we’re tracking. The above is to inform you of the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].
[/quote]
[quote]
[h2]Hotfix 96976[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a graphics issue on Xbox Series S and X systems. Graphics should now appear with greater fidelity at close zoom levels on Xbox Series consoles.
[*] Fixed an issue where monks could duplicate relics by dropping a relic before placing it in the monastery.
[*] Fixed the walking animation for monks that have dropped off a relic.
[*] We are aware of an issue in Scenario 5: ‘[i]Of Turncoats and Traitors[/i]’ of the Thoros campaign, causing an unintended difficulty-spike. The team is currently working on a fix.
[/list][/quote]

notes.title: New Update to the Persians: Coming Soon to AoE II: DE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/974e5af0eb31d8b0469a753319684e58af02e164.png[/img]
Accompanying [i]The Mountain Royals[/i] expansion will be an update including a massive rework of the Persian civilization! This update will be available to everyone who owns the base game of [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], whether you have purchased the upcoming [i]The Mountain Royals[/i] expansion or not. 

[quote][h2]The Persian Civilization Identity[/h2]
As more civilizations were released through additional expansions, we found the Persian civilization was slowly becoming less unique and their primary identity as a Knight civilization had become less meaningful.

We strived for the way the Persians are represented in-game to incorporate additional design, while representing their rich history, creating more unique tools for the Persian civilization’s toolbox. We wanted to provide you with more interesting strategic choices, and ways for you to engage your opponents, all while representing them from the early Middle Ages to late empire. 

In this update, our goal was to make the Persians feel special – the way we want each civilization to feel in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. We believe we’ve accomplished that by making the Persians a true cavalry civilization with this rework.   

With that said, here’s some expanded information on a few of our favorite changes![/quote]
[quote][h2]The Savar – A New Unique Unit[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/a095201f590f175c5afe17f5eff9c84bb1a9e216.png[/img]
Persia’s use of heavily armored cavalry has always been represented in-game, yet having the more European-style Paladin always felt unfaithful to the civilization. With this update, the Persians have received a unique upgrade to the Cavalier; the Savar.

Though the Savar looks similar to the Paladin, but is highly specialized in defeating enemy ranged units. Its additional ranged armor makes it more resilient, and their damage bonus stacks with the Persian Team Bonus, making them extremely effective at countering enemy Archers and general ranged units.  

However, the increased survivability against ranged units does come at the cost of a lower Hit Point total when compared to the Paladin, making the Savar more susceptible to melee units.[/quote]
[quote][h2]The War Elephant[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/55b64807f3f2079e457eba1b2f24a29ff56fb3f0.png[/img]
With the introduction of the Battle Elephant, we found it made the War Elephant feel less unique, and for a unit that already requires a significant investment to field, we want to ensure the War Elephant gets the respect it deserves. 

The goal of these changes is to make the War Elephant more prevalent in the Persian unit roster. The Mahouts Unique Technology has been removed, but the base movement speed of the War Elephant has increased 33% by default. No longer will you have to wait as your War Elephants slowly lumber towards the enemy; charge them down! 

Continuing the additional improvements, the War Elephant now has a significant damage bonus against buildings, now highly capable of ripping through your opponent's base, a great way to add additional pressure. We’ve also reduced the cost for the Elite War Elephant upgrade, making it significantly easier for you to realize the full potential of these behemoth units.

We always want to ensure each unit has their place in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. With these changes, we hope we’ve given you plenty of reasons to start training more War Elephants![/quote]
[quote][h2]Parthian Tactics Available in the Castle Age[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/8519ac312d8e44c86c80484a2aec114e6e10def3.png[/img]
Having access to Parthian Tactics in the Castle Age adds an entirely new layer to the strategies available to the Persian civilization within [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], making them significantly less predictable while also representing a part of history we’re excited to pay homage to.

The Sasanian Persian Empire that continued the Parthian legacy is an important part of how the Persian civilization is represented in-game. The Parthian Shot dates at least back to the Battle of Carrhae, where the Parthians used it to great effect against a Roman army. Sasanian armies employed similar tactics in the following centuries well into the early medieval period.

Now that the Persians are able to research Parthian Tactics in the Castle Age, it provides a large spike to the strength of their Cavalry Archers, which has incredible synergy with their new civilization bonus, providing extra gold for each military unit they defeat.

This is perfect to help you dictate the pace of the match with early pressure, providing a new way for you to surprise and engage your opponents.[/quote]
[quote][h3]Full Rework Change List[/h3]
The above were some of our personal highlights we wanted to provide some additional background on. Please see the full list of changes to the Persian civilization below. 

[expand type=details][b]Civilization Bonuses:[/b][list] 	[*]Start the game with +50 food, +50 wood.[/*] 	[*]Town Centers and Docks have 2x hit points and work +5%/+10%/+15%/+20% faster in Dark/Feudal/Castle/Imperial Age.[/*] 	[*]Cavalry generate 5 gold when killing enemy military units.[/*] 	[*]Parthian Tactics available in Castle Age.[/*] 	[*]Can build Caravanserai in Imperial Age.[/*][/list][b]Unique Units:[/b][list] 	[*]War Elephant (Very Big Elephant, enjoys scenic trips down the river in a transport ship).[/*] 	[*]Savar (Unique upgrade to the Cavalier, powerful all-purpose cavalry with attack bonus vs. Archers).[/*][/list][b]Unique Technologies[/b][list] 	[*]Kamandaran (Archer-line gold cost is replaced by additional wood cost).[/*] 	[*]Citadels (Castles receive -25% bonus damage, arrows replaced with bullets which deal +4 attack, +3 attack vs. infantry, and +3 attack vs. rams).[/*][/list][b]Team Bonus[/b][list] 	[*]Knights +2 attack vs. Archers.[/*][/list][b]Other Changes:[/b][list] 	[*](Elite) War Elephant attack bonus vs. standard buildings and stone buildings increased from 7 (10) ▶ 30.[/*] 	[*](Elite) War Elephant base movement speed increased from 0.6 ▶8.[/*] 	[*]Elite War Elephant upgrade cost reduced from 1600 food 1200 gold ▶ 1350 food 800 gold.[/*][/list][/expand]
[/quote]
[quote]We understand with this update a lot of changes have been made to the Persian civilization. We look forward to hearing your feedback, and plan to continue to iterate as needed. Start the game already![/quote]
[h2]Pre-Order Now![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2555420/Age_of_Empires_II_Definitive_Edition__The_Mountain_Royals/
