notes.title: Return of Rome: Everything You Need to Know
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e6a89b67c9137d5bfbbc9b966071adc0ac593b20.png[/img]
What to expect with the newest[i] Return of Rome[/i] DLC for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i].

[h2]What is Return of Rome?[/h2]
[i]Return of Rome[/i] is a completely new type of expansion, which brings classic [i]Age of Empires[/i] gameplay, style and key experiences as a brand new self-contained experience. 

When launching [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], to access [i]Return of Rome[/i], you will need to select the [i]Return of Rome[/i] icon on the Main Menu to transition your game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f2f7d9638690bed2c39f8b20321607b7c31e670f.png[/img]
You will be taken into [i]Return of Rome[/i], where you’ll be able to access favorite and new content, including the [i]Age of Empires[/i] classic civilizations, brand new campaigns, and a new competitive D3 game mode.
[quote][i]Purchasing Return of Rome will also grant you access to the bonus Romans civilization while playing in Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition mode.[/i][/quote]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141580/Age_of_Empires_II_Definitive_Edition__Return_of_Rome/

[h2]Who is the Lac Viet Civilization?[/h2]
The Lac Viet are an additional civilization playable alongside the 16 classic civilizations in [i]Return of Rome[/i].

[b]Civilization Bonuses[/b]
[list]
[*] Foragers work 20% faster
[*] Military units created 25% faster
[*] Archery Range units +2 armor
[/list]
[b]Team Bonus[/b]
[list]
[*] Houses and Farms built 50% faster
[/list]
[b]Technology Tree[/b]

[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35210618/e11d571027ebfc76ef4e1c4fd7abec3189b3bcfd.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/9c14fad5d08d5d0a2433826a5738d5585e6dff02.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Romans in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i][/h2]
The Romans were intended as a bonus for you to enjoy in Singleplayer and Unranked Lobbies as an extra, on top of the content within [i]Return of Rome[/i].

However, we’ve been listening to your feedback and desire to see Romans as a ranked civilization. [b]Based on that feedback, we have decided to add Romans to the ranked queue in a future update.[/b] We love seeing the passion of [i]Age of Empires[/i] fans, and feedback like this helps us continue to create as many happy players as we can.

This will help us ensure the Romans are balanced, and ready for competitive play on introduction to ranked gameplay.

[h3]The Romans in History[/h3]
With the newest release of [i]Return of Rome[/i] for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], players will have an opportunity to battle it out as the Romans against other beloved civilizations in [i]AoE II: DE[/i]. These Romans are joining a full roster, but are very different from the Ancient Romans featured in the original [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i].

In game, the Romans date back to about 395 C.E., making them contemporaries with the Goths, Celts, Britons, Franks, Persians, etc. By this period in Late Antiquity and Early Middle Ages – Rome was a crumbling shadow of its former glory. Plagued by an inability to pay its soldiers, lack of manpower, and its older fortifications in disrepair, they could not face the invasions of their former provinces or fend off attacks closer to home.

By the time of Attila, Rome simply couldn’t field any large armies of note, and relied on Germanic tribes to guard their frontiers, but those tribes often went rogue and became enemies instead. The old Roman-controlled area was inundated with an influx of different peoples who settled the land, bringing their own culture and customs, annihilating the old Roman ways.

By the end, Rome could not overcome a collapsing economy, loss of manpower, an inability to pay troops, plus bad leadership. When the “official” end in 476 came with the ousting of the last Roman emperor by a Germanic king, the Roman Empire had already silently melted away.

[h2]Will Return of Rome Civilizations be Playable with [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] Civilizations?[/h2]
The [i]Return of Rome[/i] civilizations and [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] civilizations are isolated to their respective [i]Return of Rome[/i] or [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. As such, they will not be able to interact with each other. 

[h2]Campaigns Included with [i]Return of Rome[/i][/h2]
[i]Return of Rome[/i] will include three new campaigns, Pyrrhus of Epirus, Sargon of Akkad and Trajan. Each featuring full voice acting, improved AI, and the historically driven narrative and gameplay that makes [i]Age of Empires[/i] special.

[h4]Pyrrhus of Epirus[/h4]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/13a4f550cf5671f99d2e91eb5abb516543464301.png[/img]
As the Wars of the Diadochi saw Alexander the Great’s successors throw the Greek world into chaos, Pyrrhus of Epirus began as a small player among titans. Will he become worthy of the legendary Hannibal Barca’s judgment of him – the greatest general of the age, second only to Alexander – or will his constant uphill struggle prove insurmountable? In this campaign, you will play as the Macedonians.

[h4]Sargon of Akkad[/h4]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/ff19e5343ec9e6d91403946fb39f7bc8f95268d7.png[/img]
An unlikely man rises to power in the city-states of Mesopotamia: Sargon is a simple cupbearer to the king, but everything changes when the war goddess Ishtar appears in his dreams. Under her guidance, Sargon leads the quarrelling Sumerians into a new age, but the seductive nature of power forces him to choose between his divine destiny and his personal ambition. In this campaign, you will play as the Sumerians.

[h4]Trajan[/h4]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/4a605447e787cc57c7c8e9e626c2d9f6aab7c9bc.png[/img]
Marcus Ulpius Trajanus climbed the ranks of the legions while the Emperor Domitian’s tyrannical rule tarnished the Roman Empire’s glory. When circumstance elevates him to the throne as Emperor Trajan, he inherits a realm on the brink of disaster. Will resourcefulness, virtue, and military might be enough to save Rome and lead it to its historical zenith, or will the Roman Empire collapse four centuries before its time? In this campaign, you will play as the Romans.

[h2]What if I Already Own Age of Empires: Definitive Edition?[/h2]
Our intention with [i]Return of Rome[/i] is to ensure that if you already own [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i], you will still find plenty of new content to enjoy.

This includes three new exclusive campaigns. A new and exclusive civilization; the Lac Viet. Plus the bonus Romans civilization for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] for you to enjoy. All of this alongside numerous quality of life upgrades and features.

[h3]Return of Rome Highlight: [/h3]
[list][*] 3 new campaigns: Pyrrhus of Epirus, Sargon of Akkad and Trajan 
[*] The introduction of the Lac Viet civilization for Return of Rome
[*] The introduction of the Romans civilization for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
[*] The introduction of the D3 competitive game mode, popularized by the Vietnamese competitive scene[/list]
[h4]🢂 Plus All 16 Civilizations from the Original Age of Empires[/h4]
[expand type=details][list][*] Assyrians
[*] Babylonians
[*] Carthaginians
[*] Choson
[*] Egyptians
[*] Greeks
[*] Hittites
[*] Macedonians
[*] Minoans
[*] Palmyrans
[*] Persians
[*] Phoenicians
[*] Romans
[*] Shang
[*] Sumerians
[*] Yamato
[/list][/expand]
[h4]Quality of Life Upgrades and Features:[/h4]
[list][*] Gates 
[*] Formations 
[*] Spectator mode 
[*] A much-improved AI for computer opponents 
[*] New maps [/list]
[h4]🢂 New Game Modes[/h4]
[expand type=details][list][*] D3
[*] Empire Wars
[*] King of the Hill
[*] Sudden Death
[*] Defend the Wonder
[*] Wonder Race
[/list][/expand]

[h2]Return of Rome Storage Requirements[/h2]
During the pre-order announcement, there was an error on the Steam page. This has since been corrected to 3GB of required available space.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]How to Pre-Order[/h2]
[i]Return of Rome[/i] is available to pre-order now, [b]including an additional 15% off[/b]!  

This innovative DLC is available as a standalone purchase, or as a bundle with [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. Rome needs a leader! 

Pre-order the [i]Return of Rome[/i] today and be ready to conquer your opponents and forge a new Roman Empire on [b]May 16, 2023[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141580/Age_of_Empires_II_Definitive_Edition__Return_of_Rome/

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/d3de6b174af7ebf8758cdc61a638a8ef1c4a827f.png[/img]

Today’s hotfix is aimed at addressing stability and performance issues, along with some balance fixes.

Be sure to dig down into the post below to get all of the smaller details before hopping in-game and checking them out firsthand.

[quote]💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-ii/] Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires] The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Thanks again to our amazing community members, all of whom have helped to make [i]Age of Empires[/i] what it is today!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[quote]
[h2]Game[/h2]
[h3]Stability & Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game no longer crashes upon closing the title after exiting a Multiplayer match while a monk holds a relic.
[/list]
[h3]Hotkeys[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where command group selection wasn’t firing unless shift group appending was enabled.
[*] Toggle Idle Pointer hotkey now works properly.
[/list]
[h3]Xbox[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where trees were invisible and un-targetable on Xbox when the Small Trees option was enabled in the settings.
[/list]
[/quote]
[quote]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bombard Towers now have 100% accuracy instead of 92% accuracy when Greek Fire is researched, as intended.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where units may not be added back to a formation after killing a target or going idle.
[*] Fixed an issue where walls always had lower selection priority than nearby objects.
[*] Fixed an issue to prevent Villagers blocking themselves when building palisade walls or stone walls, leaving gaps and sometimes staying idle.
[*] Units no longer stop attacking enemy foundations once the building is complete.
[*] Villagers no longer continue walking to Town Centers and garrison when the town bell has been activated again.
[*] New sheep no longer get unintentionally killed by Villagers when ungarrisoning from the Town Center.
[*] Collide & Correct has been disabled to prevent units from accidentally scattering.
[/list]
[/quote]
[quote]
[h2]Civilization Balance[/h2]
[h3]Portuguese[/h3]
Organ Guns
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Organ Guns would largely ignore hill bonuses/penalties
[*] Fixed an issue where converted Elite Organ Guns would deal the damage of unupgraded Organ Guns unless the player had researched the Elite upgrade themselves
[*] Fixed an issue where Organ Guns missed shots would only deal half damage instead of the intended full damage
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented Organ Gun projectiles from dispersing properly
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Organ Guns projectiles to pass between units without hitting them
[*] Increased projectile dispersion from 0.25 to 0.6
[*] Reduced the number of projectiles from 6 to 5 (7 to 6 for Elite)
[*] (Elite) Organ Gun gain +1 damage against Skirmishers
[/list]
[/quote]
[quote]
[h2]AI[/h2]
[h3]Scripting[/h3]
[list]
[*] Up-path-distance 0 now returns the correct value instead of always returning 65535.
[/list]
[/quote]
[quote][h3]:alertalert: [b]DISCLAIMER[/b][/h3]This list is subject to change and should not be considered a comprehensive list of all the known issues we’re tracking. The above is to inform you of the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].
[/quote]

notes.title: Celebrate the Return of Rome By Pre-Ordering Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1fc8b4461de5d326fec6142152a142950fe5c783.png[/img]

Where were you in 1998? Perhaps listening to Cher’s Believe, watching Titanic, playing with your Tamagotchi and relaxing on your inflatable couch? Or were you playing the [i]Age of Empires[/i] DLC [i]The Rise of Rome[/i]? This beloved evolution of the first [i]Age of Empires[/i] game has taken on a new form and joined the Definitive Edition era in the [i]Return of Rome[/i] DLC for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i].  

Yes, you read that correctly, [i]Age of Empires[/i] content available in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. Bringing the civilizations and action of ancient worlds to [i]AoE II: DE[/i]. Purchasers will be able to switch to [i]Return of Rome[/i] in the game’s main screen and take on fresh challenges.  

[h2]What can you expect from this new and innovative DLC? [/h2] 
[list]
[*] 3 new campaigns created specifically for Return of Rome. Sargon of Akkad (Sumerians), Pyrrhus of Epirus (Macedonians) and Trajan (Romans). With new missions to tackle and stories told through the familiar [i]AoE II: DE[/i] style, you’ll be able to live more moments from history.  
[*] All 16 original [i]Age of Empires[/i] civilizations from the Assyrians to the Yamato. Get to grips with the civilizations that started the [i]Age of Empires[/i] journey.  
[*] One new civilization, the Lac Viet. In honor and recognition of [i]Rise of Rome[/i]’s phenomenal popularity in Vietnam, we’ve added a new civilization with [i]Return of Rome[/i]. Adding something new for established and beginner players. 
[*] New D3 Game Mode. D3 is an homage to a fan favorite rule set that is now fully integrated into the game.  This rule set reduces rush tactics and allows players to start their early game more robustly, only allowing fighting with a single unit until entering the Bronze Age, ensuring players reach later Ages for equal battles.  This rule set also bans walls and towers, making for exciting match ups later in the game. 
[*] The Roman civilization will be playable in the main [i]AoE II: DE[/i] title. If you’ve ever wondered how the Romans might fare against the Aztecs, now’s your opportunity to find out. [/list]
Catch a glimpse of what [i]Return of Rome[/i] has to offer in our teaser trailer:
[previewyoutube=cLYKtoWGlsE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]How to Pre-Order[/h2]
[i]Return of Rome [/i]is available to pre-order now on Steam! This innovative DLC is available to prepurchase, or as a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141580/Age_of_Empires_II_Definitive_Edition__Return_of_Rome/][b]bundle[/b][/url] with [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. Rome is calling. It’s time to return.  
[quote]Pre-order the [i]Return of Rome[/i] today and be ready to conquer your opponents and forge a new Roman Empire on [b]May 16, 2023[/b]![/quote]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/64e0e6f3f44fa1450d4e26b78bb0813efdec2210.png[/img]

Hello and welcome to an exciting and fun-filled update for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]! This is a huge one with massive balance changes, bug fixes, and some new mods available as in-game options!

Plus, there’s an all-new Spicy Expeditions Event to celebrate Spring time! The merchants have come to town and have brought some very flavorful rewards from faraway lands. Complete daily challenges and unlock saffron fields, burning chilis, and colorful shops to decorate your Town Center!

While there are plenty of notable fixes and features to look forward to in today’s build, here’s some of the big highlights coming with this month’s update:

[list]
[*]Spicy Expeditions Event!
[*]Massive balance update!
[*]A mountain of bug fixes based on your feedback!
[*]A few Mods are now available as in-game options:
[list][*]Small trees
[*]Idle economy units pointers
[/list][/list]
Be sure to dig down into the post below to get all of the smaller details before hopping in-game and checking them out firsthand.

Thanks again to our amazing community members, all of whom have helped to make [i]Age of Empires[/i] what it is today!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[hr][/hr][code][h1]         ◆ UPDATE 81058◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b][/h1]

[h2]Spicy Expeditions Event[/h2]
[code][h3]           🤍April 11th through April 25th🤍[/h3][/code]
This month is dedicated to the adventurous merchants who risked life and limb to obtain luxuries for their customers throughout the ages. They shared the world’s finest indulgences in colorful shops bursting with spices from faraway lands, thanks to fearless explorers in search of commerce.

[table equalcells=1][tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e9ef3375c9b1649b02995953a15a08adf78edfba.png[/img][/td]

[/tr][/table]
[h1]New Rewards![/h1]
[b]TODAY through April 25th[/b], complete the in-game tasks within the time limit to unlock exclusive rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/4b75555477853e9be58dd0fbf0f23f0053dcff1a.png[/img]
[h3]Event F.A.Q.[/h3]

🢂 Q: Do I have to complete the challenges on consecutive days?
[expand type=details]While challenges don’t have to be completed on [b]consecutive[/b] days, [b]only one challenge can be completed per day[/b].

This means that you will need to play at least five different days to complete all of the challenges.
[/expand]
🢂 Q: When is the last day I can complete the daily challenges?
[expand type=details]The Spicy Expeditions Event concludes April 25th.
[/expand]
🢂 Q: What do I do if I accidentally unsubscribe from a special mod?
[expand type=details]No problem! All you need to do is click your [b]Profile Icon[/b] on the main menu, select [b]Event Mods[/b] (under Collection), and then check the unlocked event mod you want to enable!
[/expand]
🢂 Q: How do I change my profile icon?
[expand type=details]You can update your profile icon in your profile:
[olist][*] On the main menu, click the [b]Profile Icon[/b] next to your name.
[*] You should now be in the [b]Profile Icons[/b] tab under [b]Collections[/b].
[*] Select your favorite icon, then click the [b]Select Icon[/b] button to lock in your choice.
[*] You’re done!
[/olist]
[/expand]
🢂 Q: How do I download and enable mods?
[expand type=details]For information about how to subscribe to and prioritize your mods, visit [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047762971]this article.[/url]
[/expand]

notes.title: Enjoy the Penguin Party Event in Age II: DE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/91a92881182d0b1a0499267a9f79942b033d9bb9.png[/img]

Hello Friends! Penguins are visiting [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] since their winter months in the southern hemisphere are over now. Get your scarves and caps out because it’s going to be cold here!

Some cool challenges and rewards are waiting for you! Build up your walls and ring your town bells, an army of fighting penguins is coming from the South to take power!

We hope you enjoy this Penguin Party! Thank you for playing and stay tuned for a lot more to coming to [i]Age II: DE[/i]!

[code][h2]        💥September 19 - October 3💥[/h2][/code]

[code]                      [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/7d54ea84343fc8a84c7816591cd3d95573f9296c.gif[/img][/code]
[h1]New Rewards![/h1]

[table]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/7ef4c8a82a97a7fdd722ea91a4caed9ad85ec7d0.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/8ad961e12b033edfea1369e1e6031164cd5f9cc4.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f753924a74e02fa98bb71a2a1c7aa0e467710f8b.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]TODAY through October 3rd[/b], complete in-game tasks within the time limit to unlock exclusive goodies! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/038186bf45cf539f2f545d48efc408ff33622a20.png[/img]

[h3][b]Event F.A.Q.[/b][/h3]
[b]Q:[/b] Do I have to complete the challenges on consecutive days?
[expand type=details]While challenges don't have to be completed on [b]consecutive[/b] days, only [b]one challenge can be completed per day[/b].

[u]Only the [b]Xbox Live[/b][b] [/b]challenges can be completed *any* day before the end of the event![/u]

[b]This means that you will need to play at least five different days to complete [u]all[/u] of the challenges.[/b][/expand]
[b]Q:[/b] When is the last day I can complete the daily challenges?
[expand type=details]The [b]Penguin Party Event [/b]concludes [b]October 3rd.[/b][/expand]
[b]Q:[/b] Do I get to keep all of the event unlocks?
[expand type=showmore]All you need to do is log into your [b]Xbox Live[/b] account before the end of the event to keep all of the profile icons and mods you unlock; it's as easy as that![/expand]
[b]Q:[/b] What do I do if I accidentally unsubscribe from a special mod?
[expand type=details]No problem! All you need to do is click your [b]Profile Icon [/b]on the main menu, select [b]Event Mods [/b](under Collection), and then check the unlocked event mod you want to enable![/expand]
[b]Q:[/b] How do I change my profile icon?
[expand type=details]You can update your profile icon in your profile:[olist] 	[*]On the main menu, click the [b]Profile Icon [/b]next to your name.[/*] 	[*]You should now be in the [b]Profile Icons [/b]tab under [b]Collections[/b].[/*] 	[*]Select your favorite icon, then click the [b]Select Icon[/b] button to lock in your choice.[/*] 	[*]You're done![/*][/olist][/expand]
[b]Q:[/b] How do I download and enable mods?
[expand type=details]For information about how to subscribe to and prioritize your mods, visit [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047762971]this article[/url].[/expand]

[h1]Keep It All![/h1]
Remember: if you [b]sign in to Xbox Live[/b] during the event, you’ll get to keep all of the [b]mods[/b] and [b]profile icons[/b] you’ve achieved! Sign in, earn your rewards, and enjoy!

We hope you enjoy this month’s Penguin Party Event!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

notes.title: Updates to Ranked Team Game Elo Calculation
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/abef905f98746a17bf5f0cd23d9556a1344c6249.png[/img]

Last year, we released an [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/rankedtg-update-5-2021/]update to ranked team game (TG) Elo acquisition[/url] for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] as an initial step aimed at resolving some of the team game matchmaking and rating issues that players were experiencing.

Since then, we’ve continued to monitor this issue and take feedback about unbalanced team games and rating inflation on the team game ladder! We’re certainly aware team game Elo is inflating over time at a rate that is much higher than the 1v1 ladder, which we’ve been working in the background to address. It’s our goal to get team game Elo distribution to more evenly match 1v1 Elo distribution, which in turn should result in better matches found more quickly for players queuing for team games!

Today we are taking a large step toward resolving this issue with [b]two changes to the way points are awarded for team games[/b] in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i].

[olist]
[*] The [b]first change[/b] is a one-time adjustment to current team game Elo to help normalize player ratings. For most players, this means you’ll see your team game rating drop, as a correction toward rating inflation.
[*] The [b]second change[/b] is an adjustment to the way points are awarded after a match.
[/olist]
[h2]Ranked RM TG Elo: Here is How it Works Now[/h2]
Currently, all team members receive the same number of points for winning a match, based on a calculation according to the average Elo of each team. Example:
[list]
[*][b]Team 1[/b]
[list][*]Player A at 2000 Elo
[*]Player B at 1000 Elo[/list]
[*][b]Team 2[/b]
[list][*]Player C at 1500 Elo
[*]Player D at 1500 Elo[/list]
[*][b]If Team 1 wins:[/b]
[list][*]Both players on Team 1 gain 16 Elo (as if a 1500 Elo player beat another 1500 Elo player)
[*]Both players on Team 2 lose 16 Elo (as if a 1500 Elo player lost to a 1500 Elo player)[/list][/list]
With this system, Elo still rose higher than it should for some players (notably, the higher rated players on a team with lower rated teammates.) Our initial step was intended to fix rating inflation, but when there is a large Elo difference between teammates it didn’t correct this issue as much as we had hoped.

Currently, players who team up regularly with lower rated players could artificially increase their Elo. Player A would get more points than they should, while Player B would get less than they should. This is bad news for Player B (and for his future opponents!) because Player B’s rating would be artificially low. Over time, this causes unbalanced matchmaking, and makes for a poor-quality team game experience.

[h2]The New Calculation System: Here is an Example of The Changes[/h2]
We plan to correct this problem by using a player’s individual team game Elo, instead of their team average, and calculating that against the average Elo of the enemy team. Example:

[list]
[*]Team 1:
[list][*]Player A at 2000 Elo
[*]Player B at 1000 Elo[/list]
[*]Team 2:
[list][*]Player C at 1500 Elo
[*]Player D at 1500 Elo[/list]
[*]If Team 1 wins:
[list][*]Player A on Team 1 will gain 2 Elo (as if a 2000 Elo player beat a 1500 Elo opponent)
[*]Player B on Team 1 will gain 30 Elo (as if a 1000 Elo player beat a 1500 Elo opponent)
[*]Player C on Team 2 will lose 16 Elo (as if a 1500 Elo player beat a 1500 Elo opponent)
[*]Player D on Team 2 will lose 16 Elo (since their rating is the same their teammate, they lose the same number of points in this scenario)[/list]
[/list]
In the example above, points awarded are based on a player’s [b]individual Elo compared to the average Elo of the enemy team[/b], avoiding the inflated Elo that results from high rated players regularly teaming up with less experienced or lower rated players.

[h2]One-Time Elo Adjustment[/h2]
Because rating inflation has worsened over time, a [b]one-time correction to team game Elo[/b] will correct for player ratings that have been able to climb artificially high with the current system. Again, for most players, you will find that your team game Elo has gone down, perhaps even significantly depending on how inflated your Elo has become. If you’re concerned about how this impacts your placement in the ladder, just be aware that this is true for your opponents as well! For exceptionally low rated players however, you may see your team game rating increase slightly.

[hr][/hr]

Our hope is that these combined changes will alleviate rating inflation and significantly improve the user experience in matchmaking. Over time, this should help team game Elo to be distributed more fairly and lessen the number of inflated accounts at the top of the ladder.

[quote]Your feedback is always appreciated, and we will continue to listen to your suggestions on our [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/]official forums[/url], [url=http://discord.gg/ageofempires]Discord[/url], and [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social[/url] channels to find ways to improve your matchmaking experience. We will continue to monitor your feedback and may make additional changes to improve the system in the future.[/quote]

Player C on Team 2 will lose 16 Elo (as if a 1500 Elo player beat a 1500 Elo opponent)
Player D on Team 2 will lose 16 Elo (since their rating is the same their teammate, they lose the same number of points in this scenario)

In the example above, points awarded are based on a player’s individual Elo compared to the average Elo of the enemy team, avoiding the inflated Elo that results from high rated players regularly teaming up with less experienced or lower rated players.

Because rating inflation has worsened over time, a one-time correction to team game Elo will correct for player ratings that have been able to climb artificially high with the current system. Again, for most players, you will find that your team game Elo has gone down, perhaps even significantly depending on how inflated your Elo has become. If you’re concerned about how this impacts your placement in the ladder, just be aware that this is true for your opponents as well! For exceptionally low rated players however, you may see your team game rating increase slightly.

Our hope is that these combined changes will alleviate rating inflation and significantly improve the user experience in matchmaking. Over time, this should help team game Elo to be distributed more fairly and lessen the number of inflated accounts at the top of the ladder.

notes.title: Summer is On and So Is the Sun Festival Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/c3a07bbf22450962eeb6e559195f9b68b7178a17.png[/img]

Come celebrate another exciting event with [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]! Summer heat is on and so is a new hot event: welcome to the Sun Festival! Grab your feathers, your masks, and maybe apply some sunscreen, and jump into all the fun!

[h1]New Rewards![/h1]

[b]Now through July 21st[/b], complete in-game tasks within the time limit to unlock exclusive goodies! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/b7d617b0281b215820f19e007443ac47456a2f07.png[/img]

[h3][b]Event F.A.Q.[/b][/h3]
[b]Q:[/b] Do I have to complete the challenges on consecutive days?
[expand type=showmore]While challenges don't have to be completed on [b]consecutive[/b] days, only [b]one challenge can be completed per day[/b].

[u]Only the [b]Xbox Live[/b][b] [/b]challenges can be completed *any* day before the end of the event![/u]

[b]This means that you will need to play at least five different days to complete [u]all[/u] of the challenges.[/b][/expand]
[b]Q:[/b] When is the last day I can complete the daily challenges?
[expand type=showmore]The [b]Sun Festival Event [/b]concludes [b]July 21st.[/b][/expand]
[b]Q:[/b] Do I get to keep all of the event unlocks?
[expand type=showmore]All you need to do is log into your [b]Xbox Live[/b] account before the end of the event to keep all of the profile icons and mods you unlock; it's as easy as that![/expand]
[b]Q:[/b] What do I do if I accidentally unsubscribe from a special mod?
[expand type=showmore]No problem! All you need to do is click your [b]Profile Icon [/b]on the main menu, select [b]Event Mods [/b](under Collection), and then check the unlocked event mod you want to enable![/expand]
[b]Q:[/b] How do I change my profile icon?
[expand type=showmore]You can update your profile icon in your profile:[olist] 	[*]On the main menu, click the [b]Profile Icon [/b]next to your name.[/*] 	[*]You should now be in the [b]Profile Icons [/b]tab under [b]Collections[/b].[/*] 	[*]Select your favorite icon, then click the [b]Select Icon[/b] button to lock in your choice.[/*] 	[*]You're done![/*][/olist][/expand]
[b]Q:[/b] How do I download and enable mods?
[expand type=showmore]For information about how to subscribe to and prioritize your mods, visit [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047762971]this article[/url].[/expand]

[h1]Keep It All![/h1]
Remember: if you [b]sign in to Xbox Live[/b] during the event, you’ll get to keep all of the [b]mods[/b] and [b]profile icons[/b] you’ve achieved! Sign in, earn your rewards, and enjoy!

We hope you enjoy this month’s Sun Festival Event!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

notes.title: A Year in Review - Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
notes.content:
It’s been an outstanding year for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition, with heaps of free new content, grand tournament spectacles and now, the full release of co-operative campaigns!

You can catch all the details in the video below, or read our quick summary below.

[previewyoutube=MIaPg4JVvs4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][h1]Co-operative Campaigns & Scenarios[/h1][/h2]
Fully Co-operative Historical Battles are now officially released for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition! These new co-operative scenarios contain the same story-driven historical narratives and objectives you know and love, with an updated AI you and a friend will need to coordinate to conquer.

Co-op scenarios and campaigns are available to anyone who owns the base edition of Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition, so grab a buddy and relive the classic campaign experience.

[table][tr][td][b]Attila the Hun[/b][/td][td][b]Suryavarman I[/b][/td][td][b]Tamerlane[/b][/td][td][b]Tariq ibn Ziyad[/b][/td][td][b]Alaric[/b][/td][td][b]Saladin[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]The Scourge of God[/td][td]Usurpation[/td][td]Amir of Transoxiana[/td][td]The Battle of Guadalete[/td][td]The Battle of the Frigidus[/td][td]An Arabian Knight[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Great Ride[/td][td]Quelling the Rebellion[/td][td]Gurkhan of Persia[/td][td]Consolidation and Subjugation[/td][td]Razing Hellas[/td][td]Lord of Arabia[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Walls of Constantinople[/td][td]A Dangerous Mission[/td][td]Harbinger of Destruction[/td][td]Divide and Conquer[/td][td]The Belly of the Beast[/td][td]The Horns of Hattin[/td][/tr][tr][td]A Barbarian Betrothal[/td][td]Challenging a Thalassocracy[/td][td]Sultan of Hindustan[/td][td]Crossing the Pyrenees[/td][td]The Giant Falls[/td][td]The Siege of Jerusalem[/td][/tr][tr][td]The Battle of the Catalaunian Fields[/td][td]Nirvanapada[/td][td]Scourge of the Levant[/td][td]Razzia[/td][td]A Kingdom of Our Own[/td][td]Jihad![/td][/tr][tr][td]The Fall of Rome[/td][td][/td][td]A Titan Amongst Mortals[/td][td][/td][td][/td][td]The Lion and the Demon[/td][/tr][/table]

[h2]Matchmaking Options[/h2]
[list]
[*] Matchmaking Queue to provide more ranked play options for the community.
[*] A new Quick Play option, to be quickly matched with other similar minded players from around the world to team up and show the AI who’s boss.
[/list]

[h2]Death Match Ranked Lobbies[/h2]
After a re-work, ranked Death Match has returned with fully ranked custom lobbies, set to deliver an improved player experience.

[h2]Additional Expansions[/h2]
In the last year, we’ve seen the addition of two new expansions for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition, Lords of the West and Dawn of the Dukes.  

[table][tr][td][b]Expansion[/b][/td][td][b]New Civilizations[/b][/td][td][b]New Campaigns[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Lords of the West[/td][td]The Burgundians
The Sicilians[/td][td]Edward Longshanks
The Grand Dukes of the West
The Hautevilles[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dawn of the Dukes[/td][td]The Bohemians
The Poles[/td][td]Algirdas and Kestutis
Jadwiga
Jan Zizka[/td][/tr][/table]
Both of these expansions are available now on Steam and the Microsoft Store for you to enjoy!

[h2]Handicap[/h2]
The handicap option can buff a player up to 2x to allow a more balanced and fun experience in your custom lobby matches. This effects gameplay elements like increasing gather rates for villagers, extra bonus damage for counter units and more HP on all buildings, among other things. 

[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new Technology Tree preview feature: A small version of the tech tree that is now shown when hovering over the Technology Tree button while in-game.
[*] A new waypoint numbering system has also been added for command queues.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
There have been hundreds of balance changes over the last year, all to encourage more variation between each unit and the civilizations themselves. We’re continuing to work towards ensuring every unit has a place and its relevance within Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition, helping to create even more viable strategies and tactics for you to employ on the battlefield. 

[h2]New Maps[/h2]
Over 20 new maps have been added to the map pool, including 11 maps popularized across the Red Bull Wololo tournament series. 
These maps are available in rotation for Ranked Matchmaking, or whatever bizarre settings you want in a custom game with your friends!

Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition has had an incredible year, with over 10 major tournaments, a ton of additional free content, new expansions, multiple quality of life additions and lots more.

notes.title: Major Age of Empires 2: DE update brings new co-op event and campaigns
notes.content:
More than two years after launch, Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition keeps getting new goodies. The remastered strategy game has just got another major update, which brings a new co-op event, two new co-op campaigns, rewards, bug fixes, and more.

Age of Empires II: DE's Update 58259 - catchy, isn't it? - has kicked off a new co-op event that runs from, well, right now to February 14. This is offering a new bunch of challenges that in turn yield some decent in-game rewards, which you can earn by beating the set tasks within a certain time limit. In the style of similar events the devs have run before, this one gets you to complete a set of challenges in order, with five in total. You won't need to hit them all on consecutive days, but you can only complete up to a maximum of one per day, so you'll need to play on at least five different days while the event's live to nab them all.

Rewards vary by day, but include things like cheat codes that let you up your population cap or share resource around your team. There are also profile icons and a Town Centre decoration up for grabs. If you sign into Xbox Live at any time while the event's in swing you'll get to keep all of the mods and profile icons you unlock forever, so it's well worth doing if you intend to keep them.

Read the rest of the story...

You can now play Doom in Age of Empires

notes.title: Huge Age of Empires 2: DE update adds co-op campaigns, gameplay systems, more
notes.content:
Age of Empires 2: Definitive Edition debuted two whole years ago this week and, to mark the occasion, Forgotten Empires has launched a huge anniversary update jammed with a load of new content and changes. The RTS game's two-year anniversary bash is now live, and it brings new co-op campaigns, Quick Play vs AI matchmaking, a new player handicap system for custom lobbies, and a ton more besides.

The two new co-op campaigns are called Tariq ibn Ziyad and Tamerlane. The first features five missions, while the latter features six. There aren't any details on what these are exactly in the patch notes, with only the various mission names listed, but now they're live you can always go get stuck in if you're keen to find out, stat. It's worth noting these are still tagged as 'beta' for now as the devs are continuing to monitor player feedback and make changes to co-op campaigns.

The new Quick Play vs AI feature is a neat addition that does exactly what its name says - it lets you dive into the mode, which is designed to let you set up certain types of games and matchmake more easily and quickly, and battle it out against an AI-controlled foe rather than using the existing human multiplayer option. From the devs' preview in the patch notes, it looks like you'll get a choice of pitting two, three, or four against the AI, and you can set options for its difficulty - with the example given being 'extreme'.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Age of Empires IV is Available Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/e6049fd51cd3c8a0d5b4e9f6b5fa104274b0b149.png[/img]

Emma Bridle, Director of Customer Voice, World’s Edge 

The day is upon us, the sun has risen on a new Age. The whole team is so proud to announce that [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] is now available on Steam.

This is the first new numbered [i]Age of Empires[/i] title in 16 years, and we’re honored to have added a chapter to this globally beloved franchise. Players all over the world have been engaging in fierce battles, building expansive empires, and wololo-ing for close to 25 years and it’s thrilling to give our players more to enjoy.  

To celebrate the launch of [i]Age of Empires IV[/i], we are taking over Times Square in NYC by spanning multiple city blocks of large digital screens, a living diorama, and an AR experience. Please share your experiences if you happen to be in NYC. For those in London, heading to Piccadilly Circus from November 2nd could be an experience for the ages. 

[i]Age of Empires IV[/i] has something for every strategy gaming fan. With eight diverse civilizations, four captivating campaigns, multiplayer, skirmish, maps, unlockable videos, Art of War challenges, masteries and more, we’re excited to see what you play first.  

If you’re new to [i]Age of Empires[/i]: first of all, welcome! Now that you’re with us, there’s plenty of ways for you to get started:  

[list]
[*] Head to the “Learn” tab in the opening menu to find our Intro Tutorial. Our narrator will guide you through the game’s foundational skills, like building your economy and entering combat, whilst you help a group of displaced villagers start anew.[/*]
[*] Got the basics down? Our “Art of War” challenges, found in Single Player, will help you refine skills and earn medals as you improve on the expertise needed to be victorious in future battles.[/*] 
[*] You can also play our campaigns via “Story Mode,” allowing you to enjoy the challenges of the game, but with reduced difficulty as you focus on the historical journey and gameplay.[/*] 
[*] You could also face up against the AI in “Skirmish” mode. Choose your civ, your AI difficulty, your map and ready up![/*] 
[*] Looking to test your mettle against other players? Jump into multiplayer and select “Quick Match” or create a Custom Game. How you play is up to you! From maps to win conditions, no game will be the same.[/*]
[*] We’ve also provided a breakdown of the hotkeys here on [url=https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2021/10/22/age-of-empires-iv-hotkeys-revealed/]Xbox Wire for easy reference.[/url][/*]  
[/list]If this isn’t your first voyage onto the battlefield, there’s plenty of new features for you to enjoy in [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]. Try positioning your archers on top of walls to literally take your strategy to new heights. Place your units in stealth forests to ready the perfect ambush, your units will even whisper to evade discovery by your enemies. Move your entire civilization across the map whilst playing as the Mongols and choose your landmarks to age up and gain additional bonuses.  

There’s so much to enjoy with [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] and we can’t wait to hear from you as you get started. The team is ready and waiting to hear your feedback! Need support? Head to our dedicated Support Site to get you back to battle. 

Wololo! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466860/Age_of_Empires_IV/

notes.title: Make Your Mark On History With New Steam Bundle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f1794f6e8b7b827637a627b9a13bd883e0994d9e.jpg[/img]
Relive the march of history! Join the many generations of players who have experienced one of the most beloved franchises, spanning twenty years and leaving a legacy of historical adventures. Remember where it all started with your favorite civilizations and relive the campaigns you know and love. Add the ultimate compilation in the next installment of real-time strategy gaming. With high-fidelity graphics and featuring recently released content, the new Age of Empires Anthology delivers it all. It not only includes titles from the past, but gamers can battle it out in new game modes, discover new civilizations, and enjoy the updated graphics.

In addition to your favorite titles from the past, also included in the anthology is the new [i]Age of Empires IV – Digital Deluxe Edition[/i], with special access to the official [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] soundtrack, Unit Counters Chart, an art compilation from digital painter Craig Mullins, and exclusive in-game content. With both familiar and innovative new ways to expand your empire in stunning 4K visual fidelity, [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] brings an evolved real-time strategy game to a new generation. Play eight diverse civilizations, four distinct campaigns with legendary historical figures, 8-player multiplayer modes, and a tutorial system designed for first-time players.

[i]Age of Empires Anthology[/i] titles included:
[list]
[*] [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], plus the new “Dawn of the Dukes” and “Lords of the West” expansions
[*] [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i], plus the new “The African Royals” expansion
[*] [i]Age of Empires IV – Digital Deluxe Edition[/i]
[/list]
*Please note: the Anthology does not include the [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i] – United States Civilization.

This unforgettable anthology is an unrivaled compilation with hundreds of hours of real-time strategy fun that will stand the test of time, and is available NOW on the Steam Store!

notes.title: AVAILABLE NOW – Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition – Dawn of the Dukes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e668744eb684e2a6f512a29d3095253b37cddceb.jpg[/img]
Charge on to the battlefield like never before! [i]Dawn of the Dukes[/i], the second expansion for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], is now available on the Microsoft Store and Steam! Here’s what glories it brings to the beloved [i]Age[/i] title:
[list][*] Challenge friends with two all-new civilizations—The Bohemians and the Poles—each of which includes new unique units and technologies.
[*] Battle your way across Central and Eastern Europe with three new campaigns, overwhelming your opponents with sheer military might and economic productivity or with highly disciplined and technologically innovative armies!
[*] New achievements to earn on your Steam account![/list]
[h1]New Civilizations[/h1][hr][/hr]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UUmoSij6mqs
[h2][b]The Poles[/b][/h2][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/52cc6e20567fc6cad7bc3746cfbe0cddea9f8252.jpg[/img]
The [b]Poles[/b] are a cavalry civilization. While their western neighbors employed deadly companies of heavily armored cavalry, the Poles leveraged their strengths to evolve more towards what modern eyes might class as medium cavalry. While they could not always triumph over their rival counterparts on an individual basis, they emphasized maneuverability, organization, and sheer numbers at a time when warfare was shifting away from the typical medieval model.
[h3][b]🡒Unique Units[/b][/h3]
[expand type=showmore]
[list]
[*] [b]Obuch:[/b] The Polish unique unit is the [b]Obuch[/b], a brutal infantryman whose war hammer tears the armor from enemy units. Obuchs are best used against expensive, heavily armored units that might otherwise pose a deadly threat to the rest of your army.
[*] [b]Winged Hussar:[/b] The Poles also share a regional unit with the Lithuanians, their partners in their late-medieval commonwealth. This unit, the [b]Winged Hussar[/b], is a powerful upgrade to the Light Cavalry and replaces the Hussar upgrade that many other civilizations have.
[*] [b]Folwark:[/b] Additionally, the Poles have a unique building, the [b]Folwark[/b], which replaces the Mill and increases the efficiency of nearby Farms.
[*] [b]Technologies:[/b] Finally, the Poles have two unique technologies: [b]Szlachta Privileges[/b] and [b]Lechitic Legacy[/b]. Both of these provide powerful boosts to their roster of cavalry units.
[/list][/expand]
[url=https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/PolesTechTree_2.jpg style=button]Poles Tech Tree[/url]

[h2][b]The Bohemians[/b][/h2][hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/2df655c9559bf640f10c693a6a9165076ddedca5.jpg[/img]
The [b]Bohemians[/b] are a gunpowder and monk civilization. Threatened both militarily and ideologically on nearly all sides, the Bohemians responded with groundbreaking innovations in both spheres. Novel weaponry, battle tactics, and defensive strategies shattered the numerous feudal and professional armies of their invading rivals, while scholarly thought and debate inaugurated one of the earliest successful social revolutions in early modern European history. Bohemian armies compensated for a lack of sheer brute strength with an uncanny ability to outwit, outmaneuver, and counter their opponents.
[h3][b]🡒Unique Units[/b][/h3]
[expand type=showmore]
[list] [*] [b]Hussite Wagon:[/b] The first Bohemian unique unit is the [b]Hussite Wagon[/b], a deadly forerunner of the modern tank. Hussite Wagons possess strong firepower and are exceptional at protecting the units positioned behind them.
[*] [b]Houfnice:[/b] The second Bohemian unique unit is the [b]Houfnice[/b], a powerful upgrade to the Bombard Cannon. Houfnices are adept at blasting enemy fortifications and formations to smithereens.
[*] [b]Technologies:[/b] The Bohemians have two unique technologies: [b]Wagenburg Tactics[/b] and [b]Hussite Reforms[/b]. The former boosts their roster of gunpowder units, while the latter improves their Monks and Monasteries.
[/list][/expand]
[url=https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/BohemianTechTree_2.jpg style=button]Bohemians Tech Tree[/url]

[h1]3 New, Fully Voiced Campaigns[/h1][hr][/hr][quote][h3][b]🡒 Algirdas and Kestutis[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1efb4fb21830001dcffd8beebfe47fe43688a6d2.png[/img]
Faced with an impending invasion by the greedy Teutonic Knights, the small principality of Lithuania is on the brink of catastrophe. Divided and without wise leadership, the last pagans of Europe appear doomed, but Prince Algirdas and his loyal brother, Kestutis, refuse to bow to the marauders. Can they repel the crusaders and then contend with the grandsons of Genghis Khan — the fearsome horselords of the Golden Horde? In this campaign, you will play as the Lithuanians.[/quote][quote][h3][b]🡒 Jadwiga[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/77f80f5b8777fd1bdd35dfa1dbb345654bd739ae.png[/img]
Sent away from her mother and forcibly parted from the young man whom she loved, Jadwiga ascended to the Polish throne as a mere child. In a time of unending war, she must forge a future for her kingdom while contending with the wills of formidable leaders like Jogaila and Vytautas the Great. Can the beloved Star of the Poles bring about her vision of a powerful, united Poland-Lithuania, or will the incessant maelstrom of war plunge both realms into ruin once more? In this campaign, you will play as the Poles.[/quote][quote][h3][b]🡒 Jan Zizka[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/c0db50635e6c94bc5eadfe9ecbd883a3332df3ae.png[/img]
One-eyed Jan Zizka spent his youth as a mercenary fighting for honor and coin, but his destiny changed forever when he heard the preachings of the reformer Jan Hus in Prague. As a champion of the Hussite cause and the leader of its invincible armies, Zizka shattered existing notions of warfare with technological and tactical innovations. Cement the legacy of one of history’s greatest generals by galvanizing mere peasants into highly disciplined units and leading them to triumph over the Holy Roman Emperor’s knightly armies. In this campaign, you will play as the Bohemians.[/quote]

Houfnice: The second Bohemian unique unit is the Houfnice, a powerful upgrade to the Bombard Cannon. Houfnices are adept at blasting enemy fortifications and formations to smithereens.

Technologies: The Bohemians have two unique technologies: Wagenburg Tactics and Hussite Reforms. The former boosts their roster of gunpowder units, while the latter improves their Monks and Monasteries.

Faced with an impending invasion by the greedy Teutonic Knights, the small principality of Lithuania is on the brink of catastrophe. Divided and without wise leadership, the last pagans of Europe appear doomed, but Prince Algirdas and his loyal brother, Kestutis, refuse to bow to the marauders. Can they repel the crusaders and then contend with the grandsons of Genghis Khan — the fearsome horselords of the Golden Horde? In this campaign, you will play as the Lithuanians.

Sent away from her mother and forcibly parted from the young man whom she loved, Jadwiga ascended to the Polish throne as a mere child. In a time of unending war, she must forge a future for her kingdom while contending with the wills of formidable leaders like Jogaila and Vytautas the Great. Can the beloved Star of the Poles bring about her vision of a powerful, united Poland-Lithuania, or will the incessant maelstrom of war plunge both realms into ruin once more? In this campaign, you will play as the Poles.

One-eyed Jan Zizka spent his youth as a mercenary fighting for honor and coin, but his destiny changed forever when he heard the preachings of the reformer Jan Hus in Prague. As a champion of the Hussite cause and the leader of its invincible armies, Zizka shattered existing notions of warfare with technological and tactical innovations. Cement the legacy of one of history’s greatest generals by galvanizing mere peasants into highly disciplined units and leading them to triumph over the Holy Roman Emperor’s knightly armies. In this campaign, you will play as the Bohemians.

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 51737
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/83733a7bb80d33c1c6c0bfa4e5a78e7346d65eea.jpg[/img]

Hello and welcome to another release filled with exciting updates, balance changes, and bug fixes for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]!

Today’s build brings several fixes and updates to the game, including addressing several issues with the game crashing, civilization & map updates, and improvements & fixes to the AI. Many of these changes and fixes are a direct result of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/3020197857796238160?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Public Update Preview program[/url] (or PUP). For more information on the PUP—or to get involved—click the link above or scroll down to the [b]Ongoing section[/b] of this post.

On top of all the new changes, features, and improvements coming with today’s build, [i]Dawn of the Dukes[/i] introduces two all-new civilizations: the [b]Poles[/b] and the [b]Bohemians[/b]! Experience [b]3 new fully-voiced campaigns[/b] and [b]16 new Achievements[/b]!

Now, let’s take a quick look at some of the changes coming with today’s update:
[list][*] Celebrate all things [i]Age of Empires[/i] with the brand-new [b]Jungle Summer Vacation[/b] event, where you can unlock awesome rewards!
[*] We’ve added Polish language support!
[*] Units which were commanded using Attack Move no longer try to get into formation when reaching the destination they were sent to while enemy units.
[*] A number of [b]balance[/b] updates to gameplay, civilizations, and maps.
[*] Plus several bug and crash fixes!
[/list]Be sure to dive deep into the post below to get all of the juicy details before loading up the game and checking them out for yourself!

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Thanks again to our amazing community members, all of whom have helped to make [i]Age of Empires[/i] what it is today! Our [i]Age of Empires[/i] Fan Preview was a celebration of all of you, and the celebration continues in this event!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[hr][/hr][code][h1]         ◆ UPDATE 51737 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b][/h1]
[hr][/hr]While there are plenty of notable fixes and features to which to look forward in today’s build, here’s some of the big highlights coming with this month’s update:

[h3][b]Two New Civilizations![/b][/h3]
[b]The Poles[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/52cc6e20567fc6cad7bc3746cfbe0cddea9f8252.jpg[/img]
The [b]Poles[/b] are a cavalry civilization. While their western neighbors employed deadly companies of heavily armored cavalry, the Poles leveraged their strengths to evolve more towards what modern eyes might class as medium cavalry. While they could not always triumph over their rival counterparts on an individual basis, they emphasized maneuverability, organization, and sheer numbers at a time when warfare was shifting away from the typical medieval model.

[b]The Bohemians[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/2df655c9559bf640f10c693a6a9165076ddedca5.jpg[/img]
The [b]Bohemians[/b] are a gunpowder and monk civilization. Threatened both militarily and ideologically on nearly all sides, the Bohemians responded with groundbreaking innovations in both spheres. Novel weaponry, battle tactics, and defensive strategies shattered the numerous feudal and professional armies of their invading rivals, while scholarly thought and debate inaugurated one of the earliest successful social revolutions in early modern European history. Bohemian armies compensated for a lack of sheer brute strength with an uncanny ability to outwit, outmaneuver, and counter their opponents.

For a deep dive into the Poles and Bohemians, and more, view the official page for [i]Age of Empires II: Dawn of the Dukes[/i] right [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1557210]HERE[/url][/b]!

[h1][b]GAME[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]Stability & Performance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur under specific circumstances when selecting/interacting with control groups.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when the player sent messages in a Multiplayer lobby at the same time as the host closes the lobby.
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred when receiving an in-game invitation while playing a single player game and having the in-game menu open.
[*] Fixed a crash that consistently occurred in a custom scenario related to a unit transforming into another.
[*] Fixed a performance issue that occurred during the first few seconds of gameplay on many Random Map Scripts.
[*] Fixed a soft lock issue that could occur under specific circumstances when attempting to load into a match hosted by a user with a data mod enabled.
[*] Fixed a soft lock issue that could occur in-game when the resign dialogue was opened while the match ended.
[*] Fixed a crash/hard lock issue that could occur under specific circumstances when disconnecting from the internet during ranked matchmaking.
[/list]
[h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where terrain ambience tracks other than Forest ambience would fail to play. Terrain ambience types that can be heard in-game are as follows:
[list]
[*] Desert
[*] Fog
[*] Snow
[*] Jungle
[*] Lake
[*] Ocean
[*] Forest
[*] Plains
[/list]
[*] In Battle Royale game mode, a special kind of music now plays when the Corruption fog approaches your vicinity.
[*] Tweaked the way some melee attack sounds are played in large battles.
[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Post-game timelines now properly align players with their own graph, players are sorted by team (previously playernumber).
[*] The amount of secondary projectiles is now included in the attack display for units which fire several projectiles.
[*] Fixed an issue in MP lobbies with the “Hide Civilization” option enabled where players were able to see another player’s civilization when switching to their playercolor.
[*] Steam Users who want to create/edit clans no longer have to sign into Xbox Live to do so.
[*] Fixed an issue where several dialogs such as the Civilization selection dialog did not close when the user pressed the Escape key.
[*] When a player creates a MP lobby who has an out of date dataset mod a proper error message will now display explaining the issue.
[/list]

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Serjeants spawned by the First Crusade technology no longer default to using the aggressive stance when the Default Aggressive Unit Stance is disabled.
[*] The “going above and beyond” cheat code is now available to all players.
[/list]

[h1][b]CAMPAIGN[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
Adjusted several AI player controlled civilizations in various campaign missions for better historical accuracy, anticipating the launch of the new Dawn of the Dukes expansion:

[b]Genghis Khan[/b]
[list]
[*] Mission 5: Polish → Poles civ; Bohemians → Bohemians civ
[/list]

[b]Barbarossa[/b]
[list]
[*] Mission 1: Bohemia → Bohemians civ
[*] Mission 2: Poland → Poles civ
[/list]

[b]Ivaylo[/b]
[list]
[*] Mission 5: Poles → Poles civ
[/list]

[h3][b]Co-op[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased difficulty of the [b]Bapheus[/b] and [b]Hastings[/b] co-op scenario based on community feedback, especially on the hard difficulty level.
[/list]

[h1][b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Herbal Medicine[/b] cost reduced from [b]350g[/b] ▶ [b]200g[/b].
[/list]
[b]🡒 UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b](Elite) Steppe Lancer[/b]: reload time lowered [b]2.3[/b] ▶ [b]2.0[/b].
[*] [b]Hand Cannoneers[/b]: hitpoints increased from [b]35[/b] ▶ [b]40[/b].
[*] The speed of [b]Bullet[/b] projectiles increased from [b]5.5[/b] ▶ [b]7.5[/b].
[/list]
[h3][b]Burmese[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Howdah[/b]: Gives Battle Elephants +1/+2 armor (from [b]+1/+1[/b] ▶ [b]+1/+2[/b]).
[/list]
[h3][b]Byzantines[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 CIVILIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the hit points of [b]Watch Towers[/b] in the Castle Age and [b]Siege Workshops[/b] in the Imperial Age were lower than expected.
[/list]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Town Patrol[/b] is now free and instantly researched.
[/list]
[h3][b]Chinese[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 CIVILIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Team Bonus[/b] changed to [b]Farms[/b] +10% food (from [b]+45 food[/b] ▶ [b]+10% food[/b]).
[/list]
[h3][b]Cumans[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 CIVILIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Archery Ranges[/b] and [b]Stables[/b] now cost [b]-100 wood[/b].
[/list]
[h3][b]Lithuanians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 CIVILIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] Can now research and train the [b]Winged Hussar[/b] instead of Hussar.
[*] Lose access to the [b]Blast Furnace[/b]technology.
[/list]
[b]🡒 UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Leitis (Standard & Elite)[/b]: Increased attack from [b]12/14[/b] ▶ [b]13/16[/b].
[/list]
[h3][b]Malians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 CIVILIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Gold Mines[/b] last 30% longer (replaces the free Gold Mining technology bonus).
[/list]
[h3][b]Sicilians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 CIVILIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] The Sicilians now start with an extra [b]100 Stone[/b].
[*] [b]Team Bonus[/b] effect changed to remove the cost of the first trained [b]Transport Ship[/b] and train it instantly.
[/list]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b][strike]Scutage[/strike][/b]: replaced with the [b]Hauberk[/b] technology.
[*] [b]Hauberk[/b]: this unique technology grants [b]Knights +1 melee[/b] and [b]+2 pierce armor[/b].
[/list]

[h1][b]RANDOM MAPS[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr]
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Autumn season now includes the new birch tree type accompanying the new Dawn of the Dukes expansion 50% of the time.
[/list]
[h3][b]Map Updates[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Acclivity[/b]: Unbuildable rock terrain now generates exclusively on slopes, making it more evident where you can build and where you cannot.
[*] [b]Acclivity[/b]: Fixed a rare bug that caused one or more players to not generate forests around their initial town center.
[*] [b]Amazon Tunnel[/b]: Adjusted the carved player bases to have slightly more space and appear more natural.
[*] [b]Arabia[/b]: Each player now has 3 starting forests positioned towards the edge of the map.
[*] [b]Arabia[/b]: The players’ starting forests generate further away.
[*] [b]Arabia[/b]: The front of each player’s base is more open making it more vulnerable to attacks.
[*] [b]Arabia[/b]: Hills can now appear closer to players’ town centers.
[*] [b]Arabia[/b]: The third gold pile for each player is generated further away.
[*] [b]Arabia[/b]: Extra gold, stone, as well as relics, are now generated per player and therefore more fairly balanced.
[*] [b]Arabia[/b]: Slight variance has been added to the the circular positioning of players’ bases.
[*] [b]Arabia[/b]: Cliffs and water oases have been removed.
[*] [b]Arena[/b]: Improved the placement of lumbercamps on Empire Wars.
[*] [b]Frigid Lake[/b]: Minor aesthetic changes.
[*] [b]Lowland[/b]: Fixed a rare issue that could cause elevation to not generate properly across the entire map.
[*] [b]Marketplace[/b]: Minor aesthetic changes.
[*] [b]Migration[/b]: Relics now spawn correctly on all map sizes.
[*] [b]Northern Isles[/b]: Forests have been moved slightly further away from the player’s town centers.
[/list]We’re continuing to observe player feedback regarding all official random map scripts, Arabia has received an especially impactful update this time which we’ll be observing the effects of and plan further adjustments if necessary.
[h3][b]Random Map Scripting[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new way to paint actor areas without having to create objects, implemented new function: create_actor_area x y id radius.
[/list]

[h1][b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] Diplomacy options are no longer greyed out with non-AI players when the “Teams Locked” option is disabled (always enabled in ranked gameplay).
[*] Fixed an issue where players who join a lobby using an outdated data mod were booted from the lobby after downloading, with the civilization selection dialog still being open if opened in the lobby.
[*] Fixed an issue where hosts of Custom Scenario lobbies were unable to change their color until other people joined.
[/list]

[h1][b]AI[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized the AI players’ strategic decision-making in a wide variety of areas, including strategy selection.
[*] AI players are now less eager to pick a fight while critical army upgrades are still being researched.
[*] Improved the AI’s ability to advance to the next age earlier without sacrificing economy, with a bigger effect for certain civilizations.
[*] Improved performance on various different maps such as African Clearing.
[*] Fixed an issue with the AI’s dark age gatherer distribution calculation on nomad-style maps.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI players rarely didn’t ungarrison boats from their docks when expected.
[*] AI players may now task Serjeants to help construct Donjons instead of only using villagers.
[*] Extreme difficulty: Improvements to the effectiveness of the Militia rush strategy.
[*] Extreme difficulty: Implemented a completely new Scout Cavalry rush strategy which we’re keeping an eye on to improve.
[*] Extreme difficulty: Increased likelihood of AI players retreating their cavalry from enemy spearman type units.
[*] Extreme difficulty: Fixed an issue where the AI did not lure ibex to their towncenter to hunt as it would with deer or other similar animals.
[*] Extreme difficulty: The AI is more likely to succeed in saving a villager’s life that is being targeted by wild animals or enemy units by forcing it to garrison when possible and necessary.
[*] Fixed an issue where Cuman AI players didn’t advance past the Feudal Age in Deathmatch and Infinite Resources games.
[*] Improved AI player performance on Infinite Resources settings.
[*] The AI (HD Version) will no longer taunt the player with a betrayal message while unsuccessfully attempting to switch teams while a treaty is still ongoing.
[/list]
[h3][b]Pathfinding[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Units which were commanded using Attack Move no longer try to get into formation when reaching the destination they were sent to while enemy units are in sight instead of fighting those.
[/list]
[h3][b]Scripting[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Wall objects are now being detected when using position-target, position-focus or position-enemy.
[*] Fixed an issue with up-chat-data-to-player and up-chat-data-to-player-using-id where they did not always output chat to the intended player.
[/list]

[h1][b]LOCALIZATION[/b][/h1][hr][/hr][list]
[*] Added Polish language support!
[/list]

[h1][b]MODDING[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new flags for Blast Attack Level attribute to control the blast damage style:
[list]
[*] 4: Logistica style (5 damage to surrounding units).
[*] 8: War Elephant style (50% of the unit’s attack).
[*] 16: Battle Elephant style (25% of the unit’s attack).
[*] 32: Lechitic Legacy style (33% of the unit’s attack).
[*] 64: Reduces the blast damage with distance (works only for melee units).
[/list]
[*] Added new flag for Enable Smart Projectiles attribute:
[list]
[*] 2: Missed projectiles deal 100% of their damage if they hit another target (instead of the default 50%).
[/list]
[/list]
[h3][b]Scenario Editor[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Two new terrain types have been added accompanying the Dawn of the Dukes expansion’s release: Birch Forest and Swamp.
[*] The Change Object Civilization Name function now works with Set Area.
[*] Objects which were disabled in scenario can now properly be re-enabled later if the scenario game was loaded from a saved game file.
[*] Fixed a bug where researching the Anarchy technology by trigger for civilizations other than Goths didn’t enable Huskarls to be trained from the barracks.
[*] Added "Night" color mood.
[/list]
[h3][b]XS Scripting[/b][/h3]
The following commands have been added:
[list][*] xsGetRandomNumber()
[*] xsGetRandomNumberLH(int low, int high)
[*] xsGetRandomNumberMax(int max)[/list]

[hr][/hr][code][h1]            ◆ ONGOING ◆[/h1][/code][hr]
[/hr]
[h1][b]INVESTIGATION[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr]As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief update from our Production team regarding some of what is still in the works:
[list]
[*] [b]Alt+F4 & Queue Dodging:[/b] As a progress report, we’re continuing work on our solution for this and intend to push it Live as soon as it’s ready (and we’re as anxious as you are). We’ll be providing an information section in future patch notes once this change is ready to go Live so you know what to expect, and we’ll definitely want feedback and reaction – it’s our intent to monitor this issue and update our solution where users are continuing to try and exploit queues. 
[*] [b]Crashes and Freezes[/b]: As a reminder, player-reported issues (when they’re informational only) can be difficult for us to diagnose, and log files alongside a little bit of back and forth with our Support Team remain incredibly helpful. This shift toward working directly with our players to dig into the issues you’re reporting has allowed us to improve stability more quickly, and we’re anxious to keep this up. Here’s information that will help you work with our Teams when filing Support Requests –
[list]
[*] If your game is crashing, there’s a new type of log file that was introduced in the last patch, and it looks like this (example): [b]AoE2DESteam-46906-2021.04.06-15.46.57.mdmp[/b].
[*] The file can be found in this directory: C:\Users\[YOUR WINDOWS USERNAME]\Games\Age of Empires 2 DE\logs.
[*] The log file name specifies the game, platform you’re playing on, build version, and the date/time of the crash, and is specific to every instance – so if your game crashed earlier in the day and you’ve been playing since, you can still go back and find this file by matching it to when your issue occurred.
[*] Please attach this file in any Support Requests you submit regarding a crash, and if necessary we’ll reach back out for more information.
[*] You can reach out to our reach out to our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]Support Team[/url], and if you’re a Steam user, you may be directed to [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/aoe2de-update-46295/#pupp]PUP[/url] to help us confirm if we’ve been able to resolve your issue.
[/list][*] Polish language shows improper glyphs/characters if set to serif font.
[*] Italian VO is missing from Jadwiga 1.The Matter of the Crown intro cinematic.
[*] Duplicated Vietnamese and Vikings history articles appear in the end of history section.
[*] Poles and Bohemians civ names untranslated in Polish.
[*] Description of Poles Civ in Tech Tree unlocalized in Latin American Spanish.[/list]

[h1][b]PUBLIC UPDATE PREVIEW (PUP)[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr]April was the first time that we pushed balance changes to the PUP, and we’re thankful to our users who helped us identify bugs which we’ve since been able to address ahead of the the launch of this update.

We were also able to validate a fix for game freezing that wound up being pretty difficult to track down. The PUP continues to be one of our best tools for resolving complex issues, and we’ll be utilizing the PUP more and more in the months ahead.

You can find more information in the Steam forums when PUP builds are active (note: you must be logged into Steam to view the forum), and we invite you to participate with us as we take steps to make sure you’re having an enjoyable gaming experience.

[hr][/hr][code][h1]          ◆ MOD WARNING ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]Please note that custom mods may not be compatible with the latest game update. If you encounter performance or stability issues after your mods are disabled, please visit our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]support page[/url] for assistance!

[b]Team Bonus[/b] changed to [b]Farms[/b] +10% food (from [b]+45 food[/b] ▶ [b]+10% food[/b]).
[b]Archery Ranges[/b] and [b]Stables[/b] now cost [b]-100 wood[/b].
Can now research and train the [b]Winged Hussar[/b] instead of Hussar.
Lose access to the [b]Blast Furnace[/b]technology.
[b]Leitis (Standard & Elite)[/b]: Increased attack from [b]12/14[/b] ▶ [b]13/16[/b].
[b]Gold Mines[/b] last 30% longer (replaces the free Gold Mining technology bonus).
The Sicilians now start with an extra [b]100 Stone[/b].
[b]Team Bonus[/b] effect changed to remove the cost of the first trained [b]Transport Ship[/b] and train it instantly.
[b][strike]Scutage[/strike][/b]: replaced with the [b]Hauberk[/b] technology.
[b]Hauberk[/b]: this unique technology grants [b]Knights +1 melee[/b] and [b]+2 pierce armor[/b].

tags.feature: Autumn season now includes the new birch tree type accompanying the new Dawn of the Dukes expansion 50% of the time.

tags.bug: [b]Acclivity[/b]: Unbuildable rock terrain now generates exclusively on slopes, making it more evident where you can build and where you cannot.
[b]Acclivity[/b]: Fixed a rare bug that caused one or more players to not generate forests around their initial town center.

tags.balance_change: [b]Amazon Tunnel[/b]: Adjusted the carved player bases to have slightly more space and appear more natural.
[b]Arabia[/b]: Each player now has 3 starting forests positioned towards the edge of the map.
[b]Arabia[/b]: The players’ starting forests generate further away.
[b]Arabia[/b]: The front of each player’s base is more open making it more vulnerable to attacks.
[b]Arabia[/b]: Hills can now appear closer to players’ town centers.
[b]Arabia[/b]: The third gold pile for each player is generated further away.
[b]Arabia[/b]: Extra gold, stone, as well as relics, are now generated per player and therefore more fairly balanced.
[b]Arabia[/b]: Slight variance has been added to the the circular positioning of players’ bases.
[b]Arabia[/b]: Cliffs and water oases have been removed.
[b]Arena[/b]: Improved the placement of lumbercamps on Empire Wars.
[b]Frigid Lake[/b]: Minor aesthetic changes.

tags.bug: [b]Lowland[/b]: Fixed a rare issue that could cause elevation to not generate properly across the entire map.

tags.balance_change: [b]Marketplace[/b]: Minor aesthetic changes.

tags.bug: [b]Migration[/b]: Relics now spawn correctly on all map sizes.

tags.balance_change: [b]Northern Isles[/b]: Forests have been moved slightly further away from the player’s town centers.

tags.feature: Added a new way to paint actor areas without having to create objects, implemented new function: create_actor_area x y id radius.

tags.bug: Diplomacy options are no longer greyed out with non-AI players when the “Teams Locked” option is disabled (always enabled in ranked gameplay).
Fixed an issue where players who join a lobby using an outdated data mod were booted from the lobby after downloading, with the civilization selection dialog still being open if opened in the lobby.
Fixed an issue where hosts of Custom Scenario lobbies were unable to change their color until other people joined.

tags.balance_change: Optimized the AI players’ strategic decision-making in a wide variety of areas, including strategy selection.
AI players are now less eager to pick a fight while critical army upgrades still being researched.
Improved the AI’s ability to advance to the next age earlier without sacrificing economy, with a bigger effect for certain civilizations.
Improved performance on various different maps such as African Clearing.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue with the AI’s dark age gatherer distribution calculation on nomad-style maps.
Fixed an issue where AI players rarely didn’t ungarrison boats from their docks when expected.

tags.balance_change: AI players may now task Serjeants to help construct Donjons instead of only using villagers.
Extreme difficulty: Improvements to the effectiveness of the Militia rush strategy.
Extreme difficulty: Implemented a completely new Scout Cavalry rush strategy which we’re keeping an eye on to improve.
Extreme difficulty: Increased likelihood of AI players retreating their cavalry from enemy spearman type units.

tags.bug: Extreme difficulty: Fixed an issue where the AI did not lure ibex to their towncenter to hunt as it would with deer or other similar animals.

tags.balance_change: Extreme difficulty: The AI is more likely to succeed in saving a villager’s life that is being targeted by wild animals or enemy units by forcing it to garrison when possible and necessary.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where Cuman AI players didn’t advance past the Feudal Age in Deathmatch and Infinite Resources games.

tags.balance_change: Improved AI player performance on Infinite Resources settings.

tags.bug: The AI (HD Version) will no longer taunt the player with a betrayal message while unsuccessfully attempting to switch teams while a treaty is still ongoing.
Units which were commanded using Attack Move no longer try to get into formation when reaching the destination they were sent to while enemy units are in sight instead of fighting those.
Wall objects are now being detected when using position-target, position-focus or position-enemy.
Fixed an issue with up-chat-data-to-player and up-chat-data-to-player-using-id where they did not always output chat to the intended player.

tags.feature: Added Polish language support!
Added new flags for Blast Attack Level attribute to control the blast damage style:
Added new flag for Enable Smart Projectiles attribute:
Two new terrain types have been added accompanying the Dawn of the Dukes expansion’s release: Birch Forest and Swamp.

tags.bug: The Change Object Civilization Name function now works with Set Area.
Objects which were disabled in scenario can now properly be re-enabled later if the scenario game was loaded from a saved game file.
Fixed a bug where researching the Anarchy technology by trigger for civilizations other than Goths didn’t enable Huskarls to be trained from the barracks.

tags.feature: Added "Night" color mood.
