xsGetRandomNumberMax(int max)

tags.bug: Polish language shows improper glyphs/characters if set to serif font.
Italian VO is missing from Jadwiga 1.The Matter of the Crown intro cinematic.
Duplicated Vietnamese and Vikings history articles appear in the end of history section.
Poles and Bohemians civ names untranslated in Polish.
Description of Poles Civ in Tech Tree unlocalized in Latin American Spanish.

notes.title: Pre-Order Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition – Dawn of the Dukes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e668744eb684e2a6f512a29d3095253b37cddceb.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/age-of-empires-ii-definitive-edition-dawn-of-the-dukes/][i]Dawn of the Dukes[/i][/url], the second expansion for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] is now available for pre-order or to add to your wishlist. Here’s what it brings to [i]Age II: DE[/i]:
[list]
[*] Challenge friends with two all-new civilizations, each of which include new unique units and technologies.
[*] Battle your way across Central and Eastern Europe with three new campaigns, overwhelming your opponents with sheer military might and economic productivity or with highly disciplined and technologically innovative armies!
[*] New achievements to earn on your Xbox or Steam account! Check out the full list below.
[/list]
[i]Dawn of the Dukes[/i] will be released on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1557210]Steam[/url] on [b]August 10, 2021[/b]!

[h1]TWO NEW CIVILIZATIONS[/h1][hr][/hr][h3][b]The Poles[/b][/h3]
The [b]Poles[/b] are a cavalry civilization. While their western neighbors employed deadly companies of heavily armored cavalry, the Poles leveraged their strengths to evolve more towards what modern eyes might class as medium cavalry. While they could not always triumph over their rival counterparts on an individual basis, they emphasized maneuverability, organization, and sheer numbers at a time when warfare was shifting away from the typical medieval model.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/52cc6e20567fc6cad7bc3746cfbe0cddea9f8252.jpg[/img]

[b]▶︎ UNIQUE UNITS, BUILDINGS, AND TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [u][b]Obuch:[/b][/u] The Polish unique unit is the [b]Obuch[/b], a brutal infantryman whose war hammer tears the armor from enemy units. Obuchs are best used against expensive, heavily armored units that might otherwise pose a deadly threat to the rest of your army.
[*] [u][b]Winged Hussar:[/b][/u] The Poles also share a regional unit with the Lithuanians, their partners in their late-medieval commonwealth. This unit, the [b]Winged Hussar[/b], is a powerful upgrade to the Light Cavalry and replaces the Hussar upgrade that many other civilizations have.
[*] [u][b]Folwark:[/b][/u] Additionally, the Poles have a unique building, the [b]Folwark[/b], which replaces the Mill and increases the efficiency of nearby Farms.
[*] [u][b]Technologies:[/b][/u] Finally, the Poles have two unique technologies: [b]Szlachta Privileges[/b] and [b]Lechitic Legacy[/b]. Both of these provide powerful boosts to their roster of cavalry units.
[/list]

[h3][b]The Bohemians[/b][/h3]
The [b]Bohemians[/b] are a gunpowder and monk civilization. Threatened both militarily and ideologically on nearly all sides, the Bohemians responded with groundbreaking innovations in both spheres. Novel weaponry, battle tactics, and defensive strategies shattered the numerous feudal and professional armies of their invading rivals, while scholarly thought and debate inaugurated one of the earliest successful social revolutions in early modern European history. Bohemian armies compensated for a lack of sheer brute strength with an uncanny ability to outwit, outmaneuver, and counter their opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/2df655c9559bf640f10c693a6a9165076ddedca5.jpg[/img]

[b]▶︎ UNIQUE UNITS, BUILDINGS, AND TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [u][b]Hussite Wagon:[/b][/u] The first Bohemian unique unit is the [b]Hussite Wagon[/b], a deadly forerunner of the modern tank. Hussite Wagons possess strong firepower and are exceptional at protecting the units positioned behind them.
[*] [u][b]Houfnice:[/b][/u] The second Bohemian unique unit is the [b]Houfnice[/b], a powerful upgrade to the Bombard Cannon. Houfnices are adept at blasting enemy fortifications and formations to smithereens.
[*][u] [b]Technologies:[/b][/u] The Bohemians have two unique technologies: [b]Wagenburg Tactics[/b] and [b]Hussite Reforms[/b]. The former boosts their roster of gunpowder units, while the latter improves their Monks and Monasteries.
[/list]

[h1]THREE NEW, FULLY-VOICED CAMPAIGNS[/h1][hr][/hr][h3][b]Algirdas and Kestutis[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1efb4fb21830001dcffd8beebfe47fe43688a6d2.png[/img]
Faced with an impending invasion by the greedy Teutonic Knights, the small principality of Lithuania is on the brink of catastrophe. Divided and without wise leadership, the last pagans of Europe appear doomed, but Prince Algirdas and his loyal brother, Kestutis, refuse to bow to the marauders. Can they repel the crusaders and then contend with the grandsons of Genghis Khan — the fearsome horselords of the Golden Horde? In this campaign, you will play as the Lithuanians.

[h3][b]Jadwiga[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/77f80f5b8777fd1bdd35dfa1dbb345654bd739ae.png[/img]
Sent away from her mother and forcibly parted from the young man whom she loved, Jadwiga ascended to the Polish throne as a mere child. In a time of unending war, she must forge a future for her kingdom while contending with the wills of formidable leaders like Jogaila and Vytautas the Great. Can the beloved Star of the Poles bring about her vision of a powerful, united Poland-Lithuania, or will the incessant maelstrom of war plunge both realms into ruin once more? In this campaign, you will play as the Poles.

[h3][b]Jan Zizka[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/c0db50635e6c94bc5eadfe9ecbd883a3332df3ae.png[/img]
One-eyed Jan Zizka spent his youth as a mercenary fighting for honor and coin, but his destiny changed forever when he heard the preachings of the reformer Jan Hus in Prague. As a champion of the Hussite cause and the leader of its invincible armies, Zizka shattered existing notions of warfare with technological and tactical innovations. Cement the legacy of one of history’s greatest generals by galvanizing mere peasants into highly disciplined units and leading them to triumph over the Holy Roman Emperor’s knightly armies. In this campaign, you will play as the Bohemians.

[td]This achievement can be unlocked during the Jadwiga campaign.[/td]

[h1]PRE-ORDER NOW![/h1][hr][/hr]Pre-order [i]Dawn of the Dukes[/i] today and get ready to march into battle with the Bohemians and Poles as you guide your forces to victory on August 10, 2021! Or, pre-order [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] now and get the [i]Dawn of the Dukes[/i] expansion as a free bonus!

notes.title: Enjoy the Lords of the West Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/3dee7619de0ff47b6ff56b88b6300d67ebd9e074.jpg[/img]

[i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] is celebrating the month of July and [i]The Lords of the West[/i] with a unique Event!

While this Event is active, [b]everyone will be able to play as the Civilizations available in the popular expansion – the Burgundians and the Sicilians[/b]! This is true for all players, whether you own Lords of the West or not. The Civs will be playable in Multiplayer or Skirmish matches, and we’re including a fun group of Challenges specific to the Civs alongside some super cool rewards:
[list]
[*] Grab a spiffy new [b]Statue[/b] for your TCs!
[*] Enjoy some very unique [b]sand sculptures[/b]!
[*] Get some cosplay going for your [b]Knights[/b]!
[/list]

[table]
[tr]
[td]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/coustillier_on_boar-288x288.png[/img]
[/td]
[td]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/jacqueline_final-288x288.png[/img]
[/td]
[td]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/serjeant_building-288x288.png[/img]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[h1]New Rewards![/h1]
[b]Starting July 6th through July 20th[/b] complete the in-game tasks within the time limit to unlock exclusive rewards!

Don’t forget, the first challenge unlocks a new profile icon and is required to save all of your unlocks:

[code]🔒 [b]Sign into Xbox Live.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Jacqueline in her Auto[/b] profile icon.
💾 [b]*Required* if you want to save any rewards unlocked during the event![/b]
[/code]
Each of the following challenges must be unlocked in order and on separate days:
[code]🔒 [b]Win as the Burgundians.[/b]
🧱[Mod] Adds a statue of a [b]Coustillier[/b] located under the Town Center..

🔒 [b]Construct 3 Donjons.[/b]
🏆 Unlock a [b]Serjeant building a Donjon[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Win as the Sicilians.[/b] 
🧱[Terrain Mod] [b]Sand Donjons[/b] can now be found on beach terrain.

🔒 [b]Train 20 Coustilliers.[/b]
🏆 Unlock a [b]Coustillier Riding a Boar[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Train 50 Serjeants from Donjons.[/b]
🧱[Local Skin Mod] The Knight’s skin is replaced with [b]Roger Bosso[/b].
[/code]

[h1]Keep It All![/h1]
Remember: if you sign in to Xbox Live during the event, you’ll get to keep all of the mods and profile icons you’ve achieved! Sign in, earn your rewards, and enjoy!

We hope you enjoy your access to the [i]Lords of the West[/i] civilizations. If you enjoyed them and are interested in the Campaign content and learning more about this fascinating point in history, you can obtain those through Steam.

—The Age of Empires Team

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 50292
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/bbc5498fa9de205dfe65804e056587241d47b48b.png[/img]

Hello and welcome to another release filled with exciting updates, balance changes, and bug fixes for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]!

Today’s build brings a number of fixes to the game which reduce the likelihood of a freeze or client crash, as well as numerous other fixes and balance changes available for you to discover in this post below. Many of these changes and fixes are a direct result of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/3020197857796238160?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Public Update Preview program[/url] (or PUP). For more information on the PUPP—or to get involved—click the link above or scroll down to the [b]Ongoing → Public Update Preview Program (PUP)[/b] section of this post.

We’re pretty excited about making today’s build available to you – it contains a few pretty significant changes, including Co-Op! Below is a brief highlight to help break it all down:
[list]
[*] [b]Co-Op is now live![/b] You can read more about this new feature here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/813780/view/5464536257055952211]Co-Op Has Arrived[/url]!
[*] [b][i]Empire Wars[/i] now lives in the Ranked queue.[/b]
[*] We've made [b]CaptureAge[/b] easier than ever to use by adding UI support in Spectate (including in-game)/Replay menus.
[*] Lots and lots and lots of [b]bug fixes[/b] - these patch notes are long!
[*] [b]Balance[/b] changes!
[/list]
And much, much more! Be sure to dig down into the post below to get all of the juicy details before hopping in-game and checking them out firsthand.

[h1][b]GAME[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]Stability & Performance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game takes a long time to start up for players with large amount of graphical mods.
[*] Fixed an issue where graphics would sometimes disappear or flicker in long games.
[*] Greatly improved the performance impact of players experiencing hitches when advancing to the next age and are continuing to improve this performance.
[*] A warning is now displayed for players whose VRAM is below the min spec.
[*] Fixed various rendering related crashes.
[*] Fixed a rare crash when switching from Windowed to Fullscreen mode while in-game.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where players would crash in-game after only playing for a few seconds/minutes.
[*] Fixed a rare crash where people would attempt to change their profile icon while being temporarily disconnected from the internet.
[*] Fixed an issue where players became re-subscribed to event mods when they’re temporarily disconnected from the internet.
[*] Packing Town Center in Battle Royale now works correctly and no longer causes a crash.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur under very specific circumstances with CaptureAge installed. 
[*] Fixed a possible crash when trying to restore a Multiplayer game.
[*] Fixed a very rare audio related crash.
[/list]
[h3][b]Achievements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Players who earn an achievement on Steam can now also earn that achievement on Xbox Live if they sign in later and re-complete the achievement.
[/list]
[h3][b]Graphics[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where farms could turn partially invisible under certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed an issue where unit outlines would sometimes not display correctly at the edge of a building.
[*] The Sharkatzor cheat unit will no longer clip through objects, but will fly over them.
[*] Fixed an issue where move to arrow sometimes did not display when the camera was fully zoomed in.
[/list]
[h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] A new threatening yet familiar sound now plays when your enemy researches Atheism.
[*] A new sound now plays when your enemy researches the First Crusade, Cuman Mercenaries, or Flemish Revolution.
[*] AoE 1 priests now heal units louder.
[*] Gbetos now throw knives louder.
[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Unique Technologies for the Franks now have the correct default hotkeys.
[*] Buildings’ melee and pierce armor is now displayed on the UI when selecting a building.
[*] The in-game spectator icon now correctly displays for players from the winning team who have not quit the game yet.
[*] Fixed various UI issues where the text had incorrectly cut off.
[*] DM replays now correctly playback at the initial play speed.
[*] Negative armor values are now shown more clearly on the UI (only affects Rams & Siege Towers).
[*] Profile Icon in the profile manager is now immediately updated when selecting a new profile icon.
[*] Fixed an issue where Sans Serif Fonts could appear smudgy on specific UI screens.
[*] When spectating an AI, their technologies now correctly show in the global queue.
[*] It is now possible to see the 2nd tab of units in the dock in the Dark Age to see the future technologies and upgrades.
[*] The Malay loading screen tip no longer claims Malay have infinite fishing traps.
[*] The score and research panel display state now properly saves between watching various recorded/spectated games.
[*] Spectator count is no longer displayed when no players are spectating the game.
[*] The diplomacy screen now correctly displays player names that use Kanji symbols.
[*] Building Range Indicator brightness is no longer affected by the selected Grid Color when Player 
[*] Color Range Indicators are enabled.
[*] It is no longer possible to toggle the readiness indicator of players on the loading screen (this was only a visual check, it was not possible to “unready” players.)
[*] The aftermath timeline in a completed match's statistics now groups teams together for a clearer overview.
[*] Building Range Indicators no longer display for collapsing buildings.
[/list]
[h3][b]Accessibility[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed various issues with the Narrator feature within the accessibility options.
[/list]

[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]

[list]
[*] Fixed a legacy issue where it was possible to remove chopped straggler trees with foundations distantly. Now the foundation construction has to be started to remove the trees.

[*] Town Center foundations now display their correct range indicators.
[*] Fixed an issue where command queues would not work correctly when tasking Serjeants to build multiple Donjons.
[*] Fixed an issue where groups of moving Serjeants could stop when commanded to build a Donjon.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “Build Donjon” button would sometimes not show up when selecting Serjeants alongside other units.

[*] Fixed a legacy issue where farmers only work on the left side of a farm (they now work in the middle of the farm).
[*] Selecting “Random civilization” no longer picks a civilization chosen by another player.
[*] Scout line upgrades no longer change the stance of previously trained scout units.
[*] Garrisoning units into an allied Ram or Transport Ship will no longer lose vision when the player does not own a Market.
[*] Tatar sheep, Chinese and Mayan villager, and Inca llama spawn bonuses now work correctly on nomadic maps in games with Castle or higher age start.
[*] Fixed a rare legacy issue where Monks could lose their faith when converting a building in-group while being within a specific range of their target, yet not close enough to contribute to the conversion.
[*] Fixed various issues with foundations that are partially constructed in the fog of war and the black map.
[*] Fixed a legacy issue where Dolphins could be deleted by placing foundations on top of them.
[*] Gate placements no longer rotate when hovering them over unscouted walls and gates from other players in the fog of war.
[*] Parthian Tactics now correctly affects hero cavalry archer units.
[*] Fixed a rare issue that occurred in specific campaign missions where a ring of individually revealed cells of land appeared in previously unrevealed terrain.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where players could place a foundation on top of other player’s buildings on the edge of their line of sight.
[*] Players are no longer able to garrison their units into enemy Transports and Rams during the treaty timer.
[/list]

[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The starting setup on most of maps in Empire Wars game mode now includes 2 farms and farmers, 5 herdables and 6 shepherds, 4 foragers, 12 lumberjacks, and 4 gold miners. On specific maps, the assignment of food gatherers can differ.
[*] Also removed the chance of very distant secondary sheep and deer spawns.
[/list]
[h3][b]Map Balance[/b][/h3]
[b]Gold Rush:[/b]
[list]
[*] The starting gold mines now spawn further apart from each other.
[*] Bases are now more open and spawn without forests in front of them.
[*] Forests are now generally further away from TCs.
[*] Players now spawn slightly closer to the center of the map.
[*] The center of the map is now more central for players to be fairer for everyone.
[*] The hill in the middle of the map with the gold in it is now more prominent.
[*] The gold inside the central hill now features 5-tile gold piles and twice as many of them. However, the total gold is approximately 15% lower and is more scattered around.
[*] Also removed small lakes from spawning to better secure starting forests for players.
[/list]
[b]Golden Pit:[/b]
[list]
[*] Deer and other objects no longer appear on Death Match and infinite resources.
[/list]
[b]Team Islands:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the possibility of connected team islands.
[/list]
[h3][b]Random Map Scripting[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The maximum value in rnd(min,max) is now inclusive.
[*] Added min_connected_tiles parameter for object generation to determine the minimum amount of adjacent tiles required for the group to place tiles.
[*] Generating random maps with direct_placement in the scenario editor no longer breaks future random map generations in the same editor session.
[*] actor_area_to_place_in no longer disables max_distance_to_players.
[*] force_placement in small actor areas no longer produces excess objects.
[*] place_on_forest_zone now correctly places buildings larger than 1×1 tiles.
[*] set_avoid_player_start_areas now allows using a distance parameter.
[*] Added guard_state parameter for player setup, which can set if an object must be protected to get a resource trickle or avoid defeat.
[*] Sea Walls now properly generate Sea Gates instead of Palisade Gates.
[*] Actor areas are now optimized, so scripts using this functionality will load faster.
[*] Added accumulate_connections command for connection generation to allow stacking connections on top of previous ones.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused scripts using small actor areas to occasionally fail to spawn the desired number of objects.
[/list]

[h1][b]AI[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]

[list]

[*] Fixed an issue where military units sometimes ignored queued attack commands (SHIFT+CLICK).
[*] Units commanded to attack several targets using waypoints no longer fail to attack targets outside their range.
[*] Converted buildings no longer obstruct players while their destruction animation plays in RM/DM game modes.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where units tried to avoid no longer present objects when targeting solid objects, causing odd pathing quirks around seemingly invisible objects.
[*] Fixed a rare case where melee units could sometimes be undecisive while attacking enemy buildings next to enemy fortifications.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where Onagers pathed through trees after being command queued to target certain nearby trees.
[*] Fixed a legacy issue where Fishing ships sometimes attempted to drop off food to unreachable docks.
[*] Improved how vast amounts of Villagers path through narrow spaces.
[/list]

[*] Object Selected (MP) now correctly works with the Inverse condition in multiplayer.
[*] Display Timer Effect now correctly replaces the current timer ID when used again.
[*] The effect of Change Technology Cost no longer persists through non-scenario games.
[*] The effect of Change Object Player Color no longer makes the HP bar of the affected unit white.
[*] The Objects in Area condition now has an Object State dropdown.
[*] The effect of Change Technology Cost now uses more than one resource cost on techs that don’t have more than one resource cost by default. Canceling the tech returns original price 
[/list]

[hr][/hr][code][h1]            ◆ ONGOING ◆[/h1][/code][hr]
[/hr]
[h1][b]INVESTIGATION[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr]As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief update from our Production team regarding some of what is still in the works:
[list]
[*] [b]Alt+F4 & Queue Dodging[/b]: We’re aware and a fix is coming very soon. This is an issue we’ll be monitoring and managing on an ongoing basis once the solution is Live, to ensure that players who are using this tact to dodge queues aren’t finding new ways to abuse the system. Once this is Live we’ll want your feedback, so please go to our forums or Tweet at us and let us know how it’s performing. We’ll have more information shortly as we get closer to this change.
[*] [b]Crashes and Freezes[/b]: We’ve been busy fixing quite a few game crashes and freezes that users have reported through Support and PUP. In this process, what we’re observing is that player-reported issues (when they’re informational only) can remain pretty difficult for us to track down, but log files and a little bit of back and forth with our Support Team have been incredibly helpful. This shift toward working directly with our players to dig into the issues you’re reporting has allowed us to bring some big stability improvements to the game in a short amount of time, and we’re anxious to keep this up. Here’s some added information for you that will help our Teams work faster to provide solutions – 
[/list]

Fixed various issues with foundations that are partially constructed in the fog of war and the black map.

Fixed a rare issue that occurred in specific campaign missions where a ring of individually revealed cells of land appeared in previously unrevealed terrain.

notes.title: Custom Ranked DM
notes.content:
Hello Community!

Last month we let you know about our plans to [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/rankedtg-update-5-2021/]swap Deathmatch out from Ranked Matchmaking Queue in exchange for [b]Empire Wars[/b][/url]. What we weren’t ready to talk about yet, because we were still figuring out details, was the second piece of this change – how we intend to keep our competitive Deathmatch community in a good place. There were a lot of fantastic suggestions from you all on how to keep Deathmatch going which we greatly appreciated and now I think we have landed on a better solution. Thank you!

In a future update, we'll be adding functionality to the lobby system that includes "Custom Ranked DM". This will allow Deathmatch players to, optionally, compete for ELO using the game settings they are familiar with from the matchmaking queue.

We’ll be providing lots of that information closer to this change going live, but until then, here are some important bits things for you to know:
[list]

[*] This won’t be specific to a map pool, map choice is open to the lobby creator - this means Michi players can now play Ranked games!
[*] For now, this change is exclusive to Deathmatch
[*] Custom Ranked DM matches can be either 1v1 or TG
[*] Custom Ranked DM matches that are saved and restored will convert to unranked
[*] All current DM rankings will be carried forward to the new custom lobby-based system
[*] The decision on whether to create a "Ranked Lobby" will be made by the host on lobby creation
[*] There will be an option to limit the ELOs of joining players to a specific range
[/list]
Deathmatch will be the first mode to receive Custom Ranked support, and if we see good results (sentiment & matchmaking quality), we’ll look at adding ranked ELO to more game modes. That means that as other modes increase in popularity, we’ll slowly layer in (optional) competitive-friendly features for them. The system we are envisioning will have three levels, beginning with unranked Custom Lobbies for all modes (currently available), graduating to the DM implementation where there are things like standard competitive settings and ELO, and finally landing at Ranked Matchmaking. Modes will move up or down in this “graduation system” based on the number of daily matches being played and Community feedback, so in essence – we are putting YOU, our Community, in the driver’s seat for what happens with competitive play in the game.

For those of you that have been passionate about your favorite modes of play for many, many years, and are actively trying to build the eSports footprint, our interest is in making sure we can support that passion.

Once the Custom Ranked DM lobby system is implemented, you’ll probably see us tweak settings based on your feedback, so please keep engaging on forums and Discord. Hopefully those of you who joined the #SaveDM effort feel heard and validated with this move. We really do appreciate the time and effort you all spent giving us feedback on how to make the game better.

See you in the lobbies!

[b]—Will McCahill[/b]
[i]The Age of Empires Team[/i]

[i][b]PS. Empire Wars is still coming to Ranked Queue next patch![/b][/i]

notes.title: Co-Op has Arrived in June’s Public Update Preview!
notes.content:
[h1]The Battles Await![/h1]
[hr][/hr]It’s finally here—[b]Co-Op for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] has arrived![/b] Launching today in the [b]Public Update Preview[/b] on Steam, [b]Co-Op is now playable and will soon make its way into the Live game[/b]. What’s more fun than leading the charges down the Roman Empire as Atilla the Hun? Charging down the Roman legions with a friend by your side!

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/coop_screenshot_1_twin_bases.png[/img]

With today’s PUP build, we’ll start gathering your feedback and making changes in prep for the complete launch of all Co-Op content in a future update—So make sure you let us know what you think! You’ll find plenty of information below around how to get access, where to leave your feedback, and how we plan to follow up.

For now, here’s the TLDR:

[quote][list]
[*]Co-Op begins Preview today with [b]5 Historical Battles[/b], specifically selected because of how much fun they create as Co-Op scenarios.
[*]This Preview version of Co-Op will then go [b]Live in our next Update[/b].
[*]As we gather your feedback and make those changes, we’ll be readying the release of Co-Op Campaign content, [b]which includes 33 Missions selected from across 6 different Campaigns[/b].
[/list][/quote]
[hr][/hr][h1]Co-Op Content Breakdown:[/h1][hr][/hr]
If you’re curious about exactly which Historical Battle and Campaign Missions you’ll be able to play with friends, we’re providing a full breakdown here:

First up, these are the [b]Co-Op Historical Battles you can play today in PUP[/b]:
[list]
[*]Tours
[*]Hastings
[*]Honfoglalas
[*]Kurikara
[*]Bapheus
[/list]Then, as we work with your feedback, we’ll be[b] fully launching Co-Op in a future update[/b] including all of the following Co-Op Campaign content:

[b]Saladin[/b]
[list]
[*]An Arabian Knight
[*]Lord of Arabia
[*]The Horns of Hattin
[*]The Siege of Jerusalem
[*]Jihad!
[*]The Lion and the Demon
[/list]
[b]Attila the Hun[/b]
[list]
[*]The Scourge of God
[*]The Great Ride
[*]The Walls of Constantinople
[*]A Barbarian Betrothal
[*]The Battle of the Catalaunian Fields
[*]The Fall of Rome
[/list]
[b]Alaric[/b]
[list]
[*]The Battle of the Frigidus
[*]Razing Hellas
[*]The Belly of the Beast
[*]The Giant Falls
[*]A Kingdom of our Own
[/list]
[b]Tariq ibn Ziyad[/b]
[list]
[*]The Battle of Guadalete
[*]Consolidation and Subjugation
[*]Divide and Conquer
[*]Crossing the Pyrenees
[*]Razzia
[/list]
[b]Suyavarman I[/b]
[list]
[*]Usurpation
[*]Quelling the Rebellion
[*]A Dangerous Mission
[*]Challenging a Thalassocracy
[*]Nirvanapada
[/list]
[b]Tamerlane[/b]
[list]
[*]Amir of Transoxiana
[*]Gurkhan of Persia
[*]Harbinger of Destruction
[*]Sultan of Hindustan
[*]Scourge of the Levant
[*]A Titan Amongst Mortals
[/list]
[hr][/hr][h1]Preview Version:[/h1][hr][/hr]
You can access Co-Op through PUP (Public Update Preview) on Steam. To access the build:

[quote][list]
[*]Locate [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] in your Steam Games Library.
Right-click the game title and select  Properties at the bottom of the menu.
[*]In the window that appears, select the BETAS tab on the left.
[*]You’ll then be on the BETAS tab, and you’ll see a dropdown labeled “Select the beta you would like to opt into” – you should see an item labeled “pup_june – Public Update Preview – June” and you’ll want to select that.
[*]Your game will then receive an update, and you can launch the game from there!
[*]To return to the Live game, simply repeat steps 1-3, and once on the BETAS tab select NONE in the list. Your game will then update back to the Live build.[/list][/quote]
This puts Co-Op in your hands [i]right now[/i], and we anxiously await your feedback!

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/coop_screenshot_3_shared_defense.png[/img]

[hr][/hr][h1]Where to Find Co-Op:[/h1][hr][/hr]
You can access Co-Op content from a few different places in the UI:

[quote][list]
[*]There is a [b]Co-Op button[/b] in the [b]Main Menu UI[/b].
[*]From the Main Menu UI, you can also click [b]Single Player -> Campaigns – > Co-Op Campaigns[/b], select your Mission, then invite a friend to join your Co-Op Lobby.
[*]Alternatively, from the Main Menu UI, you can click [b]Multiplayer -> Host Game -> and create a Co-Op enabled Custom Lobby[/b].
[*]Finally, from the [b](Custom) Lobby Browser[/b], you can search for Co-Op Lobbies using the [b]Game Mode filter for “Co-Op Campaign”[/b].[/list][/quote]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/coop_screenshot_2_lobby.png[/img]

[hr][/hr][h1]How and Where to Provide Feedback:[/h1][hr][/hr]
While Co-Op is in PUP, you’ll be able to provide feedback in our normal “Public Update Preview – June” Steam forum, located here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/8/

[code]*NOTICE: you must be logged into Steam to see and contribute to the forums above.[/code]
Once Co-Op makes it live in a future update, we’ll provide Co-Op specific forum options where you can leave feedback and let us know what you think!

[hr][/hr][h1]What to Expect from Co-Op:[/h1][hr][/hr]
Co-Op Historical Battles and Campaigns bring a cooperative Multiplayer experience to the vivid story-driven Campaign content you’ve been playing for so many years, making it feel pretty new and different from how you’ve experienced it all up to this point. We’re genuinely thrilled to see how you like it, and also use your feedback to improve what’s there before releasing all of the remaining content that’s waiting for you!

You can expect all the same Campaign quality you know, and you get to bring a friend:

[quote][list]
[*]Story-driven historical narratives and objectives.
[*]That same Age of Empires II gameplay you know.
[*]In-game dialogue (fully voiced in all supported languages).
[*]Beautifully crafted maps.
[*]Additionally, all AI players have been updated to now fight against two opponents instead of one. You’ll need to coordinate to conquer![/list][/quote]
Good luck!
[i]—The Age of Empires Team[/i]

notes.title: Join the Celebrating the Ages Event!
notes.content:
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Musketeer-Fighting.jpg[/img]

With all the announcements from [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/afp-recap-2021/]Age Fan Preview Event[/url], there couldn't be a better time to celebrate the [i]Age of Empires[/i] series!

In 1997 the original Age of Empires was released, the beginning of us all coming together to create the fantastic and passionate community we are today. This month, we're bringing community favorites to Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition!  Plus, for this months event we're adding some additional bonus rewards from the last year of [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] events!

Join us as we celebrate the incredible community, moments and experiences the [i]Age of Empires[/i] series created in the CELEBRATING-THE-AGES event!
[list]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 47820
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/bbc5498fa9de205dfe65804e056587241d47b48b.png[/img]

Hello and welcome to another release filled with exciting updates, balance changes, and bug fixes for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]!

Today’s build brings a number of fixes to the game which reduce the likelihood of a freeze or client crash, as well as numerous other fixes and balance changes available for you to discover in this post below. Many of these changes and fixes are a direct result of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/3020197857796238160?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Public Update Preview program[/url] (or PUPP). For more information on the PUPP—or to get involved—click the link above or scroll down to the [b]Ongoing → Public Update Preview Program (PUPP)[/b] section of this post.

Now, let’s take a quick look at some of the changes coming with today’s update:
[list][*] Celebrate all things [i]Age of Empires [/i]with the brand-new [b]Celebrating the Ages[/b] event, where you can unlock awesome rewards.
[*] Numerous [b]crash and freeze fixes[/b], helping to provide a more stable gameplay experience.
[*] Added [b]Building Range Indicators[/b] as an option in the [b]Options → Game[/b] section.
[/list]And much, much more! Be sure to dig down into the post below to get all of the juicy details before hopping in-game and checking them out firsthand.

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Thanks again to our amazing community members, all of whom have helped to make [i]Age of Empires[/i] what it is today! Our [i]Age of Empires[/i] Fan Preview was a celebration of all of you, and the celebration continues in this event!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team


[hr][/hr][code][h1]         ◆ UPDATE 47820 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b][/h1]
[hr][/hr]Alongside plenty of fixes and features which are included in today’s build, this time we bring you the Celebrating the Ages event as we follow up to the large celebration that was the [i]Age of Empires[/i] Fan Preview!

[h3][b]The Celebrating the Ages Event[/b][/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/AgeCelebration_1920x1080.jpg[/img][code][h3]🤍 MAY 3 through MAY 24[/h3][/code]There couldn’t be a better time to celebrate the [i]Age of Empires[/i] series than after the announcements of the [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/afp-recap-2021/]Age Fan Preview event[/url]! And this time, we're bringing some community favorites to [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition![/i] Join us as we celebrate the incredible community, moments, and experiences the Age of Empires series created during the [b]CELEBRATING-THE-AGES[/b] event!

[table][tr]
[td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/GeorgeCrushington.jpg[/img][/td]
[td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Sharkatzor.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/JohnTheFearless.png[/img][/td]
[/tr][/table]
[b]🡒 NEW REWARDS![/b]
[b]Starting TODAY through MAY 24,[/b] complete in-game tasks to unlock a ton of themed goodies! In addition to the normal daily rewards, we’ve added two additional bonus challenges to this event!
[code]🎯 [b]Sign into Xbox Live.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]George Crushington[/b] profile icon.
💾 [b]*Required* if you want to save any rewards unlocked during the event![/b][/code][code]🎯 [b]Unlock the “21st Century” achievement in [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i].[/b]
⌨️ Unlocks the [b]“photon man“[/b] cheat code which spawns a Photon Man cheat unit.
💾 [b]Requires Xbox Live Sign in to verify achievement.[/b][/code][code]🎯 [b]Unlock the “Imperial Age” achievement in [i]Age of Empires 3: Definitive Edition[/i]. Requires Xbox Live Sign in to verify achievement.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks a mod that [b]replaces the Hand Cannoneer skin with the Musketeer skin[/b] from [i]Age of Empires 3[/i].
💾 [b]Requires Xbox Live Sign in to verify achievement.[/b][/code]Each of the following challenges must be unlocked in order and on separate days:
[code]🔒 [b]Gather 1997 Gold in any one game[/b]
🧱 [Mod] Unlocks a mod that replaces the [b]Military unit creation sound[/b] with the version from AoE:DE. 

🔒 [b]Use the “catzor” cheat code in a skirmish game to summon the Sharkatzor cheat unit[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Sharkatzor[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Train 10 Camel Riders in any one game[/b]
⌨️ Unlocks the [b]“cameleon”[/b] cheat code, which transforms Camel units owned by any player into Flaming Camels.

🔒 [b]Kill 5 enemy villagers in any one game[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]John the Fearless[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Reach the Imperial Age in any one game[/b]
🧱 [Mod] Unlocks a mod that replaces the [b]Age Advancement sound[/b] with the “Shipment becomes available” sound from AoE3:DE.
[/code]
[b]🡒 KEEP IT FOREVER!![/b]
Remember: if you sign in to Xbox Live at any point during the event, you get to keep all the mods and profile icons you unlock! Sign in, earn your rewards, and enjoy!

We hope you enjoy our Celebrating the Ages event!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team


[h1][b]GAME[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]Stability & Performance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the game to crash when checking whether a specific building foundation is obstructed when it no longer exists.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the game to freeze during the first few minutes of gameplay, or later in very rare cases.
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause a freeze when using the ‘Select All’ hotkey for a specific building type which includes foundations that are still under construction.
[*] Fixed a rare crash that could occur when creating a Multiplayer lobby.
[*] Fixed several crashes that could occur during game startup.
[*] Fixed a crash that would occur when attempting to watch a replay of a [i]Lords of the West[/i] campaign without owning the expansion.
[*] Fixed an extremely rare crash that could occur when two players resigned at exactly the same time.
[*] Fixed a crash that would occur when using an outdated data mod that hadn’t been updated to account for the new civilizations introduced in the [i]Lords of the West[/i] expansion.
[*] Fixed a Scenario Editor crash that could occur when generating a custom Random Map, reducing the amount of players and map size, and then generating it again.
[*] Fixed a crash that would occur when attempting to play with a modified data file containing more than 1701 units.
[/list]
[h3][b]Achievements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]‘Smoke in the water’[/b] achievement can now be unlocked, as intended, in the Lake Poyang Historical Battle.
[*] The [b]'Turkish delight'[/b] achievement can now be unlocked, as intended by defeating all other Turkish factions without forming an alliance with them.
[/list]
[h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3]
[list][*] The [i]♪ Burgundian ♪[/i] and [i]♪ Sicilian ♪[/i] themes will now play for the full duration of their tracks.
[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[b]Building Range Indicators[/b] have been added as an option in the [b]Options → Game[/b] section. Depending on the selected option, range indicators are shown for all buildings with a ranged attack:
[list]
[*] [b]At All Times[/b]
[*] [b]When Selected[/b]
[*] [b]Never[/b]
[/list]
The color of the range indicator mirrors the [b]Terrain Grid Color[/b] by default, but can (alternatively) be changed to the [b]Player Color[/b] of the selected building’s owner.
[list]
[*] Double-clicking a civilization in the civilization selection screen will now select it without having to press the ‘Confirm’ button.
[*] Fixed a very rare issue where it was possible to disable in-game notifications with no way to re-enable them.
[*] Fixed a purely visual bug in the UI where Viking militia-line units displayed a higher hit point value than the maximum hit points allowed.
[*] The [b]Bulgarian[/b] Technology Tree no longer states that the stone cost-reduction to construct Town Centers is only effective as of Castle Age; the bonus is now in effect starting in the Dark Age, as previously.
[/list]
[h3][b]Accessibility[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] In the Ranked Matchmaking window, the Preferred/Banned Map screens can now be navigated using the keyboard for each game type.
[*] In the Mod Manager, the [b]‘Check For Update’[/b] button can now be accessed using the keyboard.
[*] Fixed an issue which made it difficult to consistently navigate between the different Multiplayer tabs (Ranked, Lobby, etc.) using the keyboard.
[*] When chat narration is enabled, the Narrator now acknowledges the first letter of words when reading through in-game updates.
[*] The Narrator no longer skips the first two letters of other notifications.
[*] The Narrator no longer reads out “icon 1” and “icon 2” rather than reading the descriptive text of images in the [b]‘Select Icon’[/b] window.
[/list]

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] [b]Scorpion[/b]: No longer spawns on Aggressive Stance when the Default Aggressive stance is disabled.
[*] Issuing a move command to a [b]Monk[/b] who is already navigating to pick up a Relic will no longer cause the Monk to stop entirely.
[/list]

[h1][b]CAMPAIGN[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] [b]Kotyan Khan 4: ‘Blood for Blood’[/b]: The final objective of the mission can no longer be completed before other primary objectives.
[*] Fixed various minor issues throughout the [b]Edward Longshanks[/b] campaign of the Lords of the West expansion.
[/list]

[h1][b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Elite Steppe Lancer [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reduced gold cost from [b]45 ▶ 40 gold[/b].
[/list]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] The [b]Cannon Galleon[/b] technology is no longer required to train the unit. Instead, researching [b]Chemistry[/b] now unlocks the ability to train Cannon Galleons.
[/list]
[h3][b]Burgundians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 CIVILIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the amount of food generated by [b]Relics[/b] from [b]20 ▶ 30[/b] food/minute, which now mirrors the generation rate of gold.
[*] The food cost of economy upgrades is now reduced by [b]50%[/b] in addition to being available one Age earlier.
[/list]
[b]🡒 UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Flemish Militia:[/b] Reduced attack versus cavalry from [b]12 ▶ 8[/b].
[*] [b]Flemish Militia:[/b] Reduced attack versus camels and ships from [b]8 ▶ 6[/b].
[/list]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Burgundian Vineyards[/b]: Now converts [b]half[/b] of all food into gold rather than the entire stockpile.
[*] [b]Burgundian Vineyards[/b]: Increased the rate at which farmers generate gold by [b]+33%[/b].
[/list]
[h3][b]Cumans[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 CIVILIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the team bonus health granted to palisade walls from [b]+50% ▶ +33%[/b]
[/list]
[h3][b]Franks[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Bearded Axe[/b]: Now available in the [b]Castle Age[/b] (was Imperial Age).
[*] [b]Bearded Axe[/b]: Reduced the cost to research from [b]400 food, 400 gold ▶ 300 food, 300 gold[/b].
[*] [b]Chivalry[/b]: Now available in the [b]Imperial Age[/b] (was Castle Age).
[*] [b]Chivalry[/b]: Increased the cost from [b]400 wood, 400 gold ▶ 600 wood, 500 gold[/b].
[/list]
[h3][b]Incas[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 CIVILIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] Villagers now gain the benefits of Blacksmith upgrades starting in the [b]Castle Age[/b].
[/list]
[h3][b]Malay[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 CIVILIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Fish Traps[/b] now provide [b]+300%[/b] food as opposed to an unlimited amount.
[*] [b]Battle Elephants[/b] now cost [b]-30% in the Castle Age[/b] and [b]-40% in the Imperial Age[/b].
[/list]
[b]🡒 UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Karambit Warrior [Standard & Elite][/b]: Increased attack from [b]6/7 ▶ 7/8[/b].
[/list]
[h3][b]Mongols[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Mangudai [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reduced speed from [b]1.45 ▶ 1.4[/b].
[/list]
[h3][b]Portuguese[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Organ Gun [Standard & Elite][/b]: Secondary projectiles now consistently deal [b]2[/b] damage as opposed to [b]1 or 2[/b] depending on whether they hit their primary target.
[/list]
[h3][b]Sicilians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 CIVILIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] Now receive access to the [b]Siege Onager[/b] upgrade.
[/list]
[b]🡒 UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Serjeant[/b]: Increased Feudal Age melee armor from [b]1 ▶ 2[/b].
[*] [b]Serjeant[/b]: Increased Castle Age hit points from [b]60 ▶ 65[/b].
[*] [b]Elite Serjeant[/b]: Increased hit points from [b]75 ▶ 85[/b].
[*] [b]Donjon[/b]: Reduced the stone cost to build from [b]200 ▶ 175[/b].
[/list]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]First Crusade:[/b] As an added effect, the technology now also improves all Sicilian units’ resistance to conversion.
[/list]

[h1][b]RANDOM MAPS[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]NEW MAPS![/b][/h3]
Five brand-new maps have been added to the map pool:

[table][tr]
[td][img]https://forums.ageofempires.com/uploads/default/original/3X/d/e/de1298d46975e8b3f7bff598058534b4b729092a.png[/img][/td]
[td][b]Crater[/b]
“In the depths of a Siberian forest, an ash-covered wasteland appears, offering little shelter but plenty in gold and riches.”[/td]
[/tr][tr]
[td][img]https://forums.ageofempires.com/uploads/default/original/3X/8/3/83cb4d45c258bf8174b48892851a903825d5b9ea.png[/img][/td]
[td][b]Crossroads[/b]
“Four forest-capped hills loom at the center, serving as the only source of wood and rendering the paths between them most treacherous.”[/td]
[/tr][tr]
[td][img]https://forums.ageofempires.com/uploads/default/original/3X/7/1/7122286d4adcb697c591dbe2be42157c98398186.png[/img][/td]
[td][b]Michi[/b]
“An impenetrable forest separates the teams of players, until one breaks through and draws the first blood on this infamous battlefield.”[/td]
[/tr][tr]
[td][img]https://forums.ageofempires.com/uploads/default/original/3X/d/7/d7a61015d3848748259e451b1fa7a47ee2b74236.png[/img][/td]
[td][b]Team Moats[/b]
“The surrounding streams offer little but a false sense of security. And with little room for expansion, players must soon break out and claim the vast lands around.”[/td]
[/tr][tr]
[td][img]https://forums.ageofempires.com/uploads/default/original/3X/8/1/8193ef3d7cf500d5a6987f201fef8e8bf2d932b1.png[/img][/td]
[td][b]Volcanic Island
[/b]
“With stone scattered around in the shallows, the once fire-breathing mountain has since overgrown with lush vegetation and now awaits to be conquered.”[/td]
[/tr][/table]
[h3][b]Map Balance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Baltic[/b]: On Tiny, Small, and Medium map sizes, the number of Relics now correctly scale and spawn based on the number of players actually present on the map.
[*] [b]Migration[/b]: Players’ starting islands now always touch the edges of the map to prevent a channel around to the back of the island.
[*] [b]Migration[/b]: Increased the width of the water channels between the players and the mainland.
[*] [b]Migration[/b]: Increased the size of the mainland and created a more consistent shape across map variants.
[*] [b]Migration[/b]: Forests on the mainland now grow in larger groupings and can appear closer to the coastline, allowing for more open space inland.
[*] [b]Migration[/b]: Increased the amount of gold and stone on the map to more closely match the standard amounts, though the number of resource nodes can vary slightly.
[*] [b]Migration[/b]: Berries no longer grow close to the water.
[*] [b]Migration[/b]: Cliffs no longer spawn on the Tiny (1v1) map size.
[*] [b]Seize the Mountain[/b]: Slightly reduced the amount of forest generated on the map.
[*] [b]Seize the Mountain[/b]: Adjusted the forests on smaller map sizes to make the map less easy to wall.
[*] [b]Seize the Mountain[/b]: Reduced the size of the mountain on smaller map sizes to allow for more playable space.
[*] [b]Seize the Mountain[/b]: Improved the balance of starting forests in 3v3 and 4v4 settings.
[*] [b]Seize the Mountain[/b]: On smaller map sizes, the mainland now spawns further from the map edges to prevent players from walling to the edge of the map with a Dock.
[*] [b]Hideout[/b]: Secondary gold and stone piles—as well as other resources which were meant to spawn outside of the player’s walls—can no longer appear within the walls of an elongated base.
[*] [b]Fortress[/b]: Fixed an issue which would create empty areas of the map.
[*] [b]Fortress[/b]: Towers are now spaced more evenly.
[/list]

[h1][b]AI[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where AI players would issue orders repeatedly, causing undesirable side effects such as unit stuttering.
[*] Boar lurers garrisoned by the AI in a Town Center to avoid the boar’s attacks will now, rather than hiding in the Town Center for extended periods of time, ungarrison once the boar swaps to a new target.
[/list]
[h3][b]Pathfinding[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare, persistent issue where units would defy the rules of space and time to path through walls and attack enemy units.
[*] Fixed an issue where lumberjacks could become idle after tasking them to trees using command queue.
[*] Fixed an issue where builders would refuse to path to a foundation if blocked or locked within walls during a previous attempt to reach the site.
[*] Villagers working on a Farm will no longer move around the farm more than four times before dropping off food. This should make their harvesting efficiency more consistent.
[*] Fixed an edge case where huntable wild animals, such as a boar, would stop chasing the boar lurer despite them still being within the boar’s line of sight.
[/list]
[h3][b]Scripting[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]can-train, up-can-train, train[/b], or [b]up-train[/b] commands now allow for [b]-1[/b] to be passed into them instead of causing a game crash.
[*] [b]up-remaining-boar-amount[/b] now also works on living boars, as intended.
[*] Stacked [b]find-status-remote[/b] searches no longer erroneously reset search indexes.
[*] Introduced [b]sn-enable-research-queue[/b] to control whether AI players can (or cannot) queue technologies along with units when [b]sn-enable-training-queue[/b] is enabled. [b]sn-enable-research-queue[/b] is set to [b]0[/b] by default, and can be set to [b]1[/b] to enable.
[*] [b]sn-number-tasked-units[/b] now works as intended when used with [b]up-target-objects[/b] or [b]up-target-point[/b].
[/list]

[h1][b]MODDING[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new [b]Blast Defense Level[/b] attribute in data for scenarios and RandomMapScripts. It has the same functionality as the blast defense level field in unit data.
[*] Added a new [b]Object Hotkey[/b] attribute in data for scenarios and RandomMapScripts. It has the same functionality as the Hotkey field in unit data.
[/list]
Added new flags for [b]Hero Status[/b] attribute to control hero properties individually:
[list]
[*] [b]2[/b]: cannot be converted
[*] [b]4[/b]: auto-healing
[*] [b]8[/b]: default defensive stance
[*] [b]16[/b]: protected formation
[*] [b]32[/b]: safe delete confirmation
[/list]
The flags can be combined with each other, or flag 1 can be used to enable full hero status.
[list]
[*] The [b]Regeneration Rate[/b] attribute now determines the number of hit points a given unit regenerates in a minute. The Regeneration task in the unit data is no longer required. The Regeneration Rate attribute has no effect for units with Hero Status flag [b]1[/b] (full hero status) or [b]2[/b] (auto-healing), which regenerate at the fixed 30 hit points/min rate.
[/list]


[hr][/hr][code][h1]            ◆ ONGOING ◆[/h1][/code][hr]
[/hr]
[h1][b]INVESTIGATION[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr]As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief update from our Production team regarding some of what is still in the works:
[list]
[*] [b]Crashes and Freezes[/b]: This Update delivers several fixes that address game crashes and freezing. Addressing these types of problems remains a priority for us when we’re able to get actionable information about what users are experiencing and why those problems are occurring. We continue to monitor these issues where reported by users and ask that you [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]reach out to our Support Team[/url] for solutions and to provide our team with more information about the issue should you encounter them. As part of this process, you may be asked to submit files that give us important information about why you’re experiencing problems, and perhaps even directed to [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/aoe2de-update-46295/#pupp]PUPP[/url] to help us confirm if we’ve been able to resolve your issue.
[/list]For other known issues, please visit [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/articles/360049490811-Known-Issues-Solutions]this page[/url] to see what’s being tracked!


[h1][b]WHAT'S ON THE HORIZON[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr]During the recent [b]Age of Empires Fan Preview Event[/b], we announced both [b]Dawn of the Dukes[/b] and that [b]Coop is coming to the game[/b]!

We’ll have more details on both of these announcements in the coming months, so stay tuned to our channels for more information!

PS: We’re pretty hyped and excited to get this into your hands 🙂


[h1][b]PUBLIC UPDATE PREVIEW (PUPP)[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr]April was the first time that we pushed balance changes to the PUP, and we’re thankful to our users who helped us identify bugs which we’ve since been able to address ahead of the the launch of this update.

We were also able to validate a fix for game freezing that wound up being pretty difficult to track down. The PUP continues to be one of our best tools for resolving complex issues, and we’ll be utilizing the PUP more and more in the months ahead.

You can find more information in the Steam forums when PUP builds are active (note: you must be logged into Steam to view the forum), and we invite you to participate with us as we take steps to make sure you’re having an enjoyable gaming experience.


[hr][/hr][code][h1]          ◆ MOD WARNING ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]Please note that custom mods may not be compatible with the latest game update. If you encounter performance or stability issues after your mods are disabled, please visit our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]support page[/url] for assistance!

tags.feature: Celebrate all things Age of Empires with the brand-new Celebrating the Ages event, where you can unlock awesome rewards.

tags.bug: Numerous crash and freeze fixes, helping to provide a more stable gameplay experience.

tags.feature: Added Building Range Indicators as an option in the Options → Game section.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue that could cause the game to crash when checking whether a specific building foundation is obstructed when it no longer exists.
Fixed an issue that could cause the game to freeze during the first few minutes of gameplay, or later in very rare cases.
Fixed an issue that would cause a freeze when using the ‘Select All’ hotkey for a specific building type which includes foundations that are still under construction.
Fixed a rare crash that could occur when creating a Multiplayer lobby.
Fixed several crashes that could occur during game startup.
Fixed a crash that would occur when attempting to watch a replay of a Lords of the West campaign without owning the expansion.
Fixed an extremely rare crash that could occur when two players resigned at exactly the same time.
Fixed a crash that would occur when using an outdated data mod that hadn’t been updated to account for the new civilizations introduced in the Lords of the West expansion.
Fixed a Scenario Editor crash that could occur when generating a custom Random Map, reducing the amount of players and map size, and then generating it again.
Fixed a crash that would occur when attempting to play with a modified data file containing more than 1701 units.
The ‘Smoke in the water’ achievement can now be unlocked, as intended, in the Lake Poyang Historical Battle.
The 'Turkish delight' achievement can now be unlocked, as intended by defeating all other Turkish factions without forming an alliance with them.
The ♪ Burgundian ♪ and ♪ Sicilian ♪ themes will now play for the full duration of their tracks.

tags.feature: Building Range Indicators have been added as an option in the Options → Game section. Depending on the selected option, range indicators are shown for all buildings with a ranged attack:

tags.bug: Fixed a very rare issue where it was possible to disable in-game notifications with no way to re-enable them.
Fixed a purely visual bug in the UI where Viking militia-line units displayed a higher hit point value than the maximum hit points allowed.

The Bulgarian Technology Tree no longer states that the stone cost-reduction to construct Town Centers is only effective as of Castle Age; the bonus is now in effect starting in the Dark Age, as previously.
In the Ranked Matchmaking window, the Preferred/Banned Map screens can now be navigated using the keyboard for each game type.
In the Mod Manager, the ‘Check For Update’ button can now be accessed using the keyboard.
Fixed an issue which made it difficult to consistently navigate between the different Multiplayer tabs (Ranked, Lobby, etc.) using the keyboard.
When chat narration is enabled, the Narrator now acknowledges the first letter of words when reading through in-game updates.
The Narrator no longer skips the first two letters of other notifications.
The Narrator no longer reads out “icon 1” and “icon 2” rather than reading the descriptive text of images in the ‘Select Icon’ window.
Scorpion: No longer spawns on Aggressive Stance when the Default Aggressive stance is disabled.
Issuing a move command to a Monk who is already navigating to pick up a Relic will no longer cause the Monk to stop entirely.
Kotyan Khan 4: ‘Blood for Blood’: The final objective of the mission can no longer be completed before other primary objectives.
Fixed various minor issues throughout the Edward Longshanks campaign of the Lords of the West expansion.

tags.balance_change: Elite Steppe Lancer [Standard & Elite]: Reduced gold cost from 45 ▶ 40 gold.
The Cannon Galleon technology is no longer required to train the unit. Instead, researching Chemistry now unlocks the ability to train Cannon Galleons.
Increased the amount of food generated by Relics from 20 ▶ 30 food/minute, which now mirrors the generation rate of gold.
The food cost of economy upgrades is now reduced by 50% in addition to being available one Age earlier.
Flemish Militia: Reduced attack versus cavalry from 12 ▶ 8.
Flemish Militia: Reduced attack versus camels and ships from 8 ▶ 6.
Burgundian Vineyards: Now converts half of all food into gold rather than the entire stockpile.
Burgundian Vineyards: Increased the rate at which farmers generate gold by +33%.
Reduced the team bonus health granted to palisade walls from +50% ▶ +33%
Bearded Axe: Now available in the Castle Age (was Imperial Age).
Bearded Axe: Reduced the cost to research from 400 food, 400 gold ▶ 300 food, 300 gold.
Chivalry: Now available in the Imperial Age (was Castle Age).
Chivalry: Increased the cost from 400 wood, 400 gold ▶ 600 wood, 500 gold.
Villagers now gain the benefits of Blacksmith upgrades starting in the Castle Age.
Fish Traps now provide +300% food as opposed to an unlimited amount.
Battle Elephants now cost -30% in the Castle Age and -40% in the Imperial Age.
Karambit Warrior [Standard & Elite]: Increased attack from 6/7 ▶ 7/8.
Mangudai [Standard & Elite]: Reduced speed from 1.45 ▶ 1.4.
Organ Gun [Standard & Elite]: Secondary projectiles now consistently deal 2 damage as opposed to 1 or 2 depending on whether they hit their primary target.
Now receive access to the Siege Onager upgrade.
Serjeant: Increased Feudal Age melee armor from 1 ▶ 2.
Serjeant: Increased Castle Age hit points from 60 ▶ 65.
Elite Serjeant: Increased hit points from 75 ▶ 85.
Donjon: Reduced the stone cost to build from 200 ▶ 175.
First Crusade: As an added effect, the technology now also improves all Sicilian units’ resistance to conversion.

tags.bug: On Tiny, Small, and Medium map sizes, the number of Relics now correctly scale and spawn based on the number of players actually present on the map.
Players’ starting islands now always touch the edges of the map to prevent a channel around to the back of the island.
Increased the width of the water channels between the players and the mainland.
Increased the size of the mainland and created a more consistent shape across map variants.
Forests on the mainland now grow in larger groupings and can appear closer to the coastline, allowing for more open space inland.
Increased the amount of gold and stone on the map to more closely match the standard amounts, though the number of resource nodes can vary slightly.
Berries no longer grow close to the water.
Cliffs no longer spawn on the Tiny (1v1) map size.
Slightly reduced the amount of forest generated on the map.
Adjusted the forests on smaller map sizes to make the map less easy to wall.
Reduced the size of the mountain on smaller map sizes to allow for more playable space.
Improved the balance of starting forests in 3v3 and 4v4 settings.
On smaller map sizes, the mainland now spawns further from the map edges to prevent players from walling to the edge of the map with a Dock.
Secondary gold and stone piles—as well as other resources which were meant to spawn outside of the player’s walls—can no longer appear within the walls of an elongated base.
Fixed an issue which would create empty areas of the map.
Towers are now spaced more evenly.
Fixed an issue where AI players would issue orders repeatedly, causing undesirable side effects such as unit stuttering.

Boar lurers garrisoned by the AI in a Town Center to avoid the boar’s attacks will now, rather than hiding in the Town Center for extended periods of time, ungarrison once the boar swaps to a new target.
Fixed a rare, persistent issue where units would defy the rules of space and time to path through walls and attack enemy units.
Fixed an issue where lumberjacks could become idle after tasking them to trees using command queue.
Fixed an issue where builders would refuse to path to a foundation if blocked or locked within walls during a previous attempt to reach the site.
Villagers working on a Farm will no longer move around the farm more than four times before dropping off food. This should make their harvesting efficiency more consistent.
Fixed an edge case where huntable wild animals, such as a boar, would stop chasing the boar lurer despite them still being within the boar’s line of sight.
The can-train, up-can-train, train, or up-train commands now allow for -1 to be passed into them instead of causing a game crash.
up-remaining-boar-amount now also works on living boars, as intended.
Stacked find-status-remote searches no longer erroneously reset search indexes.

tags.feature: Introduced sn-enable-research-queue to control whether AI players can (or cannot) queue technologies along with units when sn-enable-training-queue is enabled. sn-enable-research-queue is set to 0 by default, and can be set to 1 to enable.

tags.bug: sn-number-tasked-units now works as intended when used with up-target-objects or up-target-point.

tags.feature: Added a new Blast Defense Level attribute in data for scenarios and RandomMapScripts. It has the same functionality as the blast defense level field in unit data.
Added a new Object Hotkey attribute in data for scenarios and RandomMapScripts. It has the same functionality as the Hotkey field in unit data.
Added new flags for Hero Status attribute to control hero properties individually:

tags.bug: The Regeneration Rate attribute now determines the number of hit points a given unit regenerates in a minute. The Regeneration task in the unit data is no longer required. The Regeneration Rate attribute has no effect for units with Hero Status flag 1 (full hero status) or 2 (auto-healing), which regenerate at the fixed 30 hit points/min rate.

notes.title: The Age of Empires: Fan Preview Recap!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/6878292e9cf69820fa32abbd0b35f9bde576dbfe.png[/img]

We’ve vacated the Town Center (for now) and our [b]Age Fan Preview[/b] broadcast has come and gone! We hope you enjoyed the show and have [i]plenty[/i] of new news to talk about and share with the community.

In case you missed some of the excitement or information in the whirlwind, here’s a quick breakdown of everything we shared today.

[h1]IV | New Civ: The Delhi Sultanate[/h1]
[previewyoutube=uHESFQ8LBfk;full][/previewyoutube]
First we revealed one of the civilizations you’ll be able to play in Age of Empires IV: the Delhi Sultanate! This first look showed off buildings, units and…elephants!

[code][list]
[*] If you’d like to learn more about what makes the Delhi Sultanate unique, you can visit our [url=https://fanpreview.ageofempires.com/]Virtual Village[/url] for a closer look.
[/list][/code]
[h1]IV | The Norman Campaign[/h1]
[previewyoutube=qojnBjUYzUU;full][/previewyoutube]
We took a deep dive into the [b]Norman Campaign[/b] coming to [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]. We previewed the documentary-style storytelling that will carry you through missions, as well as some of the gameplay captured straight from the campaign: beginning with William of Normandy’s battle for the English throne. [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] will have four playable campaigns, and we’re excited to share more as we get closer to its release.

[h1]IV | Behind-the-Scenes at Relic Entertainment[/h1]
[previewyoutube=PmwuI9vdFi8;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Age of Empires IV[/i] is being developed by [b]Relic Entertainment[/b], who offered us a behind-the-scenes look at their Vancouver studio and work on the game. Their history with real time strategy games, their passionate team, and their love for the franchise shone through in our chats with them, and we hope you enjoyed getting to know the people behind the project!

[h1]IV | New Civ: The Chinese[/h1]
[previewyoutube=hvuOQ84VrRw;full][/previewyoutube]
Our trip to Vancouver to visit Relic was followed by another special civilization reveal for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]: [b]the Chinese![/b] Their reveal video gave us a taste for their units, unique buildings, and even the first notes of their musical theme.

[code][list]
[*] Learn more about the Chinese civilization in the [url=https://fanpreview.ageofempires.com/]Virtual Village[/url].
[/list][/code]
[h1]II | New Expansion: The Dawn of the Dukes[/h1]
[previewyoutube=ATBsKnkabkk;full][/previewyoutube]
As Fan Preview is a celebration of ALL things [i]Age of Empires[/i], we also wanted to feature our [i]Definitive Editions[/i]. We’ve been so thrilled to remaster these classic titles for new and old players alike, and to continue evolving them alongside the community’s feedback!

Today we announced some big additions coming to [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition:[/i]
[list]
[*] The second official DLC—[b]Dawn of the Dukes[/b]—is coming with an Eastern European setting!
[*] Some of our existing campaigns will be playable in two player [b]co-op[/b], with more information about the feature coming soon!
[/list]
[h1]III | New Civ: The United States[/h1]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/aoe3de-ushc-dc.jpg[/img]

[i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i] is getting more content too! On April 13, you'll be able to experience the [b]United States[/b] civilization.
[list]
[*] A new civilization, new customizable home city, distinct units, and unique mechanics are on the horizon!
[*] You’ll be able to earn the United States civ for FREE by completing the [b]Fifty States Challenge[/b], or by purchasing and unlocking it immediately via Steam or the Microsoft Store.
[*] We’ll also be expanding the civ roster in the future as we head to [b]Africa[/b]. More information to come!
[/list]
[h1]♥ | A Community Tribute[/h1]
[previewyoutube=0d_SwlRazco;full][/previewyoutube]
One of the best things about [i]Age of Empires[/i] is the vibrant, creative, welcoming community. A celebration of the franchise wouldn’t be complete without all of YOU, so the Relic and World’s Edge Community Teams got together to pay tribute to you and your love of the games. It’s been a fantastic journey with you all so far, and we can’t wait to see you in [i]Age of Empires IV[/i].

[h1]IV | Age of Empires IV Gameplay: An Exclusive Look![/h1]
[previewyoutube=0EU0AHLkHFA;full][/previewyoutube]
You’ve been asking to see more of [i]Age of Empires IV[/i], so we pulled a little something together! This epic look at the gameplay of [i]Age IV[/i] showcases all of our revealed civilizations as they build and battle across the Ages. There are so many great moments, and we’re excited to hear what stands out to you!

[h1]IV | A Final Look...[/h1]
[previewyoutube=Q1pEnd41eJA;full][/previewyoutube]
Just when you thought we were done, our host hinted at one final look at the game...

[h1]...But Wait, There's More![/h1]
And with that, our show was done! A big thank you to our host [b]Zak (AKA ZeroEmpires)[/b] and to the entire team who worked so hard to put the show together.

But this is just the beginning! Fan Preview isn’t finished just yet; there are a few more activities for you to enjoy over the next week:

[code][list]
[*] You can head to our [url=https://fanpreview.ageofempires.com/][b]Virtual Village[/b][/url] to catch more exclusive content, learn more about the [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] civilizations we've revealed thus far, and take part in some activities built exclusively for this celebration.
[*] An [b][i]Age of Empires IV[/i] Closed Beta[/b] is on the horizon! If you want a chance to take part, you’ll need to be an [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/insiders][b][i]Age of Empires[/i] Insider[/b][/url]. Go sign up if you haven’t already; we’ll have more to share about the Beta in the near future, so stay tuned to our social channels and website.
[*] There’s also an opportunity to [b]win a one-of-a-kind, Age of Empires-branded, Dell Alienware Aurora R11 Desktop.[/b] [b][url=http://ageofempiressweepstakes.com/]Enter for a chance to win![/url][/b]
[/list][/code]
[i]Age of Empires IV[/i] is coming this [b]Fall 2021[/b] as our [i]Definitive Editions[/i] continue to evolve month after month. There’s never been a better time to be an [i]Age of Empires[/i] fan, and we’re excited for what comes next.

So, to everyone joining us, whether new or for the twentieth (or more) years: [b]WO-LO-LO![/b]

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

notes.title: Join The Women of History Event!
notes.content:
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Queen-Screenshot-1080x568.jpg[/img]

Throughout the echoes of time, women have continued to challenge expectations and leave resounding marks in history. This month—in honor of [url=https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2021/03/08/xbox-celebrates-international-womens-day/]International Women’s Day[/url] and [url=https://womenshistorymonth.gov/]Women’s History Month[/url] here in the States—we’re shining the spotlight on some of that history with a new event, several brand-new icons, visual mods, and more.

So, join in as we celebrate some of these passionate trailblazers during the [b]WOMEN OF HISTORY[/b] event!
[list]
[*] Unlock a brand new [b]Cheat Code[/b]!
[*] Unlock the [b]Queen [/b]Visual Replacement for the King!

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 46295
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/5effe4c89035190bae209b60bb40fb1f3da5b53d.png[/img]

Hello again, my kings and queens of the battlefield! It's that time again: another monthly release with yet another small—albeit important—update for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i].

Today's build comes with a bunch of crash and performance improvements for the game, many of which are direct results of the new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/3020197857796238160]Public Update Preview program[/url] (or PUPP). All of you who jumped in to experiment with the build and troubleshoot with the team have been [i]WONDERFUL[/i], and we will be creating a NEW development build this month to continue working with those of you experiencing issues. You can look for that build information on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]Steam forum[/url] and in the PUPP section, below!

For now, here's a quick look at what's landing in the game today:
[list]
[*] Enjoy an all-new [b]Women of History event![/b] Unlock new profile icons, new mods, and a brand-new cheat code!
[*] Numerous [b]crash fixes[/b] and [b]performance improvements[/b], including an [b]out of sync[/b] fix related to building placement
[*] Fixed several issues related to the placement of building foundations in the fog of war
[*] Units should no longer be able to path through walls to attack enemy units
[*] No more black terrain tiles in the Scenario Editor!
[/list]We've got a lot more in store for the April release, and want to continue working with you to identify and prioritize improvements. Whether you're encountering issues or have a new feature in mind for the game, the team is always looking for the consensus of the community over on our official channels.

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Thanks again to those amazing champions who helped us get this month's build together! Plenty more to come; until then, we'll see you on the battlefield! ⚔
