[h1][b]GAME[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]Stability & Performance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when returning to the ranked lobby following the Benchmark Test.
[*] Fixed a rare crash that could be triggered by multiple players spamming taunts simultaneously in a Custom Lobby, thus taunting the game into an early gg.
[*] Fixed a unique out-of-sync error triggered by placing a building foundation over another player’s unexplored building after a third player had already resigned from the match.
[*] Improved the performance when playing a scenario with a large number of triggers. This is done by halting checks for the trigger conditions of a trigger after one condition has already failed.
[*] Fixed a variety of crashes triggered during gameplay.
[/list][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3]
[list][*] The [b]Burgundian[/b] and [b]Sicilian[/b] articles in the History compendium now play the correct background tracks for their civilizations.
[/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the tooltips of fortifications to clarify which types of units increase the number of projectiles fired when garrisoned.
[*] Fixed a visual issue where the reward text of event mods appeared off-center in the completion notifications.
[/list][h3][b]Accessibility[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The post-game menu can now be navigated using the keyboard.
[*] The narrator will now skip certain in-game notifications in some languages.
[/list]

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] Donjon foundations no longer prevent a player from being defeated. ([i]Go, now, and die with honor![/i])
[*] Fixed an issue where the minimap would display the location of enemy [b]Gate[/b] foundations.
[*] Building foundations are now automatically cancelled when Villagers attempt to begin construction if placed over an obstacle previously hidden by the fog of war .
[*] Fixed an issue where buildings could be constructed on top of enemy players’ buildings under specific circumstances.
[*] Fixed an issue where allied building foundations yet to begin construction were visible in the fog of war.
[/list]

[h1][b]AI[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]Pathfinding[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where units would not be able to path correctly through gates or the ruins of destroyed objects. This issue affected several official campaign scenarios, such as the fourth mission of the [b]Sicilian Hautevilles[/b] campaign.
[*] Fixed an increasingly rare issue where units could path through walls to attack enemy units.
[/list][h3][b]Scripting[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]object-data-carry[/b] didn’t work with Farm objects.
[/list]

[h1][b]MODDING[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]Scenario Editor[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Attempting to save a file using invalid characters will no longer result in the Editor entering a bugged state.
[*] The civilization bonuses of the [b]Chinese[/b] and [b]Mayan[/b] civs (bonus Villagers) as well as the [b]Inca[/b] (bonus Llama) now work properly in scenarios. The bonus units will no longer spawn every time the scenario is loaded or when the civilization choices are updated.
[*] Generating a random map in the Editor will no longer result in certain terrain textures being displayed as an infinite black void.
[/list]

[hr][/hr][code][h1]            ◆ ONGOING ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]INVESTIGATION[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr]As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief update from our Production team regarding some of what is still in the works:
[list][*] [b]Crashes in Campaign/Standard Matches:[/b] We’re seeing continued reports that some users are experiencing crashes when trying to play Campaign or Standard matches. We’ve added some additional logging to help us track these down, and we’ve been getting helpful information from that logging in recent PUP builds. If your game is crashing, we ask that you [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]reach out to our Support Team[/url] for solutions and to provide our team with more information about the issue. You may be asked to submit files that give us important information about why you’re experiencing problems, and perhaps even directed to [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/aoe2de-update-46295#ongoing_pupp]PUPP[/url] to help us confirm if we’ve been able to resolve your issue.
[/list]For other known issues, please visit [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/articles/360049490811-Known-Issues-Solutions]this page[/url] to see what’s being tracked!
[quote]Note that this list is subject to change and should not be considered a [i]comprehensive[/i] list of every known issue we’re tracking. The above is provided as insight into the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].
[/quote]
[h1][b]Public Update Preview Program - April[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr]We’ll be launching the [b]Public Update Preview[/b] for April pretty much straight away as we get right back to work with the Community to identify game crashes or freezes and their root causes. If you’re experiencing any kind of problem playing the game, the Public Update Preview is a great place to let us know and work directly with our Developers to find a solution. This has already proven useful in helping us track down problems and deliver fixes in the March Update, and we very much hope to continue this trend in the months to come.

Here are some of the issues we believe we've fixed in this month's PUPP build:
[list]
[*] [b]This build contains a fix for a game freeze reported by several users, which we were able to diagnose thanks to additional logging and Support Requests provided by users in March’s PUP forum.[/b] If you were experiencing a game freeze before and the PUPP build resolves issue, please visit the forum to let us know.
[*] We'll be following up with individual users to ask for similar feedback.
[/list]
You can stop by the Steam forum for the April edition of the Public Update Preview, here:
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/7/]🛠 PUP – APRIL FORUM[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/6/3106892150602892836/]F.A.Q.[/url]
[/list][b]* Note that you will need to be signed in to Steam to view the PUP forum and threads.[/b]


[hr][/hr][code][h1]          ◆ MOD WARNING ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]Please note that custom mods may not be compatible with the latest game update. If you encounter performance or stability issues after your mods are disabled, please visit our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]support page[/url] for assistance!

notes.title: ANNOUNCING the AGE OF EMPIRES: FAN PREVIEW Event, beginning April 10!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5fFFIOkAX4o;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]WO LO LO![/h1][hr]
[/hr]The [i]Age of Empires[/i] team is thrilled to announce a celebration of the franchise with a new event: the [b]Age of Empires: Fan Preview[/b]. The event begins with a special, half-hour broadcast starting at [b]9 a.m. PT on April 10[/b], which will be streamed live on [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/]AgeofEmpires.com[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/xbox]Twitch[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/xbox/]Facebook Live[/url], the [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/xbox]Xbox YouTube[/url] channel, and [url=https://www.bilibili.com/]Bilibili[/url] for our fans in China! Following the broadcast, we will open a limited-time digital experience on [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/]AgeofEmpires.com[/url] to continue celebrating with the community for the week to follow.

Whilst we don’t want to spoil everything we have in store, we know that you’ve been eager for more glimpses of [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] since the first trailer at X019. Our broadcast will include a [b]new look at gameplay, civilizations, campaigns, and more for you to enjoy![/b] We will also be sharing some exciting news for our [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] and [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i] players, as well.

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/AgeIV.gif[/img]

Since the release of [i]Age of Empires[/i] over [b]20 years ago[/b], the franchise has grown to support a worldwide community of players with a shared love of real-time strategy. Over the last three years, we’ve delighted seasoned players and new fans alike with the Definitive Editions of [i]Age of Empires[/i], [i]Age of Empires II[/i], and [i]Age of Empires III[/i]: projects which were made possible thanks to the feedback and passion of the community. We are so proud to have such an energetic, dedicated fanbase at the foundation of our community.

[quote][h3]...and with the Definitive Editions in the hands of players, there’s a new era on the horizon...[/h3][/quote]
The community has been the driving force behind this amazing franchise and fueled its evolution for more than two decades; now it’s time to celebrate with an event built for YOU!

So, mark your calendars:

[hr][/hr][code][h3]         April 10 @ 9 a.m. PT /12 p.m. ET /16:00 UTC / 18:00 CEST[/h3][/code][hr][/hr]
Then garrison yourself in your Town Center, gather your snacks, and get HYPED for all the [i]Age of Empires[/i] news, content reveals, and surprises on the way. We'll talk more about the event as we get closer, as well as where you can tune in when it's time to make history!

We can’t wait to see you this April!

notes.title: Now Available: the Public Update Preview (PUP) program!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today we're trying something new with an experimental program inspired by feedback from you—the [i]Age II[/i] community! We’re calling this the [b]Public Update Preview[/b] program, or [b]"PUP"[/b] for short. These Update Previews will not only provide a sneak peek to owners of the game, but an opportunity for passionate players to step up, be recognized, and help us squash issues before they ever arise.

[b]Starting today, everyone that owns [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] on Steam will have immediate access to the Public Update Preview.[/b] This is a publicly-available, Steam 'BETA' branch accessible via your [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] properties menu. Opting into it will give you access to game content that is actively in development for the next game update.
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/6/3108017414047366981/]Instructions on how to access the branch can be found here![/url][/b]
[/list]
These builds will sometimes contain new features, content, or bug fixes—it really depends on what we happen to be doing at the time—but it means that you're invited to take a step behind the curtain and preview everything that’s coming to the game in the weeks leading up to a release. 

Whenever we make these builds available, you’ll see a Public Update Preview branch appear in your Steam 'BETA' list with a name similar to this month's branch:
[list]
[*] [b]pup_march – Public Update Preview – March[/b]
[*] [i](Note that you may need to relaunch Steam.)[/i]
[/list]
You don’t need to redeem any keys or use any passwords; the branch will show up whenever a build is available, and we’ll post in our channels to let you know it’s there. 

This is an experiment for us, and you should expect that we’ll change how we’re doing this over time as we learn the best way to engage with you, collect your feedback, and make sure this process is having the best possible impact on your game's updates. We won’t be able to fix everything you may find or change everything you suggest, but our hope is that you’ll see your feedback represented over time and, together, enhance the value of the official updates we introduce to the game. 

This afternoon, we’re launching with build [b]#45513[/b], which primarily contains a number of bug fixes. We plan to  update the build throughout this process and as batches of fixes or changes come in, but for now, you can start discussing the build and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/6/3108017414047032717/]reporting issues[/url] in the brand-new PUP forum:
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/6/]🛠 Public Update Preview - March[/url][/b]
[*] [i](Note that you [u]must[/u] own the game to access the PUP forum.)[/i]
[/list]
Once we’re ready to start prepping for the update to go Live, a few things will happen:
[list]
[*] We’ll pull back the branch so it no longer appears in your Steam Beta list.
[*] The PUP forum will be archived with all the threads about the current build.
[*] A new branch and forum will appear again when we have a new build and branch to share.
[*] A new list of changes will be posted along with areas you can focus on to make the biggest impact.
[/list]
That's it; those are most of the details you need to get started right away, and we'll continue building our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/6/3106892150602892836/]FAQ[/url] over time as you ask your questions about the Public Update Preview program.

Please join us in strengthening the quality of [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] by sharing your voice—we’re definitely listening, and looking for every opportunity to make this the game you love to play :)

See you on the battlefield!

—The World's Edge Team

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Hotfix 45185
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/950c395f5c62c558fd75a0b7ee8c6d8a1247e757.png[/img]

Here we go! We appreciate your patience as we bundle up and test another package of fixes for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. Today, our focus is on the prevalent crashes and errors disrupting the community while sneaking a few balance changes in for our new civilizations. As is our modus operandi, here are the highlights:
[list][*] Updated how the game utilizes [b]CPU[/b] and [b]GPU[/b] resources to avoid taxing systems not running [b]Vsync[/b].
[*] Fixed numerous [b]crashes[/b] reported by the community.
[*] Fixed an [b]out-of-sync error[/b] when [b]spectating a match with fog of war disabled[/b].
[*] Fixed an animation hitch when advancing from one Age to the next.
[*] The tech tree now displays the correct health values of units and buildings.
[*] Buildings can no longer be overlapped when you can't see the enemy's structure.
[*] Fixed issues which prevented units and secondary projectiles from dealing their intended damage.
[*] Adjustments to the [b]Burgundian Coustillier[/b] and to [b]Sicilian bonuses and unique technologies[/b].
[*] Numerous localization fixes.
[*] Ongoing investigation into more community reports!
[/list]
As always, your feedback plays a huge part in setting the course for the game, so keep it coming! Visit the forums, join the Discord, and get involved in the community!

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Watch for more updates, and be sure to check out the 'Ongoing Issues' section (below) to see what's at the top of our list in the month(s) to come!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[hr][/hr][code][h1]         ◆ HOTFIX 45185 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]GAME[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]Stability & Performance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated how GPU and CPU resources are consumed when running the game. When [b]Vsync[/b] is disabled, the FPS will be capped at the monitor’s refresh rate rather than drawing upon all available resources.
[*] Placing a horizontal or vertical gate on top of a Villager will no longer crash the game. (Placing an angled gate will [i]continue[/i] to not crash the game.)
[*] Fixed an out-of-sync error when spectating a game with the fog of war disabled.
[*] Fixed an animation hitch when advancing from one Age to the next.
[*] Fixed a crash when constructing a Stable while the chat narrator is enabled and the game language is set to French.
[*] Fixed a crash when starting any game as the [b]Sicilians[/b] or [b]Burgundians[/b] while using the [b]“Shuffle”[/b] music playlist.
[*] Fixed a spectator crash when counting the number of idle villagers.
[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the [b]Sicilian civilization[/b] tooltip to clarify that [b]Serjeants[/b] are only able to build and repair Donjons, and [i]cannot[/i] (as was improperly stated) repair buildings, siege units, and ships.
[*] Added missing map icons in the [b]Quick Play[/b] menu for the five new maps added to the game via [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/3022446487047678558]Update 44725[/url].
[*] The tech tree now displays the correct health values of units and buildings.
[*] Corrected the tech tree tooltips of the unique units for several civilizations.
[*] Improved the legibility of tech tree text for the two new civilizations: the Burgundians and Sicilians.
[*] Fixed the truncation of certain text strings throughout the [i]Lords of the West[/i] campaigns.
[*] Fixed the date and timestamp of news events displayed in-game.
[*] The notification when you complete an event challenge now scales more appropriately when it contains longer text strings.
[/list]

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] Villagers will no longer fight back against Feudal Age [b]Scout Cavalry[/b] or Castle Age [b]Eagle Scouts[/b] when not ordered to do so.
[*] Villagers will now automatically move to finish nearby buildings placed in the fog of war when finished with their current project.
[*] Building foundations can once again be placed over unexplored areas as long as it includes some area that has been explored. Note that you'll still be restricted from placing foundations in fully-unexplored areas of the map.
[*] Building foundations can no longer begin construction if overlapping other structures or foundations that aren't within a player's line of sight.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented [b]Turtle Ships[/b] and [b]Mangonels[/b] from dealing their intended damage, and some secondary projectiles from dealing [i]any[/i] damage in certain circumstances. This fix should also ensure that [b]Ballista Elephants[/b] can cut through forests, as intended.
[*] Fixed an issue which would prevent the construction of [b]Gates[/b] due to a failed obstruction check, despite there being no obstructions.
[*] Defeated players can no longer launch surprise attacks with garrisoned units while spectating the remainder of their match.
[/list]

[h1][b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]Burgundians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Coustillier:[/b] Reduced charge damage from [b]+35 ▶ +25[/b].
[*] [b]Elite Coustillier:[/b] Reduced charge damage from [b]+40 ▶ +30[/b].
[*] [b]Coustillier [Standard & Elite]:[/b] No longer deals double damage against units with the ‘Archer’ armor class.
[/list]
[h3][b]Sicilians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 CIVILIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] On Nomad-style maps, the first [b]Town Center[/b] to be built no longer benefits from the Sicilian construction speed bonus.
[*] The civilization’s resistance to bonus damage is no longer applied to siege weapons.
[*] Serjeants can no longer construct [b]Donjons[/b] in the Battle Royale game mode.
[/list]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]First Crusade:[/b] Reduced the number of [b]Serjeants[/b] spawned per Town Center from [b]10 ▶ 7[/b].
[*] [b]Scutage:[/b] Now awards gold to each ally based on the size of their [i]own[/i] military rather than the military count of the researching player.
[/list]

[h1][b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] Fixed an issue which would prevent the sending of messages after finding a Quick Play match.
[/list]

[h1][b]LOCALIZATION[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] Added localized text for the countdown timer that appears in the [b]Attila 4 (‘A Barbarian Betrothal’)[/b] mission.
[*] Fixed instances where the objective text would not display localized variants during [b]The Grand Dukes of the West 2 (‘The Wolf and the Lion’)[/b] campaign mission.
[*] Updated the legibility of certain diacritics on the [b]e[/b] and [b]i[/b] letters which were difficult to read.
[*] [b]CN:[/b] Updated the names of the [i]Lords of the West[/i] campaigns to display the proper headers on the Western Europe selection screen.
[*] [b]DE:[/b] Updated the names of the Lords of the West campaigns to appear visually consistent with other campaign titles.
[*] [b]FR:[/b] Added missing translations to the [b]Sicilian[/b] history page.
[*] [b]IT:[/b] Fixed a mismatched text and audio line in the outro cinematic of the [b]The Grand Dukes of the West 1 (‘A Kingdom Divided’)[/b] campaign mission.
[/list]

[hr][/hr][code][h1]     ◆ ONGOING INVESTIGATION ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief update from our Production team regarding some of what is still in the works:
[list]
[*] [b]Memory Crashes:[/b] Some players have reported memory crashes that require additional information to address. If you are experiencing regular crashes of any kind, please [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]reach out to our support team[/url] for solutions and to provide our team more information about the issue.
[*] [b]Unable to Reconnect:[/b]  We are working on a solution in addition to improvements to ensure that players can quickly and easily reconnect to their games when they disconnect or drop due to a network or Xbox Live issue. We hear you and recognize the frustration this can cause.
[*] [b]Scenario Editor: direct_placement or grouped_by_team affects player land generation in consecutive maps.[/b] If direct_placement or grouped_by_team is used when generating a map in the editor, additional maps generated in the same editor session will not do so properly. Until this can be fixed (tentatively aiming for the quarterly update), a workaround is to restart the title to ensure maps are generated properly.
[/list]
For other known issues, please visit [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/articles/360049490811-Known-Issues-Solutions]this page[/url] to see what’s being tracked!
[quote]Note that this list is subject to change and should not be considered a [i]comprehensive[/i] list of every known issue we’re tracking. The above is provided as insight into the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].
[/quote]

[hr][/hr][code][h1]          ◆ MOD WARNING ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]Please note that custom mods may not be compatible with the latest game update. If you encounter performance or stability issues after your mods are disabled, please visit our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]support page[/url] for assistance!

notes.title: Join the Age of Empires II: DE 2021 New Year Celebration!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=A8IgR1O-lhM;full][/previewyoutube]
With another year behind us, we’re hosting a party to celebrate all the adventures that lie ahead—and you’re all invited! Come join us in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] as we celebrate (albeit a bit late) the start of a new year (and new update) to the game!

We’ve prepared a bunch of new, celebration-themed goodies for you to unlock and enjoy over the next few weeks, so don’t miss the [b]2021 NEW YEAR CELEBRATION EVENT![/b]
[list]
[*] Unlock three new [b]Celebratory Profile Icons![/b]
[*] Unlock a new [b]Age Up Celebration[/b] with Fireworks and Cheering!
[*] Unlock a [b]New Year Celebration Scene[/b] for your Town Center!
[*] Unlock [b]Fireworks[/b] for your Research Complete and Building Upgrades!
[/list]
[table][tr]
        [td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/PR7-044.png[/img][/td]
        [td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/PR7-045.png[/img][/td]
        [td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/PR7-046.png[/img][/td]
[/tr][/table]

[h1]New Rewards![/h1]
[b]Starting TODAY through FEBRUARY 8,[/b] complete the in-game tasks within the time limit to unlock  all the New Year celebration goodies! The first challenge unlocks a new profile icon and is required to save all of your unlocks:
[code]🎯 [b]Sign into Xbox Live.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Serjeant with Balloon-Sword[/b] profile icon.
💾 [b]*Required* if you want to save any rewards unlocked during the event![/b]
[/code]Each of the following challenges must be unlocked in order and on separate days:
[code]🔒 [b]Win a Standard or MP game playing as one of the following civs: Spanish, Ethiopians, Japanese or Incas.[/b]
🧱 [Mod] Unlocks the [b]New Year Celebration Scene[/b] for the Town Center.

🔒 [b]Create 21 Hand Cannoneers in any one game.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Flemish Militia Cheers[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Advance to Castle Age from Dark Age within 21 minutes.[/b]
🧱 [Mod] Unlocks the Age Up [b]Fireworks and Cheering Celebration[/b].

🔒 [b]Create 21 Cannon Galleons or Elite Cannon Galleons in any one game.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Coustillier Firework[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Cumulatively construct 21 Bombard Towers in any games.[/b]
🧱 [Mod] Unlocks the [b]Fireworks[/b] replacement for Research Complete and Building Upgrades.
[/code]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/Age-Up-Fireworks.gif[/img]

[h1]Keep It All![/h1]
Remember: if you [b]sign in to Xbox Live[/b] during the event, you’ll get to keep all of the [b]mods[/b] and [b]profile icons[/b] you’ve achieved! Sign in, earn your rewards, and enjoy the 2021 New Year Celebration event!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Hotfix 44834
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/4b876e91b547dd02c3c33f72f0688d0f8d696f01.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][code][h1]         ◆ UPDATE 44834 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]Today's (January 28) hotfix introduces a handful of solutions for some of the gameplay issues that cropped up with the January update, while work continues on other bugs you've reported—including specific crashes that some users are experiencing. Here's the list of changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an exploit which would result in the [b]Lithuanian Relic bonus[/b] stacking beyond the +4 cap, failing to decrement if the Relics were ejected from the Monastery, and stacking to infinity (and beyond).
[*] Fixed an exploit which allowed users to delete enemy walls using [b]Tower[/b], [b]Donjon[/b], and [b]Gate[/b] foundations.
[*] Fixed an [b]out of sync[/b] error triggered by placing building foundations over enemy units or buildings hidden by the fog of war.
[*] Please let us know if you continue to be awarded [i]Lords of the West[/i] achievements without completing the listed requirements, as we have taken steps to resolve this. If you continue to experience it, please visit our forum and describe what you were doing when the achievements were rewarded, and whether or not you were rewarded other achievements or event challenge unlocks at the same time.
[/list]
If you continue to experience [i]any[/i] crashes, performance issues, or technical hiccups in the game, please take the time to [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/requests/new]reach out to the support team[/url] so they can assist you.


[hr][/hr][code][h1]     ◆ ONGOING INVESTIGATION ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]Crashes are the primary focus of our ongoing investigation, as well as performance issues noted by a subset of players. For those experiencing them, the most important thing you can do is contact our support team: both for assistance and to provide details that will help our team understand the problem.

ːGimmeAnAː [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/][i]Age of Empires II[/i] Support Center[/url]

We are also tracking and working on fixes for several other game issues identified by the community over the past week. For issues which have been verified, keep an eye on the [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/360049490811]Known Issues page[/url] for updates; and if you encounter a new problem that is not listed, please check the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/2/]official forum[/url] to contribute to a discussion thread if one already exists, or start a new one if (and [i]only[/i] if) it does not.


[hr][/hr][code][h1]          ◆ MOD WARNING ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]Please note that custom mods may not be compatible with the latest game update. If you encounter performance or stability issues after your mods are disabled, please visit our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]support page[/url] for assistance!

notes.title: Available Now: Lords of the West!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=oLJk_nIMdkc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]AVAILABLE NOW![/h1][hr]
[/hr][b]The [i]Lords of the West[/i] have arrived in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition![/i][/b] A new era is upon us, and what better way to celebrate than by challenging your friends in battle with two brand new civilizations, or testing your mettle and strategy in three new, fully-voiced campaigns! Pick up your copy today and expand your gameplay:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389240/

[h1]FEATURES[/h1][hr]
[/hr]Included in the Lords of the West expansion:

[h3]New Civ! The Burgundians[/h3][expand type=showmore]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/age-of-empires-2-de-burgundians.jpg[/img]

Rise from a mere duchy to the marvel of Western Europe through economic might, cultural achievement, and the use of advanced military technology and tactics.

The dukes of Burgundy played a vital role in the politics of medieval Western Europe. They led the transformation from the medieval to the early modern world and ushered in a golden age for the region called the Northern Renaissance. At their height, these “Grand Dukes of the West” controlled large parts of modern-day France, Belgium, The Netherlands, and Luxembourg.  Carving a new polity out of French, English, and Holy Roman domains was a daunting task that came with a high price: decades of war and bloodshed.

However, the Burgundians knew to use more than just warfare to get what they wanted. Their diplomatic and marriage policies proved to be even stronger than their swords.

[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION BONUSES[/b]
[list]
[*] Economic upgrades are available one Age earlier than other civs
[*] Stable technologies are 50% cheaper
[*] Gunpowder units gain a +25% bonus to their attack
[*] Cavalier upgrade is available in the Castle Age
[/list]
[b]▶︎ TEAM BONUS[/b]
[list]
[*] Relics generate both Gold and Food
[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNIQUE UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Coustillier:[/b] Burgundian cavalry unit that utilizes a powerful shock attack when charging into battle. Strong vs. infantry and archers. Weak vs. Camel Riders and Monks.
[*] [b]Flemish Militia:[/b] Burgundian unique infantry unit. Strong vs. cavalry. Weak vs. archers.
[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNIQUE TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Burgundian Vineyards:[/b] Convert all food into gold at a 2:1 ratio; Farmers slowly generate gold in addition to food.
[*] [b]Flemish Revolution:[/b] Upgrades all existing Villagers into [b]Flemish Militia[/b], and allows the training of Flemish Militia at Town Centers.
[/list]
[b]▶︎ FULL TECHNOLOGY TREE[/b]

[url=https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/lotw_burgundiantechtree.png][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/lotw_burgundiantechtree.png[/img][/url]
[/expand]
[h3]New Civ! The Sicilians[/h3][expand type=showmore]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/age-of-empires-2-de-sicilians.jpg[/img]

Experience the diverse cultures and martial spirit of the Mediterranean’s crossroads as you build one of the most coveted kingdoms of medieval Europe.

Robert Guiscard arrived in Italy in 1047 CE with a robber-band of 35 men. Within a century, his Hauteville family included dukes in Italy, princes in the Middle East, and even the King of Sicily. Join this intrepid family of Norman adventurers and complete their unlikely and compelling story, starting with Robert Guiscard’s arrival in Italy to his nephew Roger II’s consolidation of the Hauteville lands into the Kingdom of Sicily.

The Italo-Normans, as the conquerors and rulers in Norman Italy and Sicily are now known, were successful on the battlefield because of their fierce disposition, vigorous military tradition, keen affinity for tactics and the use of cunning, and sheer torrid speed. In these, they most closely resembled their Viking and Frankish forebears, but as they settled in Italy and Sicily they embraced local cultural customs and norms of governance.

[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION BONUSES[/b]
[list]
[*] Castles and Town Centers are constructed 100% faster
[*] Land military units absorb 50% of all incoming bonus damage
[*] Farm upgrades provide +100% additional food to Farms before they need to be reseeded
[/list]
[b]▶︎ TEAM BONUS[/b]
[list]
[*] Transport ships +5 carry capacity and +10 armor versus anti-ship bonus damage
[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNIQUE UNIT[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Serjeant:[/b] A hardy infantry unit which can also construct [b]Donjons[/b].
[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNIQUE BUILDING[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Donjon:[/b] Unique fortification used to train [b]Serjeants[/b]. Units can garrison in the building for protection; Archers and Villagers shoot additional projectiles when garrisoned.
[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNIQUE TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]

[/list]

[url=https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/lotw_siciliantechtree.png][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/lotw_siciliantechtree.png[/img][/url]
[/expand]
[h3]New Campaigns[/h3][expand type=showmore]

[b]▶︎ EDWARD LONGSHANKS[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/779f7e321e6821398a212127ac2a573795f5b422.png[/img]
Edward I is widely considered as one of England’s greatest rulers, mentioned in the same breath as Alfred the Great and Elizabeth I. Known as “Longshanks” for his height and intimidating stature, he was a man that commanded respect as he transformed England from a tattered state into a prominent European power.

[b]▶︎ THE GRAND DUKES OF THE WEST[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/788b3f84e1a6d83ae3ceb65c308bdce995cd2937.png[/img]
he Burgundian dukes are driven by ambition and greed. They lead an extremely luxurious life and need to constantly expand their domains in order to pay for it. Image and publicity mean everything to them. Philip the Bold earned his nickname after the defeat at Poitiers and John the Fearless earned his after a defeat in the Crusades, so these dukes know the importance of propaganda.

[b]▶︎ THE HAUTEVILLES[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/03c461b265f17bbb64c2b7917c5885f4f35d5c55.png[/img]
Robert Guiscard arrived in Italy in 1047 CE with a robber-band of 35 men. Within a century, his Hauteville family included dukes in Italy, princes in the Middle East, and even the King of Sicily. Join this intrepid family of Norman adventurers and complete their unlikely and compelling story.

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 44725
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/8e82140a7edf956705312f98ab26120aa909bc50.png[/img]

Welcome to another monumental week for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition![/i] Not only are we kicking it off with a transport ship full of features and fixes, but we're laying the groundwork for the first official expansion—[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/games/aoeiide/lords-of-the-west/][i]Lords of the West[/i][/url]—which introduces two new civilizations, three new campaigns, and expands the tools with which to build your empire!

Update 44725 lays the groundwork for the expansion with improvements to the stability and performance of the game—including fixes for the multiplayer performance setbacks following the November update—along with several new features, a new in-game event, and other challenges to improve your experience. Check out some of the highlights:
[list]
[*] Join the [b]New Year Celebration[/b] and unlock exclusive new icons and mods!
[*] Owners of the [i]Lords of the West[/i] expansion get early access to the two new civilizations in multiplayer: the [b]Burgundians[/b] and [b]Sicilians![/b]
[*] Numerous fixes to multiplayer performance and stability issues
[*] The profanity filter now targets specific ##### words rather than the whole ***** sentence
[*] Building blueprints can no longer be used to "scout" terrain that doesn't have visibility
[*] Five new maps: [b]African Clearing, Amazon Tunnel, Atacama, Coastal Forest, Seize the Mountain[/b]
[*] Unofficial mods are now disabled upon game update to prevent compatibility issues
[*] AI and pathfinding improvements galore!
[*] [i]...and more![/i]
[/list]
We're hoping this helps kick 2021 off to a *great* start, and creates a solid foundation for not only the expansion, but everything we have in store for the year to come (so much good stuff). As always, this includes input from all of you—the community—so come

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
We look forward to joining you for the big launch tomorrow, and hope you enjoy everything today's update brings to the game! ♥

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[hr][/hr][code][h1]         ◆ UPDATE 44725 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b][/h1]
[hr][/hr]While there is plenty of notable fixes and features to which to look forward in today’s build, here are some of the big highlights coming with this month's update:

[h3][b]Join the New Year Celebration![/b][/h3][previewyoutube=A8IgR1O-lhM;full][/previewyoutube][code][h3]🥳 JANUARY 25 through FEBRUARY 8[/h3][/code]A new year means a new chapter in the history books, as well as another reason to celebrate in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition![/i]

2021's [b]NEW YEAR CELEBRATION EVENT[/b] introduces a new set of icons, new mods, new upgrade effects, and another reason to jump back into [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] to round out your collection!

[table][tr]
[td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/PR7-044.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/PR7-045.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/PR7-046.png[/img][/td]
[/tr][/table]
[b]🡒 NEW REWARDS![/b]
[b]Starting TODAY through FEBRUARY 8,[/b] complete in-game tasks to unlock a ton of themed goodies:
[code]🎯 [b]Sign into Xbox Live.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Serjeant with Balloon-Sword[/b] profile icon.
💾 [b]*Required* if you want to save any rewards unlocked during the event![/b][/code]Each of the following challenges must be unlocked in order and on separate days:
[code]🔒 [b]Win a Standard or Multiplayer game playing as one of the following civilizations: the Spanish, Ethiopians, Japanese, or Inca.[/b]
🧱 Unlocks the [b]New Year Celebration Scene[/b] for the Town Center.

🔒 [b]Create 21 Hand Cannoneers in any one game.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Flemish Militia Cheers[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Advance to Castle Age from Dark Age within 21 minutes.[/b]
🧱 Unlocks the Age Up [b]Fireworks and Cheering Celebration[/b] mod.

🔒 [b]Create 21 Cannon Galleons or Elite Cannon Galleons in any one game. [/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Celebratory Coustillier[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Cumulatively construct 21 Bombard Towers in any games.[/b]
🧱 Unlocks the [b]Fireworks particle mod[/b] upon researching a technology or Aging-Up!
[/code]
[b]🡒 KEEP IT FOREVER!![/b]
Remember: if you [b]sign in to Xbox Live[/b] during the event, you’ll get to keep all of the [b]mods[/b] and [b]profile icons[/b] you’ve achieved! Sign in, earn your rewards, and enjoy the celebration!

We hope you enjoy the [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] New Year Celebration!  Again, don’t forget to sign into Xbox Live to ensure you keep everything you unlock!

[h3][b]NEW CIV! The Burgundians ([i]Lords of the West[/i])[/b][/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/lotw-screen-02-desk.jpg[/img][quote][i]“Rise from a mere duchy to the marvel of Western Europe through economic might, cultural achievement, and the use of advanced military technology and tactics.”[/i][/quote][b]🡒 OVERVIEW[/b]
The Burgundians are a new cavalry civilization specializing in economic development. Take advantage of their ability to perform economic upgrades one Age earlier than other civilizations, cheaper stable technologies, and more powerful gunpowder units to dominate your opponents on the battlefield.

Click below to see the different tools the Burgundians bring to the battlefield!

[b]Civilization Bonuses[/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] Economic upgrades are available one Age earlier than other civs
[*] Stable technologies are 50% cheaper
[*] Gunpowder units gain a +25% bonus to their attack
[*] Cavalier upgrade is available in the Castle Age
[/list]
[/expand]
[b]Team Bonus[/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] Relics generate both Gold and Food
[/list]
[/expand]
[b]Unique Units[/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] [b]Coustillier:[/b] Burgundian cavalry unit that utilizes a powerful shock attack when charging into battle. Strong vs. infantry and archers. Weak vs. Camel Riders and Monks.
[*] [b]Flemish Militia:[/b] Burgundian unique infantry unit. Strong vs. cavalry. Weak vs. archers.
[/list]
[/expand]
[b]Unique Technologies[/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] [b]Burgundian Vineyards:[/b] Convert all food into gold at a 2:1 ratio; Farmers slowly generate gold in addition to food.
[*] [b]Flemish Revolution:[/b] Upgrades all existing Villagers into [b]Flemish Militia[/b], and allows the training of Flemish Militia at Town Centers.
[/list]
[/expand]
[b]Full Technology Tree[/b]
[expand type=details]
[url=https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/lotw_burgundiantechtree.png][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/lotw_burgundiantechtree.png[/img][/url]
[/expand]
[b]🡒 EXCLUSIVE TO [i]LORDS OF THE WEST[/i][/b]
The Burgundians are unlocked exclusively for owners of the [i]Lords of the West[/i] DLC. Try out the Burgundians early (multiplayer only) by [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/buy-now#PreOrder_Now_Lords_of_the_West]pre-ordering [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition – Lords of the West[/i][/url], then enjoy [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/games/aoeiide/lords-of-the-west/]everything the expansion has to offer[/url] on January 26th!

[h3][b]NEW CIV! The Sicilians ([i]Lords of the West[/i])[/b][/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/lotw-screen-03-desk.jpg[/img][quote][i]“Experience the diverse cultures and martial spirit of the Mediterranean’s crossroads as you build one of the most coveted kingdoms of medieval Europe.”[/i][/quote][b]🡒 OVERVIEW[/b]
The Sicilians are an infantry civilization specializing in city building to fuel their relentless drive for expansion. Build [b]Donjons[/b] for additional fortifications around your towns, employ the [b]First Crusade[/b] technology to spawn batches of the unique [b]Serjeant[/b] unit in all Town Centers, and utilize the [b]Scutage[/b] technology to refill you and your team members’ battle coffers with 15 gold for each military unit you own.

Click below to see the different tools the Sicilians bring to the battlefield!

[b]Civilization Bonuses[/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] Castles and Town Centers are constructed 100% faster
[*] Land military units absorb 50% of all incoming bonus damage
[*] Farm upgrades provide +100% additional food to Farms before they need to be reseeded
[/list]
[/expand]
[b]Team Bonus[/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] Transport ships +5 carry capacity and +10 armor versus anti-ship bonus damage
[/list]
[/expand]
[b]Unique Units[/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] [b]Serjeant:[/b] A hardy infantry unit which can also construct [b]Donjons[/b].
[*] [b]Donjon:[/b] Unique fortification used to train [b]Serjeants[/b]. Units can garrison in the building for protection; Archers and Villagers shoot additional projectiles when garrisoned. ([b]Note:[/b] The building is considered a Tower, and thus does not count towards the building requirement to Age Up.)
[/list]
[/expand]
[b]Unique Technologies[/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] [b]First Crusade:[/b] Upon researching, each Town Center (up to 5) spawns a one-time group of 10 Serjeants.
[*] [b]Scutage:[/b] Upon researching, each team member receives a one-time payment of 15 gold for each military unit that they own.
[/list]
[/expand]
[b]Full Technology Tree[/b]
[expand type=details]
[url=https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/lotw_siciliantechtree.png][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/lotw_siciliantechtree.png[/img][/url]
[/expand]
[b]🡒 EXCLUSIVE TO [i]LORDS OF THE WEST[/i][/b]
The Sicilians are unlocked exclusively for owners of the [i]Lords of the West[/i] DLC. Try out the Sicilians early (multiplayer only) by [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/buy-now#PreOrder_Now_Lords_of_the_West]pre-ordering [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition – Lords of the West[/i][/url], then enjoy [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/games/aoeiide/lords-of-the-west/]everything the expansion has to offer[/url] on January 26th!


[h1][b]GAME[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]Stability & Performance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Numerous fixes implemented to address the mid-to-late game multiplayer performance setbacks following the November update.
[*] Implemented fixes to performance dips that could occur when a player Ages-Up.
[*] Fixed a crash when exiting the profile screen while it is loading.
[*] Fixed a crash in the [b]Battle Royale[/b] mode triggered when the corruption damaged a non-combatant object.
[*] Fixed a rare issue which would cause the game to stall after submitting a player report.
[/list]
[h3][b]Achievements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Chasing the Crown:[/b] Fixed an issue in the Bayinnaung campaign which prevented the achievement from being earnable.
[/list]
[h3][b]Graphics[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a building’s [b]research complete[/b] animation could fail to spawn the particles if multiple research projects were queued in the same building.
[/list]
[h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3]
[list][*] The [b]Stormy Dog[/b] cheat unit now [i]♪ barks ♪[/i] when selected.
[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Bonus stats granted to unit(s) via automatic upgrades are now displayed in the base unit stats. As an example, an inherit bonus to attack granted to Scout Cavalry in the Feudal Age would be displayed as [b]5[/b] instead of [b]3+2[/b].
[*] The profanity filter now only censors the word(s) which were flagged as vulgar rather than the entire message.
[*] The [b]Report Player[/b] modal no longer remains disabled after submitting a report.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]Civilization Selection Screen[/b] could not be closed after launching the game via a Steam invitation.
[*] The [b]Back[/b] button now denotes the page to which they’ll return in their tooltips.
[*] Upon research of the [b]Cuman Mercenaries[/b] technology, a notification is now sent to the Cuman player’s allies when completed.
[*] Medals awarded upon the completion of each [b]Historical Battle[/b] are now displayed on top of the mission titles, as intended.
[*] Scenario leaderboards will now properly display scores greater than 65535 points.
[*] The [b]Technology Tree[/b] can now be navigated using the [b]z, x, c, v[/b], and [b]b[/b] keys on the keyboard.
[*] Custom scenarios which change the player color of units will now display the correct color in the HUD when those units are selected with others, garrisoned, or added to command groups.
[/list]
Several UI improvements have been made to the Battle Royale mode:
[list]
[*] The [b]Battle Royale[/b] timer is now displayed in the Objectives panel.
[*] A notification is now displayed when Monks or Missionaries cannot heal a unit in the Battle Royale corrupted zone.
[*] The [b]China[/b] and [b]India[/b] Real World maps will no longer appear as suggested battlefields in Battle Royale.
[/list]

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]Gaia[/b] team no longer shares the same player color as Player 7 (gray), but displays its own distinct color (white).
[*] Increased the line-of-sight of most starting [b]Heroes[/b] in the [b]Battle Royale[/b] game mode to be more consistent across all units.
[*] Added a new hotkey: [b]“Select all idle military units”[/b]
[/list]
[/hr][h3][b]Exploit Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Hovering the blueprints of buildings over unexplored terrain will no longer reveal if the underlying terrain is occupied by a building or unit. While the blueprint can still be placed, it will not be buildable if the area is obstructed. This fixes the “palisade scan” exploit that allowed players to identify occupied areas beneath the fog of war.
[*] Fixed an exploit where units could be trapped within the foundations of horizontally- and vertically-placed Gates.
[/list]
[/hr][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Great Fish (Marlin)[/b] can no longer be deleted by Dock foundations.
[*] The [b]“Select all military buildings”[/b] hotkey no longer allows players to select buildings and units simultaneously when no [b]Barracks[/b] are present on the map.
[*] Fixed an issue where the projectiles of some ranged military—most notably gunpowder units—would be less accurate than intended.
[/list]

[h1][b]CAMPAIGN[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]Campaign Missions[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated several [b]Joan of Arc, Barbarossa, Attila the Hun[/b], and [b]Bari[/b] missions—which featured the Burgundian or Italo-Norman players—to use the new Burgundian and Sicilian civilizations.
[*] [b]Sundjata 4:[/b] ‘Blood on the River Bank’: The AI will no longer use the [b]Mema Princess[/b] as an explorer, leading to a rare situation where the scenario could not be completed.
[/list]

[h1][b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] On maps where each player begins with multiple Town Centers, additional Villagers or Llamas granted to the [b]Chinese, Mayan[/b], and [b]Inca[/b] civilizations will [i]only[/i] spawn from a single Town Center as opposed to [i]each[/i] of them.
[*] Reduced the hit points of [b]Palisade Walls[/b] and [b]Gates[/b] by [b]40%[/b] in the Dark Age.
[*] [b]Cavalry Archer [Standard & Heavy]:[/b] Reduced the attack animation duration from [b]1.3 ▶ 1.15[/b]. This reduces the overall attack delay by [b]11.5%[/b].
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]Heated Shot[/b] upgrade would not affect secondary arrows fired from Castles and Towers.
[/list]
The following civilizations no longer have access to the [b]Treadmill Crane[/b] technology:
[list]
[*] [b]Franks[/b]
[*] [b]Khmer[/b]
[*] [b]Slavs[/b]
[/list]
[h3][b]Bulgarians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Konnik (Dismounted) [Standard & Elite]:[/b] No longer has more line of sight than the mounted Konnik.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Packed Town Centers[/b] no longer appear in the [b]Battle Royale[/b] game mode on non-BR maps.
[/list]
[h3][b]Map Balance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Antarctica:[/b] Players start with a normal scout again; Penguins will continue to roam the map as unflappable spectators of the battlefield.
[*] [b]Arena:[/b] Secondary herds of sheep now consistently spawn within the walls.
[*] [b]Black Forest:[/b] Balanced out the elevation throughout the map.
[*] [b]Four Lakes:[/b] Relics now scale with map size. This means that [b]4[/b] Relics will spawn on tiny/small/medium map sizes, [b]6[/b] Relics during six-player matches, and [b]8[/b] Relics during eight-player matches.
[*] [b]Highland:[/b] Reduced the number or remote straggler trees spawned throughout the map.
[*] [b]Highland:[/b] Small rivers will no longer separate teammates. In games with only two players or teams, only a single river will be generated on all map variants.
[*] [b]Highland:[/b] The river is now consistently [b]7 tiles wide[/b] instead of being a random width.
[*] [b]Highland:[/b] Ice crossings will no longer interfere with ship navigation during the snowy season.
[*] [b]Highland:[/b] Added additional crossings to the river.
[*] [b]Highland:[/b] Cliffs have been removed from the map.
[*] [b]Highland:[/b] Starting gold clusters now spawn further from each other.
[*] [b]Highland:[/b] Distant gold and stone nodes, as well as Relics, are now distributed more evenly around the map.
[*] [b]Highland:[/b] Berries will no longer spawn adjacent to the river.
[*] [b]Highland:[/b] Huntable animals now avoid areas where berries are spawned.
[*] [b]Highland:[/b] Each player now consistently starts with a group of [b]4[/b] Deer as opposed to randomly receiving 3 or 4 Deer.
[*] [b]Highland:[/b] Removed extra boars from the map.
[*] [b]Highland:[/b] Reduced the number of predators that spawn throughout the map.
[*] [b]MegaRandom[/b]: Fixed several map seeds which could generate imbalanced battlefields.
[*] [b]Nile Delta:[/b] No longer spawns a [b]Packed Town Center[/b] when playing [b]Empire Wars[/b].
[*] [b]Nile Delta:[/b] The edges of the starting islands have been moved away from the map edge on all non-Tiny map sizes. This should help prevent situations where Transport Ships could spawn in land-locked pools of water.
[*] Serengeti: Elevated areas now appear around player starting areas, similar to Arabia.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Relics are now spawned per player on their respective island, and scale based on the total number of players in the match. This means that [b]4[/b] Relics will spawn on tiny/small/medium map sizes, [b]6[/b] Relics during six-player matches, and [b]8[/b] Relics during eight-player matches.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] With the exception of ludicrous-sized maps, an extra [b]3-tile gold[/b] and [b]3-tile stone[/b] node will spawn for each player. To compensate, starting stone piles have been reduced from [b]5- and 4-tile groups[/b] to [b]4- and 3-tile groups[/b].
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Adjusted the forests on each island to establish equilibrium between the two.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Increased the distance at which starting gold and stone generate to the shoreline from [b]5 ▶ 7[/b].
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] The roads connecting players are now much narrower, allowing for more variety when generating resource nodes around the islands.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Updated the road terrain textures to blend more seamlessly with their surroundings.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Starting gold clusters now spawn further from each other.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Berries now spawn further away from the shorelines.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Deer herds are now generated to avoid Berry bushes.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Reduced the number of predators that spawn throughout the map.
[*] [b]Valley:[/b] With the exception of ludicrous-sized maps, an extra [b]3-tile gold[/b] and [b]3-tile stone[/b] node will spawn for each player. To compensate, starting stone piles have been reduced from [b]5- and 4-tile groups[/b] to [b]4- and 3-tile groups[/b].
[*] [b]Valley:[/b] Starting gold clusters now spawn further from each other.
[*] [b]Valley:[/b] Deer no longer spawn on the map when “infinite resources” is selected via the match settings.
[*] [b]Valley:[/b] Relics are more evenly-distributed between players for maximum drama.
[*] [b]Valley:[/b] Reduced the number of predators that spawn throughout the map.
[/list]
[h3][b]Random Map Scripting[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Implemented the [b]effect_amount[/b] functionality, which allows the modification of object attributes, unit upgrades, and the modification or removal of technologies.
[*] [b]effect_amount[/b] can also be used to apply its effects to the Gaia player by using special Gaia effect types.
[*] In [b]King of the Hill[/b] games, resource generation via Monuments is now enabled by default. It can be turned off by using [b]effect_amount[/b] to disable technology 729.
[*] Implemented the [b]effect_percent[/b] functionality, which has the same function as [b]effect_amount[/b] but uses percentage as its value.
[*] [b].xs[/b] scripting is now available in RMS. [b]#includeXS[/b] has been added to load .xs scripts for random maps.
[/list]

[h1][b]AI[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] AI players will no longer include Monks who are holding Relics in assaults on their enemies.
[*] AI players will no longer try to task Villagers to resources that are unreachable due to being blocked by allied structurers.
[*] AI players are now able to see enemy units that have been sighted by human allies with whom they share vision.
[*] AI players will no longer be able to track and find units spotted and then hidden by the fog of war for more than five seconds.
[*] AI livestock is no longer affected by “collide and correct,” which would previously move them away from the Town Center when they blocked another unit that had no other path to their destination.
[*] The [b]Portuguese AI[/b] will no longer build [b]Feitorias[/b] at the start of every Deathmatch.
[*] The AI is now aware of the [b]Battle Royale[/b] timer, enabling them to better plan and maneuver their armies away from the impending doom.
[*] Fixed an issue which would prevent Villagers from fighting back against attackers on [b]Nomad[/b] when in the process of constructing a [b]Town Center[/b].
[*] Fixed a rare issue where Villagers would fail to defend themselves against predatory animals (such as wolves).
[*] Fixed a rare issue where Villagers could go idle and ignore new commands after being ordered to repair an object.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where the AI would stop scouting for long periods of time.
[/list]
[h3][b]Pathfinding[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Units will now prioritize the most direct path when moving less than 20 tiles.
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]boars[/b] could randomly break agro after bumping into an obstruction.
[*] Fixed an issue where patrolling melee units would occasionally fail to engage and attack ranged units who were already in motion.
[/list]
[h3][b]Scripting[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when using direct unit control to garrison units.
[*] AI can now use the [b]fe-cc-effect-amount[/b] and [b]fe-cc-effect-percent[/b] actions.
[*] [b]sn-maximum-patrol-distance[/b] now works with units patrolling in formation.
[*] [b]up-can-build-line[/b] now correctly checks if coordinates are valid before attempting to place a building.
[*] [b]object-data-locked[/b] now correctly checks if a gate is locked or unlocked.
[*] Krepost projectiles are now recognized by [b]up-projectile-detected[/b] as [b]projectile-castle[/b].
[*] [b]up-modify-escrow[/b] can no longer cause escrow to go into negative values.
[*] [b]up-store-player-name[/b] no longer stores the player number together with the player name.
[/list]

[h1][b]LOCALIZATION[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] Added missing localization for the description of the Battle Royale game mode on the Quick Play screen.
[*] Added a missing localization string in the fifth mission of the [b]El Cid[/b] campaign.
[/list]

[h1][b]MODDING[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[quote][list]
[*] [b]Unofficial mods are now automatically disabled upon the release of new game updates.[/b] This is to prevent compatibility issues with mods that have not been tested or verified to work with new updates, or which may cause crashes and other unexpected behaviors. A new message will appear when mods are disabled in this manner which includes instructions on how to re-enable mods.
[/list]
[/quote][list]
[*] Civ-specific unit sounds can now be modified individually for the [b]Huns[/b] and [b]Mongols[/b], as well as the [b]Teutons[/b] and [b]Goths[/b]. Naming irregularities and collisions for certain civ-specific sounds have been resolved.
[*] The Technology Tree data is now contained in the [b]civTechTrees.json[/b] file, thus allowing for easier and more flexible modification of the tech tree.
[*] Added technology effects [b]20-27[/b], which apply their effect to the player’s enemies.
[*] When modding the [b]UIColors.json[/b] file, the game now correctly pulls from the [b]Text[/b] attribute (rather than the [b]Healthbar[/b] attribute) to determine the UI text color.
[*] [b]xsEffectAmount[/b] has been implemented for both the scenario editor and random map scripts.
[/list]
The following attributes can now be modified:
[list]
[*] Bonus Damage Resistance
[*] Icon ID
[*] Shown Attack
[*] Shown Range
[*] Shown Melee Armor
[*] Shown Pierce Armor
[/list]
This can be done in the following methods and places:
[list]
[*] Technology effects in the data file
[*] Modify Attribute Trigger effect in the Scenario Editor
[*] Effect Amount command in Random Map, AI, and .xs Scripts
[/list]
[h3][b]Scenario Editor[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Scenario designers now have the power and option to prevent human players from changing teams in their scenarios.
[*] Generating large maps in the editor no longer crashes the game.
[*] Loading very small custom maps in the editor no longer crashes the game.
[*] Fixed a crash when using the [b]“Replace Object”[/b] effect.
[*] The [b]“Damage Object”[/b] trigger will now work with negative numbers.
[*] The [b]“Set Building Gather Point”[/b] trigger now works as intended.
[*] The [b]“Play Sound”[/b] trigger now plays sounds as a 2D effect, which can be heard by the whole map when a specific position is not included.
[*] The [b]“Heal Object”[/b] effect no longer excludes the given unit from the benefits of technologies.
[*] The [b]“Object Has Action”[/b] condition will now work in conjuction with any unit AI tasks, such as patrolling.
[*] Permanent [b]Flares[/b] placed in the editor no longer flash on the minimap.
[*] It is no longer possible to unpack [b]Town Centers[/b] directly on top of resources.
[/list]

A new year means a new chapter in the history books, as well as another reason to celebrate in Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition! 2021's NEW YEAR CELEBRATION EVENT introduces a new set of icons, new mods, new upgrade effects, and another reason to jump back into Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition to round out your collection!

The Burgundians are a new cavalry civilization specializing in economic development. Take advantage of their ability to perform economic upgrades one Age earlier than other civilizations, cheaper stable technologies, and more powerful gunpowder units to dominate your opponents on the battlefield.
Economic upgrades are available one Age earlier than other civs

tags.balance_change: Stable technologies are 50% cheaper
Gunpowder units gain a +25% bonus to their attack
Cavalier upgrade is available in the Castle Age
Relics generate both Gold and Food

tags.feature: Coustillier: Burgundian cavalry unit that utilizes a powerful shock attack when charging into battle. Strong vs. infantry and archers. Weak vs. Camel Riders and Monks.
Flemish Militia: Burgundian unique infantry unit. Strong vs. cavalry. Weak vs. archers.
Burgundian Vineyards: Convert all food into gold at a 2:1 ratio; Farmers slowly generate gold in addition to food.
Flemish Revolution: Upgrades all existing Villagers into Flemish Militia, and allows the training of Flemish Militia at Town Centers.

The Sicilians are an infantry civilization specializing in city building to fuel their relentless drive for expansion. Build Donjons for additional fortifications around your towns, employ the First Crusade technology to spawn batches of the unique Serjeant unit in all Town Centers, and utilize the Scutage technology to refill you and your team members’ battle coffers with 15 gold for each military unit you own.
Castles and Town Centers are constructed 100% faster

tags.balance_change: Land military units absorb 50% of all incoming bonus damage
Farm upgrades provide +100% additional food to Farms before they need to be reseeded
Transport ships +5 carry capacity and +10 armor versus anti-ship bonus damage

tags.feature: Serjeant: A hardy infantry unit which can also construct Donjons. Donjon: Unique fortification used to train Serjeants. Units can garrison in the building for protection; Archers and Villagers shoot additional projectiles when garrisoned. (Note: The building is considered a Tower, and thus does not count towards the building requirement to Age Up.)
First Crusade: Upon researching, each Town Center (up to 5) spawns a one-time group of 10 Serjeants.
Scutage: Upon researching, each team member receives a one-time payment of 15 gold for each military unit that they own.

Highland: Each player now consistently starts with a group of 4 Deer as opposed to randomly receiving 3 or 4 Deer.
Highland: Removed extra boars from the map.
Highland: Reduced the number of predators that spawn throughout the map.

tags.bug: MegaRandom: Fixed several map seeds which could generate imbalanced battlefields.
Nile Delta: No longer spawns a Packed Town Center when playing Empire Wars.

Nile Delta: The edges of the starting islands have been moved away from the map edge on all non-Tiny map sizes. This should help prevent situations where Transport Ships could spawn in land-locked pools of water.

tags.balance_change: Serengeti: Elevated areas now appear around player starting areas, similar to Arabia.

Team Islands: Relics are now spawned per player on their respective island, and scale based on the total number of players in the match. This means that 4 Relics will spawn on tiny/small/medium map sizes, 6 Relics during six-player matches, and 8 Relics during eight-player matches.

Team Islands: With the exception of ludicrous-sized maps, an extra 3-tile gold and 3-tile stone node will spawn for each player. To compensate, starting stone piles have been reduced from 5- and 4-tile groups to 4- and 3-tile groups.
Team Islands: Adjusted the forests on each island to establish equilibrium between the two.
Team Islands: Increased the distance at which starting gold and stone generate to the shoreline from 5 ▶ 7.
Team Islands: The roads connecting players are now much narrower, allowing for more variety when generating resource nodes around the islands.
Team Islands: Updated the road terrain textures to blend more seamlessly with their surroundings.
Team Islands: Starting gold clusters now spawn further from each other.
Team Islands: Berries now spawn further away from the shorelines.
Team Islands: Deer herds are now generated to avoid Berry bushes.
Team Islands: Reduced the number of predators that spawn throughout the map.

Valley: With the exception of ludicrous-sized maps, an extra 3-tile gold and 3-tile stone node will spawn for each player. To compensate, starting stone piles have been reduced from 5- and 4-tile groups to 4- and 3-tile groups.
Valley: Starting gold clusters now spawn further from each other.
Valley: Deer no longer spawn on the map when “infinite resources” is selected via the match settings.
Valley: Relics are more evenly-distributed between players for maximum drama.
Valley: Reduced the number of predators that spawn throughout the map.

tags.feature: Implemented the effect_amount functionality, which allows the modification of object attributes, unit upgrades, and the modification or removal of technologies.
effect_amount can also be used to apply its effects to the Gaia player by using special Gaia effect types.
In King of the Hill games, resource generation via Monuments is now enabled by default. It can be turned off by using effect_amount to disable technology 729.
Implemented the effect_percent functionality, which has the same function as effect_amount but uses percentage as its value.
.xs scripting is now available in RMS. #includeXS has been added to load .xs scripts for random maps.

tags.bug: AI players will no longer include Monks who are holding Relics in assaults on their enemies.
AI players will no longer try to task Villagers to resources that are unreachable due to being blocked by allied structurers.

tags.feature: AI players are now able to see enemy units that have been sighted by human allies with whom they share vision.

tags.bug: AI players will no longer be able to track and find units spotted and then hidden by the fog of war for more than five seconds.
AI livestock is no longer affected by “collide and correct,” which would previously move them away from the Town Center when they blocked another unit that had no other path to their destination.
The Portuguese AI will no longer build Feitorias at the start of every Deathmatch.

tags.feature: The AI is now aware of the Battle Royale timer, enabling them to better plan and maneuver their armies away from the impending doom.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue which would prevent Villagers from fighting back against attackers on Nomad when in the process of constructing a Town Center.
Fixed a rare issue where Villagers would fail to defend themselves against predatory animals (such as wolves).
Fixed a rare issue where Villagers could go idle and ignore new commands after being ordered to repair an object.
Fixed a rare issue where the AI would stop scouting for long periods of time.

tags.balance_change: Units will now prioritize the most direct path when moving less than 20 tiles.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where boars could randomly break agro after bumping into an obstruction.
Fixed an issue where patrolling melee units would occasionally fail to engage and attack ranged units who were already in motion.
Fixed a crash when using direct unit control to garrison units.

tags.feature: AI can now use the fe-cc-effect-amount and fe-cc-effect-percent actions.
sn-maximum-patrol-distance now works with units patrolling in formation.
up-can-build-line now correctly checks if coordinates are valid before attempting to place a building.
object-data-locked now correctly checks if a gate is locked or unlocked.
Krepost projectiles are now recognized by up-projectile-detected as projectile-castle.
up-modify-escrow can no longer cause escrow to go into negative values.
up-store-player-name no longer stores the player number together with the player name.
Added missing localization for the description of the Battle Royale game mode on the Quick Play screen.
Added a missing localization string in the fifth mission of the El Cid campaign.

Unofficial mods are now automatically disabled upon the release of new game updates. This is to prevent compatibility issues with mods that have not been tested or verified to work with new updates, or which may cause crashes and other unexpected behaviors. A new message will appear when mods are disabled in this manner which includes instructions on how to re-enable mods.

Civ-specific unit sounds can now be modified individually for the Huns and Mongols, as well as the Teutons and Goths. Naming irregularities and collisions for certain civ-specific sounds have been resolved.
The Technology Tree data is now contained in the civTechTrees.json file, thus allowing for easier and more flexible modification of the tech tree.
Added technology effects 20-27, which apply their effect to the player’s enemies.
When modding the UIColors.json file, the game now correctly pulls from the Text attribute (rather than the Healthbar attribute) to determine the UI text color.
xsEffectAmount has been implemented for both the scenario editor and random map scripts.
Bonus Damage Resistance
Icon ID
Shown Attack
Shown Range
Shown Melee Armor
Shown Pierce Armor
Technology effects in the data file
Modify Attribute Trigger effect in the Scenario Editor
Effect Amount command in Random Map, AI, and .xs Scripts
Scenario designers now have the power and option to prevent human players from changing teams in their scenarios.

tags.bug: Generating large maps in the editor no longer crashes the game.
Loading very small custom maps in the editor no longer crashes the game.
Fixed a crash when using the “Replace Object” effect.
The “Damage Object” trigger will now work with negative numbers.

tags.feature: The “Set Building Gather Point” trigger now works as intended.
The “Play Sound” trigger now plays sounds as a 2D effect, which can be heard by the whole map when a specific position is not included.

tags.bug: The “Heal Object” effect no longer excludes the given unit from the benefits of technologies.

tags.feature: The “Object Has Action” condition will now work in conjuction with any unit AI tasks, such as patrolling.

tags.bug: Permanent Flares placed in the editor no longer flash on the minimap.
It is no longer possible to unpack Town Centers directly on top of resources.

notes.title: Pre-Order Age of Empires II: DE - Lords of the West, coming January 26th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e58ee4e77e973514e6b2143fd492a5b25fe69140.png[/img]

[i][b]Lords of the West[/b][/i]—the first official expansion to [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]—is now available to pre-order or add to your wishlist for the holiday season. Here's what it brings to [i]Age II: DE:[/i]
[list]
[*] Challenge your friends with two all-new civilizations, each of which include unique units and technologies for you to explore!
[*] Battle across Western Europe and the Mediterranean in three new campaigns—including the British king, Edward Longshanks!
[*] Claim victory by means of sheer military might, diplomatic prowess, or through overwhelming economic power!
[*] New achievements to earn on your Xbox or Steam account! Check out the full list, below.
[/list]
[i][b]Lords of the West[/b][/i] will be released on the [url=https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9n69dq6hp313]Microsoft Store[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389240]Steam[/url] this [b]January 26th, 2021![/b]

[h1]TWO NEW CIVILIZATIONS[/h1][hr][/hr][h3][b]Burgundians[/b][/h3]
Rise from a mere duchy to the marvel of Western Europe through economic might, cultural achievement, and the use of advanced military technology and tactics. The Burgundian unique unit is the [b]Coustillier[/b], a cavalry unit that utilizes a powerful shock attack when charging into battle!

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/burgundians_screenshot_1.png[/img]

[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION BONUSES[/b]
[list]
[*] Cavalry Civilization
[*] Economic upgrades are available one Age earlier than other civs
[*] Fallen Knights return 50% of their gold cost
[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNIQUE UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Coustillier:[/b] Cavalry unit that can charge their attack stat
[*] [b]Flemish Militia:[/b] Heavy infantry unit with a bonus vs cavalry; can only be obtained via the [b]Flemish Revolution[/b] technology (see below)
[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNIQUE TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Burgundian Vineyards:[/b] Convert all food into gold at a 2:1 ratio
[*] [b]Flemish Revolution:[/b] Upgrades all existing Villagers to [b]Flemish Militia[/b]
[/list]

[h3][b]Sicilians[/b][/h3]
Experience the diverse cultures and martial spirit of the Mediterranean's crossroads as you build one of the most coveted kingdoms in medieval Europe. The Sicilian unique unit is the [b]Serjeant[/b], a hardy infantry unit that can construct the formidable Donjon.

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/sicilians_screenshot_1.png[/img]

[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION BONUSES[/b]
[list]
[*] Infantry Civilization
[*] Castles and Town Centers are constructed 100% faster
[*] Land military units absorb 33% of all incoming bonus damage
[*] Each Farm upgrade grants Farmers +1 carry capacity
[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNIQUE BUILDING[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Donjon:[/b] Unique fortification used to train [b]Serjeants[/b]. Units can garrison in the building for protection; Archers and Villagers shoot additional projectiles when garrisoned
[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNIQUE UNIT[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Serjeant:[/b] Infantry unit which can also construct Donjons
[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNIQUE TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]First Crusade:[/b] Upon researching, each Town Center spawns a one-time group of 7 Serjeants
[*] [b]Scutage:[/b] Upon researching, each team member receives a one-time payment of 15 gold for each military unit that they own[/list]
[code][i]* Note that civilization balance and bonuses may change between now and release.[/i][/code]
[h1]THREE NEW, FULLY-VOICED CAMPAIGNS[/h1][hr][/hr][h3][b]Edward Longshanks[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/779f7e321e6821398a212127ac2a573795f5b422.png[/img]
A bitter hostage of rebel barons, Edward Longshanks vows to reclaim his birthright and lead a shattered England to unprecedented heights of prestige and fortitude. A shrewd commander and cunning politician, his merciless methods are effective, though amoral. Follow him as his thirst for power and glory leads him throughout England, Wales, Scotland, and even on Crusade! In this campaign, you will play as the Britons.

[h3][b]The Grand Dukes of the West[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/788b3f84e1a6d83ae3ceb65c308bdce995cd2937.png[/img]
For decades, the dukes of Burgundy have been embroiled in a bloody struggle over control of the mad French king using their cunning, military prowess, and immense wealth. However, as the blood that they spill is paid for with the blood of their own, their focus turns increasingly northwards as they aim to create a kingdom of their own. In this campaign, you will play as the Burgundians.

[h3][b]The Hautevilles[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/03c461b265f17bbb64c2b7917c5885f4f35d5c55.png[/img]
Robert de Hauteville left Normandy in 1047 CE with a small band of thieves. Within a century, members of his family had become dukes in Italy, princes in the Holy Land, and even kings of Sicily. Join these intrepid Norman adventurers as they fuse three cultures into Europe’s most tolerant and sophisticated kingdom. In this campaign, you will play as the Sicilians.

[h1]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS[/h1][hr][/hr]Unlock and earn brand-new achievements on Steam and the Microsoft Store!

[table][tr]
        [td][b]ACHIEVEMENT NAME[/b][/td]
        [td][b]ACHIEVEMENT DESCRIPTION[/b][/td]
[/tr][tr]

[td]Complete the Edward Longshanks campaign.[/td]

[td]Complete the Grand Dukes of the West campaign.[/td]

[td]Complete the Hautevilles campaign.[/td]
[/tr][tr]

[/tr][tr]

[/tr][tr]
[td]No Wheels[/td]
[td]Do not construct a single siege weapon in the first Grand Dukes of the West mission "A Kingdom Divided".[/td]
[/tr][tr]
[td]A Second Hastings[/td]
[td]Ignore the armistice offered by the British and invade England by wiping out Humphrey's base in the fifth Grand Dukes of the West mission "The Hook and Cod Wars".[/td]

[td]Win a game playing as the Sicilians.[/td]

[td]Transform at least 50 Villagers into Flemish Militia by researching Flemish Revolution.[/td]

[h1]PRE-ORDER NOW![/h1][hr][/hr]Pre-order [i][b]Lords of the West[/b][/i] today and get ready to march into battle with the Sicilians and Burgundians as you guide your forces to victory on January 26th, 2021!
