[/code]
[b]▶︎ KEEP IT FOREVER!![/b]
Remember: if you [b]sign in to Xbox Live[/b] at any point during the event, you’ll get to keep all of the [b]mods[/b] and [b]profile icons[/b] you’ve unlocked! Sign in, earn your rewards, and enjoy the Summer Celebration Event!

[h3][b]STATS & LEADERBOARD UPDATE[/b][/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/40220-Stats-Page.jpg[/img]
We’ve revamped the [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/stats/ageiide][b]Community Stats[/b][/url] page to include improved individual stats and leaderboard updates.
[list][*] Improved the look and information available on the stats pages.
[*] Information can now be filtered by game mode, as well as additional filters for civilization and specific maps.
[*] You can now download replay files directly from the website by clicking on a recent match and pressing the button next to a player’s name.[/list]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/40220-Leaderboard.jpg[/img]
Check out all of the changes [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/stats/ageiide]here[/url].

[h1]◆ [b]GAME[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]STABILITY & PERFORMANCE[/b][/h3][list][*] Fixed a crash triggered when several selected units were killed at the same time while spectating.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]GAMEPLAY[/b] ◆[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where [b]Gates[/b] could not be constructed under certain circumstances.
[*] Units no longer perform actions when facing the wrong direction.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]MAP BALANCE[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]GENERAL[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Improved how [b]sheep[/b] are spawned to prevent rare circumstances where sheep could fail to spawn entirely.
[*] The placement of resources in random maps is no longer constrained to cardinal directions.[/list]
[h3][b]MAPS[/b][/h3]
[list][*] [b]Baltic:[/b] On larger map sizes, the size of the lake has been increased slightly and balanced for all players.
[*] [b]Islands:[/b] Deer now avoid berry bushes.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Relics are now spawned exclusively on the mountain.
[*] [b]Mountain Ridge:[/b] The number and density of deep lakes has been adjusted to provide equal access to all players.
[*] [b]Mountain Ridge:[/b] Slightly decreased the density of forests on the map.
[*] [b]Nile Delta:[/b] Fixed an issue where the initial Transport Ships could spawn in land-locked lakes, preventing them from being usable to migrate.
[*] [b]Ravines:[/b] Adjusted forest generation around the map.
[*] [b]Ravines:[/b] Reduced the density of forests near the player starting positions to allow for more aggressive gameplay.
[*] [b]Wolf Hill:[/b] Increased the amount of starting gold from [b]one 3-tile deposit[/b] and [b]one 4-tile deposit[/b] to [b]three 4-tile deposits[/b].
[*] [b]Wolf Hill:[/b] Increased the amount of starting stone from [b]one 3-tile deposit[/b] to [b]two 3-tile deposits[/b].[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]GENERAL[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue which would result in games being played on the [b]Brazil[/b] server rather than the most ideal server for participants in the match.
[*] Players now automatically leave their multiplayer party when they exit the matchmaking screen.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]MODDING[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]SCENARIO EDITOR[/b][/h3]
[list][*] The map seeds from recorded games can now be used to generate the same map in the Scenario Editor.[/list]

[quote][h1]◆ [b]ONGOING INVESTIGATION[/b] ◆[/h1]As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief update from our Production team regarding some of what is still in the works:
[list][*] [b]Server-Specific Connectivity Issues:[/b] We’ve received reports that some users are experiencing connectivity issues when connecting to the Brazil server region. During last week’s server maintenance, we resolved an issue which resulted in users being incorrectly assigned to that server region; now we are continuing to monitor and investigate whether additional connectivity problems exist that still need to be addressed.
[*] [b]Disconnect and Reconnect Fix:[/b] We have major stability fixes in the works for two reported issues:
[list][*] One which caused players to disconnect from their matches.
[*] One which prevented players from reconnecting to the dropped matches after a disruption in their connection.[/list]
When implemented, players should be able to reconnect to their games if still within the game within 60 seconds. Following thorough testing, we hope to have this implemented in an upcoming release window.[/list]
[h3]:alertalert: [b]DISCLAIMER[/b][/h3]This list is subject to change and should not be considered a comprehensive list of all the known issues we’re tracking. The above is to inform you of the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].[/quote][quote]Please note that custom mods may not be compatible with the latest game update. If you are experiencing issues launching or playing the game after downloading the new build, try [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/mods]disabling your installed mods[/url] before trying again.

Still having trouble? Visit our [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/support/aoe2/]support page[/url]![/quote]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Hotfix 39515
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/7525e15f9535d9203fce9d94792d7254822d7bbd.png[/img]

Today’s hotfix follows in the footsteps of [b]Update 39284[/b] with a handful of important fixes for issues that cropped up in last week’s build. This includes the notable pauses during gameplay, AI behaviors that proved disruptive to players, the loss of the final chapter in the Saladin campaign, a misrepresentation of ELO changes following ranked matches, and more.

Note that there are still a number of issues which are still being investigated—such as the inability to construct certain gates, reported problems with the Brazil server, and others—and we will do what we can to keep you updated and informed as we work towards solutions. For the time, keep an eye on the Known Issues page and official forum for updates and requests for more information from those experiencing the problems.

[quote]📃 [b]LEARN ABOUT:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/2572068948295461441]Update 39284[/url]
💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-ii/104]On the Official Forum[/url]
❓ [b]FIND:[/b] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/support/aoe2/aoe2-issues/]Other Known Issues[/url][/quote]
Thank you for your patience; we look forward to hearing from you regarding these latest changes!

—The Age of Empires Team

[h1]▬▬▬ HOTFIX 39515 ▬▬▬[/h1]

[h1]◆ FIXES ◆[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed an issue which caused intermittent, short pauses during gameplay.
[*] Fixed an issue where ELO changes would not be displayed properly after the conclusion of each ranked match.
[*] Fixed an issue where broken mods could prevent the title from launching.
[*] Fixed an issue which resulted in the removal of the [b]Saladin 6 (“The Lion and the Demon”)[/b] campaign mission—leading to great historical turmoil!
[*] The [b]Horse[/b] unit now has the same speed, armor class, and line of sight as the [b]Scout Cavalry[/b] unit.
[*] The Department of Agriculture has cited villagers who would attempt to replant farms well beyond their allotted plots. This should result in less wandering across the map to seek out unoccupied plots.
[*] Farmers will now automatically split to nearby farms that are free when they finish building a new farm.
[*] Players will no longer be matched on maps that are not in the current map pool.
[*] Fixed an issue in Ranked play where Black Forest would launch unexplored, and other maps would show up as explored when not intended.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI-controlled players would fail to lure boars in certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed a visual issue with the rendering of ranked map tabs.[/list]

notes.title: On Now: The Mongolian Civ Celebration Event!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=8MVgoEUE-Vk;full][/previewyoutube]
Welcome, [i]Age of Empires II:Definitive Edition[/i] fans, to the MAY-HEM EVENT! 

Join us as we celebrate one of [i]Age II’s[/i] most feared civilizations—[b]THE MONGOLS[/b]—and rewind the clock to a year ago when [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] first debuted on the E3 2019 stage! Complete a set of new challenges to unlock profile icons, visual mods, as well as a new campaign cheat code, then compete in the revamped E3 Mongol scenario to earn your spot on the global leaderboard. All of this is a part of the [b]MONGOLIAN CIV CELEBRATION EVENT[/b]!

These are the root of what we've tried to capture this month: with new mods, profile icons, and even some special treats that you get to seek out and discover! Special shout-out to all of our Insider's who voted on these three special units to receive a profile icon spotlight!

[quote]🎯 [b]Sign into Xbox Live.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Mayhem La Hire[/b] profile icon.

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition July 2020 Update
notes.content:
People may be looking towards Age of Empires 3's remake & the long-awaited Age of Empires 4, but Age of Empires 2 is still alive and kicking. The Definitive Edition has just received a big update.

The highlights include balance improvements to over 23 different maps, separate Random Map & Deathmatch map pools, a new map, and a bunch of little tweaks and stat/cost changes.

There's a new Mongol Civ event happening, with a new competitive single-player map. The community is also able to vote on which maps they want in the two map pools.

Here's' a video talking about the new changes:

And here's the full summary of the update from the patch notes page:

Ranked Matchmaking updates! Separate Random Map & Deathmatch map pools; new 'Preferred Map' and 'Prefer Random Civilization' option in lobbies! Various balance changes and bug fixes to 6 civilizations and several campaigns! A long list of map improvements to over 23 maps! AI Improvements! Pathfinding improvements! The Horde of Genghis Khan approaches during the Mongol Civ Event! NEW MAP: Land Nomad!284 New competitive Single Player scenario! New 'player lookup' functionality in Profile menu!

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 39284
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=jG6elbtmFEE;full][/previewyoutube]
It's that time again! The July update is HERE with a new seasonal event, a long list of balance changes to the civs and maps in [i]Age II: DE[/i], several brand-new features, and even a new battlefield where you can fight for supremacy! Here's the abbreviated list of what you'll find in today's game build:
[list][*] [b]Ranked Matchmaking updates![/b] Separate Random Map & Deathmatch map pools; new 'Preferred Map' and 'Prefer Random Civilization' option in lobbies!
[*] Various [b]balance changes and bug fixes[/b] to 6 civilizations and several campaigns!
[*] A long list of [b]map improvements[/b] to over 23 maps!
[*] [b]AI Improvements![/b]
[*] [b]Pathfinding improvements![/b]
[*] The Horde of Genghis Khan approaches during the [b]Mongol Civ Event![/b]
[*] [b]NEW MAP: Land Nomad![/b]
[*] [b]New competitive Single Player scenario![/b]
[*] [b]New 'player lookup' functionality in Profile menu![/b][/list]
This will also be the first release where [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/2498884002765924547]your votes[/url] helped determine the ranked map pool! Nearly 5000 votes were cast for the maps you want to see, with six coming out on top to join the 1v1 and Team Game map pools:

[code][h3][b]1v1 - Your Picks![/b][/h3][list][*] [b]FOUR LAKES — ✅ Picked by 43% of Voters[/b]
[*] [b]HIDEOUT — ✅ Picked by 36% of Voters[/b]
[*] [b]GOLDEN PIT — ✅ Picked by 36% of Voters[/b][/list]
[h3][b]Team Game - Your Picks![/b][/h3][list][*] [b]VALLEY — ✅ Picked by 51% of Voters[/b]
[*] [b]OASIS — ✅ Picked by 44% of Voters[/b]
[*] [b]LOMBARDIA — ✅ Picked by 37% of Voters [/b][/list][/code]
A HUGE thanks to everyone who voted this week; it was a close race with several maps [i]well[/i] in contention to take the top three spots!

[i]Don't like what you see?[/i] Get involved! Another vote is on the way every two weeks—so make your voice heard, campaign for your favorite map picks, and join the conversation! Don't miss out on your favorite map next time!

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
As always, we hope you enjoy today's update and look forward to hearing what you think! Thanks for keeping things stellar for this first half of this year; let's make the second half even better!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1]▬▬▬ UPDATE 39284 ▬▬▬[/h1]

[h1]◆ [b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b] ◆[/h1]While there is plenty of notable fixes and features to which to look forward in today’s build, here are some of the big highlights coming with this month’s update:

[h3][b]The Mongolian Civ Celebration Event![/b][/h3][previewyoutube=8MVgoEUE-Vk;full][/previewyoutube][code][h3]🐎 On NOW through AUGUST 3[/h3][/code]This month, join us as we celebrate one of [i]Age II[/i]'s most feared civilizations—[b]THE MONGOLS[/b]—and rewind the clock to a year ago when [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] first debuted on the E3 2019 stage! Complete a set of new challenges to unlock profile icons, visual mods, as well as a new campaign cheat code, then compete in the revamped E3 Mongol scenario to earn your spot on the global leaderboard. All of this is a part of the [b]MONGOLIAN CIV CELEBRATION EVENT![/b]
[list][*] Unlock three new [b]Profile Icons![/b]
[*] Unlock the [b]Mongol Yurt skin[/b] for your houses—visible to everyone in your matches!
[*] Unlock the [b]Genghis Khan statue[/b] for your Town Center!
[*] Discover a new cheat code: [b]"Yes We Khan"[/b]
[*] Test your skills with a new [b]Competitive Scenario[/b] based on the original E3 2019 demo![/list]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/mongol_scenario_aoe2de-1-1080x608.jpg[/img]
Here are the specific challenges available over the next two weeks:

[quote]🎯 [b]Sign into Xbox Live.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Genghis Khan[/b] profile icon.
💾 [b]This is *required* if you want to save any mod content or cheat codes unlocked during the event![/b]

🎯 [b]Play a match on Land Nomad.[/b]
🏆 Replaces the Mongol's houses with [b]Yurts[/b] during the event. Note that this will be visible to all users.

🎯 [b]Score more than 15,000 points on the 'Mongol Raiding' scenario.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Anti-Siege[/b] profile icon.

🎯 [b]Kill a Siege Onager using Mangudai.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Genghis Khan statue[/b] mod for your Town Center.

🎯 [b]Score more than 20,000 points on the 'Mongol Raiding' scenario.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Racing Ram[/b] profile icon.

🎯 [b]Advance to the Feudal Age in less than 12 minutes using the Mongols.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]"Yes We Khan"[/b] cheat code. This cheat is exclusive to the Genghis Khan campaign, and replaces all your Mangudai with the "Genghis Khan" unit.
[/quote]
We hope you enjoy the July celebration, the new features, and the new scenario to test your skills! And don't forget to sign into Xbox Live to ensure you keep everything you unlock!

[h3][b]NEW MAP: Land Nomad![/b][/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/land_nomad_aoe2de.jpg[/img][quote]"The lone villagers from several tribes are looking for a new place to settle and call home. With no water in sight, they must establish themselves and seek out as many resources as they can to build a town and ready themselves for battle."[/quote]
[b]LAND NOMAD[/b] is available now in both the Ranked Team Game pool and in unranked matches!

[h1]◆ [b]GAME[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]Stability & Performance[/b][/h3][list][*] The match will now automatically resume when a player resigns or leaves during a pause.
[*] Player profiles will no longer reset when changing to and from older game builds. This means medals and campaign progress will not reset when playing on a beta or tournament branch.
[*] Users playing with less than 16 GB of RAM or 1 GB of VRAM will now automatically default to and download low resolution UI assets.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where, after quitting out of a previous match, players could get stuck when joining a new match.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented players from creating another lobby after hosting a multiplayer match.
[*] Fixed a crash which could occur when using [b]Siege Towers[/b] in a game.
[*] Fixed a rare crash when returning to the map after the end of a match.
[*] Implemented additional anti-cheat protections so as to maintain an atmosphere of fair play.[/list]
[h3][b]Functionality[/b][/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/player_search_aoe2de-1080x687.jpg[/img][list][*] [b]NEW![/b] Added a [b]Player Lookup[/b] feature to the Profile menu. This allows you to easily search for players to add them to a clan, mute or unmute their chat, ban from your lobbies, or report to the World’s Edge Support Team.
[*] [b]NEW![/b] Added a new [b]Lobby Ban[/b] functionality to the ‘Host Lobby’ and ‘Profile’ menus. This allows you to prevent players from joining custom lobbies you’re hosting.[/list]
[h3][b]Graphics[/b][/h3][list][*] Custom trees (Tree A-K) now use randomized rotations when spawned by random maps.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where placeholder terrain could appear on explored maps.[/list]
[h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*] Fixed an issue where the [i]♪ “attack” ♪[/i] notification sound would, on occasion, not play in circumstances where it normally should.
[*] The maximum [b]Music[/b] volume is now double the previous limit.[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*] Age advancement is now also displayed in the Global Queue.
[*] Fixed instances of distorted icon colors for some technologies, such as [b]Bloodlines[/b] and [b]Careening[/b].
[*] Player icons now dynamically update when displaying “Friend or Foe” colors (ALT + G).
[*] The [b]“Display Future Technologies”[/b] setting now works as intended in campaign missions that disable specific technologies.
[*] The [b]“Display Future Technologies”[/b] setting now works properly when playing with all technologies available to all players.
[*] The tech tree now loads the correct civilization when opened on the matchmaking screen or after a match has concluded.
[*] The game will more accurately convey when a recorded game file ends abruptly due to a playback error (such as a desync).
[*] Implemented adjustments to the profanity filter based on feedback and usage statistics.
[*] Removed the Mixer button from the main menu.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]GAMEPLAY[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Added a new hotkey field to quickly issue the [b]Drop Relic[/b] command.
[*] The [b]“Select all Land Military Units”[/b] and [b]“Select all Visible Land Military Units”[/b] will no longer include Monks that are transporting a Relic.
[*] Farmers will now properly spread out to nearby idle farms after right-clicking a group to a single plot.
[*] The multi-building production queue now takes the remaining training time of queued items into account when adding to the queue(s).
[*] Double-clicking a herdable animal will now select all herdables instead of a single type. For example, double-clicking a Sheep will now also select all nearby Goats and Cows.
[*] Riderless [b]Horses[/b] and [b]Camels[/b] can now be loaded into Transport Ships.
[*] Holding [b]ALT[/b] and [b]right-clicking[/b] with a selected unit will prioritize attacks on enemy units. ALT + right-clicking a building or resource will result in a move command instead of another action.
[*] [b]Trebuchets[/b] will no longer immediately repack when, after unpacking, they then have to move to fire upon their intended target.
[*] The confirmation prompt will no longer appear when deleting incomplete buildings or groups of objects. Note that it will still appear if important completed objects are also selected in the group.
[*] Fixed a legacy issue where [b]Gates[/b] rotated to a NE/SW orientation ( ╱ ) would vanish when building a structure adjacent to them.
[*] Fixed an issue where units ordered to follow would not always acknowledge a new movement command.
[*] Fixed an issue where deleting a building foundation before quickly swapping to a different object would instead result in the deletion of the last object.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where using SHIFT+click to remove Villagers from the training queue would remove the Villager currently being trained.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where cliffs could be destroyed when hit by projectiles.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]CAMPAIGN[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]Campaign Missions[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Attila 1: ‘The Scourge of God’:[/b] The Scythians now have access to gold mines.
[*] [b]Dracula 2: ‘The Return of the Dragon’:[/b] Starting units now respect the “impassible” aspect of impassible terrain.
[*] [b]Dracula 5: ‘The Night Falls’:[/b] Fixed an issue which prevented players from unlocking the “Fire with Fire” achievement after training 10 Condottiero.
[*] [b]Ivaylo 4: ‘Echoes of Heroes’:[/b] A prompt suggesting that Ivaylo has died will no longer display when he dismounts from his horse.
[*] [b]Le Loi 5: ‘A Three-Pronged Attack’:[/b] Mission objectives now state that the player must capture the monument in the city of Nghe An as a part of the victory condition.
[*] [b]Le Loi 5: ‘A Three-Pronged Attack’:[/b] Pre-built barracks can no longer spawn units in locations where they are trapped.
[*] [b]Prithviraj 4: ‘The Fate of India’:[/b] Chemistry is now available for research.[/list]
[h3][b]Historical Battles[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Battle of Hastings:[/b] Harald’s landing is no longer thwarted by Transport Ships blocking his units.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Battle Elephant [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reduced trample damage from [b]50%[/b] to [b]25%[/b].
[*] [b]Condottiero:[/b] Increased attack from [b]9[/b] to [b]10[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Byzantines[/b][/h3][b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Elite Cataphract:[/b] Reduced the food cost of the upgrade from [b]1600[/b] to [b]1200 food[/b]. The gold cost is unchanged (800g).[/list]
[b]▶︎ TECHNOLOGIES[/b][list][*] [b]Logistica:[/b] Reduced the food cost of the upgrade from [b]1000[/b] to [b]800 food[/b]. The gold cost is unchanged (600g).[/list]
[h3][b]Italians[/b][/h3][b]▶︎ TECHNOLOGIES[/b][list][*] [b]Pavise[/b] now also provides +1 melee armor and +1 pierce armor to Condottieri units.[/list]
[h3][b]Koreans[/b][/h3][b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION[/b][list][*] As their civilization bonus, military units (except for siege weapons) now cost [b]20%[/b] less wood to train (was [b]15%[/b]).[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]War Wagon:[/b] Increased the base cost to train by [b]+5 wood[/b]. After the civilization discount, the total cost is now [b]92 wood[/b] (was [b]94[/b]).
[*] [b]Turtle Ship:[/b] Increased the base cost to build by [b]+10 wood[/b]. After the civilization discount, the total cost is now [b]152 wood[/b] (was [b]153[/b]).[/list]
[h3][b]Malay[/b][/h3][b]▶︎ UNITS[/b] [list][*] [b]Karambit Warrior [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Decreased food cost from [b]30[/b] to [b]25 food[/b]. The gold cost is unchanged (15g).[/list]
[h3][b]Portuguese[/b][/h3][b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION[/b][list][*] As their civilization bonus, all units now cost [b]20%[/b] less gold to train (was [b]15%[/b]).[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Caravel:[/b] Increased the base cost to build by [b]+3 gold[/b]. After the civilization discount, the total cost is now [b]34.4 gold[/b] (was [b]34[/b]).[/list]
[h3][b]Tatars[/b][/h3][b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Flaming Camel:[/b] Increased attack bonus against elephants from [b]+80[/b] to [b]+130[/b].
[*] [b]Flaming Camel:[/b] Increased blast radius from [b]1.5[/b] to [b]2.0[/b].[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]MAP BALANCE[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Relics will now spawn during “infinite resources” matches so Lithuanians can activate their civilization bonus.
[*] The generation of player gold, stone, and other resources has been further adjusted to prevent resources from overlapping or appearing stuck.[/list]
[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Increased the amount of starting gold to [b]4[/b] gold tiles per player.
[*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Removed extra boars from the map.
[*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Hilltops will no longer generate forest on Deathmatch or Infinite Resources modes.
[*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Extra deer and predator animals will no longer spawn when using Deathmatch settings.
[*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Relics are now generated slightly further from players’ bases.
[*] [b]Arabia:[/b] Starting stone and gold resources have been adjusted to spawn a minimum, set distance from each other.
[*] [b]Arabia:[/b] Huntable animals will no longer spawn directly next to berries.
[*] [b]Archipelago:[/b] Land masses will generate away from the edges of the map—even on smaller sizes—to prevent fully-enclosed bodies of water.
[*] [b]Arena:[/b] A third gold and second stone deposit have been added as guaranteed forward spawns outside of each player’s wall.
[*] [b]Arena:[/b] Huntable animals will no longer spawn directly next to berries.
[*] [b]Baltic:[/b] Each player is now provided with extra gold and stone deposits.
[*] [b]Baltic:[/b] On tiny, small, and medium-sized maps, Relics have been re-balanced between the players, with the fifth relic spawning on the shallows or ice island in the water.
[*] [b]Baltic:[/b] Forest generation has been adjusted for more consistent results.
[*] [b]Baltic:[/b] The number of cliffs have been reduced and spaced out throughout the map.
[*] [b]Baltic:[/b] Player starting locations have been adjusted with circular placement and slightly larger starting areas.
[*] [b]Black Forest:[/b] Reduced the number of straggler trees that spawn.
[*] [b]Bog Islands:[/b] Gold and stone deposits no longer appear near the edges of water.
[*] [b]Bog Islands:[/b] Extra gold and stone deposits have been redistributed more evenly throughout the map.
[*] [b]Bog Islands:[/b] The lake in the middle of the map now has a more consistent, circular shape.
[*] [b]Bog Islands:[/b] Players now consistently spawn at an equal distance from the center of the map.
[*] [b]Four Lakes:[/b] Fixed a bug where road terrain tiles would mistakenly appear in small clumps.
[*] [b]Ghost Lake:[/b] Adjusted the generation of forests and player starting positions to ensure an equal amount of land and forest for each player.
[*] [b]Ghost Lake:[/b] Reduced the density of forests to promote a more open, aggressive battlefield.
[*] [b]Ghost Lake:[/b] Removed cliffs from the map.
[*] [b]Ghost Lake:[/b] Ponds now only appear in the center of the map.
[*] [b]Ghost Lake:[/b] Far gold and stone resources are now generated per player.
[*] [b]Ghost Lake:[/b] Relics are now generated per player on tiny (1v1) maps.
[*] [b]Ghost Lake:[/b] Each player’s primary gold mine (7 tiles) is always towards the center of the map to encourage aggressive play.
[*] [b]Golden Pit:[/b] The center pit is now consistently circular.
[*] [b]Golden Pit:[/b] Players spawns have been balanced to start an equal distance from the center pit.
[*] [b]Golden Pit:[/b] Reduced the density of forests to promote a more open, aggressive battlefield.
[*] [b]Gold Rush:[/b] Extra stone mines have been split from two, six-tile piles into four, three-tile piles.
[*] [b]Gold Rush:[/b] Extra stone mines are now consistently generated near player starting positions.
[*] [b]Hamburger:[/b] Players spawns are now in a perfect circle, ensuring equal access to the water.
[*] [b]Hamburger:[/b] Adjusted how fish are generated to ensure that deep fish appear along the entire length of the water.
[*] [b]Hamburger:[/b] Starting resources have been slightly spread out from their previous positions.
[*] [b]Hamburger:[/b] The first and second gold and/or stone deposits will now spawn away from each other.
[*] [b]Hamburger:[/b] Fixed an issue where extra gold, stone, and relics could appear on the central island.
[*] [b]Hamburger:[/b] All starting resources now generate away from the water and central forest.
[*] [b]Hamburger:[/b] Fixed an issue where the central forest would fail to spawn on larger map sizes.
[*] [b]Hill Fort:[/b] Thin lines of forest no longer appear between players on 1v1 matches.
[*] [b]Hill Fort:[/b] Fixed an instance of the map where extra berries would fail to generate.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Starting fish will no longer spawn directly adjacent to berries.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Huntable animals will no longer spawn directly next to berries.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Gold and stone deposits will now appear further from shorelines.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Forests are generated more evenly throughout the map.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Starting stone and gold resources have been adjusted to spawn a minimum, set distance from each other.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Player starting positions and the Kilimanjaro mountain are now more centered in the maps.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] The mountain is now generated correctly on the Ludicrous map size.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Far gold and stone will no longer spawn together in clusters.

[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Introduced numerous new map variants while revising and removing some older variants. The resulting maps tend to offer more open, aggressive battlefields.
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Increased the variety of seasons.
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Extremely large or extremely small deposits of gold and stone will now spawn less frequently.
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Starting gold and stone deposits are more evenly distributed around the map.
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Revisited the starting food resources in order to provide a more equal balance regardless of civilization choice. The maximum amount of huntable food is now 2 deer and 3 rhinos or elephants—a combination that will spawn roughly 2% of the time.
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Huntable animals will no longer spawn directly next to berries.
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] The chance of a grouped start for Team Games has been increased (similar to Lombardia).
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] The Nomad start now takes after the classic Nomad or Land Nomad start: where there are no clear bases and villagers for each player are scattered throughout the whole map.
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Introduced the possibility of starting with a [b]Fishing Ship[/b] or [b]Transport Ship[/b].
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Introduced the possibility of starting with a [b]Feitoria[/b] at [b]1%[/b].
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Introduced the possibility of starting with a [b]Fortified Palisade[/b] at [b]2%[/b].
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Reduced the chance of starting with a [b]Stone Wall[/b] from [b]2%[/b] to [b]1%[/b].
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Increased the chance of starting with a [b]Horse[/b] or [b]Camel[/b] from [b]12%[/b] to [b]20%[/b].
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Decreased the chance of starting without a [b]Scout[/b] from [b]10%[/b] to [b]3%[/b].
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Decreased the chance of starting with a [b]Castle[/b] from [b]2%[/b] to [b]1%[/b].
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Increased the chance of starting with a [b]Outpost[/b] from [b]1%[/b] to [b]6%[/b].
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Extreme scout option (i.e. Militia, Spearman, Skirmisher, etc.) now appear less frequently, and only when there isn’t a large amount of deer.
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Fixed various issues with stuck or inaccessible resources.
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Fixed various instances where lands and resources were generated unevenly.
[*] [b]Migration:[/b] The main gold pile has been split from one [b]8-tile[/b] deposit into [b]two 4-tile[/b] deposits.
[*] [b]Mountain Pass:[/b] Increased the amount of available food on the map. Forage bushes have been added, Deer now appear in packs of 4 instead of 3, and more Sheep and Deer appear throughout the map (overall).
[*] [b]Mountain Pass:[/b] Fixed a bug where Villagers and resources could spawn stuck inside of a mountain.
[*] [b]Nile Delta:[/b] Relics have been re-balanced among the islands. Depending on the size of the map, large islands will spawn with 2, 3, or 4 Relics, while one relic will always spawn on the starting islands in the middle.
[*] [b]Nile Delta:[/b] Increased the amount of available food on the map. Ostriches now appear in groups of 4 instead of 3, and the number of Ostriches, Elephants, and Goats that spawn throughout the map has been increased.
[*] [b]Nile Delta:[/b] The total amount of gold and stone available has been increased and evenly distributed on both large islands.
[*] [b]Nile Delta:[/b] Adjusted how forests are generated to prevent large, empty clearings on larger map sizes.
[*] [b]Nomad:[/b] Shore fish are now generated more evenly.
[*] [b]Pacific Islands:[/b] Reshaped the outside areas and player positions to be more evenly shaped.
[*] [b]Pacific Islands:[/b] Adjusted the number of starting animals to [b]8 buffalo[/b] and [b]1 rhino[/b].
[*] [b]Pacific Islands:[/b] Shorelines have become a more ideal habitat for (and thus have become more populated by) box turtles.

[*] [b]Pacific Islands:[/b] Deer have reproduced in higher numbers and moved into the interior of the islands.
[*] [b]Pacific Islands:[/b] Starting forests are now more consistent for each player.
[*] [b]Pacific Islands:[/b] Increased the amount of forested area on the large middle islands.
[*] [b]Pacific Islands:[/b] Extra forage bushes have sprouted on the middle islands.

[list][*] [b]NEW![/b] A [b]Preferred Map[/b] option is now available in matchmaking. Use it to weight the ranked matchmaking choice in favor of your favorite map!
[list][*] If both players share a preferred map, they will play on that map.

[h1]◆ [b]AI[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] AI-controlled players may now delete a wall tile (and reconstruct it later) in order to more effectively lure a boar from outside of a walled base.
[*] AI players may now delete and abandon building foundations located next to enemy fortifications (such as a Castle, Krepost, Tower, etc.).
[*] AI players may now inform their allies about enemy player positions by sending a chat message and using a flare on the minimap.
[*] Players can now (properly) change the attack stance of converted scouting units previously owned by an AI player.

[*] Updated the AI player response to Eagle Warrior rushes.
[*] AI-controlled Scouts can now path to the edge of the map to capture sheep.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented AI players from training the most effective units to counter specific enemy compositions.
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause the AI to send too many Villagers to defend against a Tower rush.
[*] Implemented a variety of minor fixes and strategical improvements to the AI player behavior.
[*] Improved the behavior of the AI (CD) when assigned to the new [i]Definitive Edition[/i] civilizations (Lithuanians, Bulgarians, Cumans, and Tatars).[/list]
Some adjustments have also been made to the Extreme AI behavior:
[list][*] Extreme AI players may preemptively send Spearmen to resource drop sites to protect gatherers when enemy cavalry attacks are expected.[/list]

AI: [b]up-group-size[/b] count no longer includes garrisoned objects.
AI: Fixed an issue which could cause [b]up-change-name[/b] to load the wrong script when restarting the game.
AI: [b]up-find-status-remote/local[/b] now stacks searches correctly.
AI: [b]up-get-focus-fact[/b] and [b]up-get-target-fact[/b] now work correctly when getting allied goal values.
AI: [b]up-find-remote c: gate-class[/b] can now find gates.
AI: [b]up-get-path-distance/up-path-distance[/b] will return 65535 if the unit cannot actually path to destination tile.
AI: [b]position-enemy[/b] and [b]position-target[/b] now work correctly.
AI: [b]object-data-patrolling[/b] will no longer always return 0.
AI: [b]up-get-focus-fact[/b] and [b]up-get-target-fact[/b] now return the correct value when using player-distance.
AI: [b]up-find-remote[/b] will no longer find pending objects when using class.
AI: [b]object-data-idling[/b] now works correctly with livestock.

tags.feature: Added a [b]Datamod[/b] drop-down menu to the Campaign screens.

tags.bug: Modded music will no longer be played louder than original tracks.

Fixed an issue where diplomacy would always display as “enemy” when playing a scenario in a Standard Game. This was caused by Diplomacy Settings not being properly saved in the scenario, and can be fixed by opening and re-saving any affected scenarios so the fix can take effect.

notes.title: New Matchmaking Customization (and more) coming this July!
notes.content:
Happy July’s-eve everyone! With only hours left until the end of the month (or [i]negative[/i] hours for our friends living near the dateline), we wanted to fill you in on where we’re at and what’s on the horizon for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i].

While we don’t have a June update in store for the final moments of the month, we [i]do[/i] have a lot in store for you this July! Rather than trying to explain it all in text, here’s our own [b]BBQTurkman[/b] with an early sneak peek at some of what’s in store:

[previewyoutube=mnAwxTqA_WE;full][/previewyoutube]
For those of you who still appreciate detailed lists ([i]…and who doesn’t?[/i]), here are some of the highlights from the video along with some additional tidbits of info:

[quote][h1]COMING THIS JULY[/h1]

✅ [b]There will be a JULY UPDATE![/b]

✅ [b]The RANDOM MAP and DEATHMATCH game modes will have unique map pools.[/b]

✅ [b]A new PREFERRED MAP option lets you prioritize the map you want to play.[/b]
Here’s how it will work:
[list][*] If both players share a preferred map, they will play on that map.
[*] If players have different preferred maps, it will choose from the two.
[*] If one player has a map preference and the other doesn't, the preferred map will be used.
[*] If neither player has a preference, a random map will be selected from the pool of non-banned maps.
[*] In Team games, the map is selected from the list of preferences provided by players, skewing towards those that are preferred by the majority of players.[/list]
✅ [b]We will use COMMUNITY VOTING to determine and modify the map pools![/b]
[list][*] Use your voice to help determine which maps show up in the ranked pool(s).[/list]
✅ [b]The Ranked map pools will be UPDATED EVERY TWO WEEKS![/b]
[list][*] You can check out the first rotation which [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/2498884002732546201]happened yesterday[/url]![/list]
✅ [b]A new RANDOM CIVILIZATION option randomizes picks for everyone.[/b]
[list][*] With the option, all picks in a given match will be randomized, not just an individual’s pick.[/list]
✅ [b]Coming soon: the MONGOL EVENT![/b]
Which includes:
[list][*] Three new profile icons!
[*] A solid gold statue!
[*] Visual mod for houses![/list]
✅ [b]New: COMPETITIVE SCENARIO based on the E3 Demo, plus an online leaderboard![/b]

[i]…and more[/i]![/quote]
All of this comes with a new approach to how we deliver content, updates, and fixes to the game. We will highlight more of the process changes coming with (and continuing beyond) the July update, but we wanted to start with some of the important changes coming to [i]Age II: DE[/i] based on the community’s feedback.

As always, the forums and Discord are your safe space to discuss these new changes—as well as the features and ideas you’d be excited to see in the future!

[quote][h3]👉 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/0/]Visit the Steam Forums[/url]
👉 [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]Visit the official Discord server[/url][/h3][/quote]
This is only the beginning; thanks for coming along on this journey with us!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 37650
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=EE3msNcJD14;full][/previewyoutube]
Good day, fellow tacticians!

May marks the six-month milestone since the arrival of [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] this past November, and we’re just as excited today as we were on day one—even as we now work, play, and enjoy the game from the safety of our homes. We hope you’re staying healthy, safe, and taking the time to play and escape from the world when it’s needed the most!

Today’s update introduces new changes, content, and improvements to keep up with our growing community: including a new [b]in-game event[/b] to test your skills as well as major improvements to the [b]stability[/b] and [b]playability[/b] of the game. Here's the tl;dr list of the highlights:
[list][*] Fixed the infamous [b]“5 Minute Disconnect!”[/b]
[*] The [b]Malay[/b] now prioritize speed over stamina when Aging Up!
[*] Implemented various [b]balance changes[/b] and [b]fixes[/b] for civilizations, units, and maps!
[*] Improved the [b]AI[/b] to put up a better fight (or be a better partner) on the battlefield!
[*] Added several [b]localization fixes[/b] for several languages!
[*] Introducing the [b]May-hem Event[/b]: celebrating the quirkiness of [i]Age of Empires II[/i]![/list]
As always, the full list of changes can be found below while the conversation happens over on our community channels!

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/eventcomments/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Update 37650 Discussion[/url][/quote]
Be safe, everyone, and we hope you enjoy the latest changes to [i]Age of Empires II![/i]

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1][b]▬▬▬ UPDATE 37650 ▬▬▬[/b][/h1]

[h1]◆ [b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b] ◆[/h1]While there is plenty of notable fixes and features to which to look forward in today’s build, here are some of the big highlights coming with the May update:

[h3][b]The May-hem Event![/b][/h3][previewyoutube=qykw2Q_IVY8;full][/previewyoutube]
It's that time again! With the May update comes a brand-new festival for you to enjoy—[b]THE "MAY-HEM" EVENT[/b]—when we're celebrating the love of the game by spotlighting the community's unique approaches, discoveries, and favorite moments in [i]Age of Empires[/i] over the last 20+ years.

Here’s what we’ve pulled together for you to enjoy during the event:
[list][*] Three new [b]Profile Icons![/b]
[*] Three [b]event-exclusive visual mods![/b]
[*] Train your [b]sheep[/b] to be even better scouts!
[*] Discover unique, Age-themed Easter Eggs hidden in the game!
[*] Unlock the new [b]Mayhem Menu Background[/b] for the duration of the event.[/list]
Starting [b]TODAY[/b] through [b]JUNE 9[/b], check back daily to unlock new challenges and new event content:

[quote]🎯 [b]Sign into Xbox Live.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Mayhem La Hire[/b] profile icon.

🎯 [b]Play the ‘Early Economy’ Art of War mission and obtain a Silver or Gold medal.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Town Center Trophies Decoration[/b] mod.

🎯 [b]Train at least three monks.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Mayhem Scout Sheep[/b] profile icon and the [b]Monk Unit Conversion FX[/b] mod.

🎯 [b]Train at least 99 villagers over the course of any number of games.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Calculating Research FX[/b] mod.

🎯 [b]Build at least 20 wall sections over the course of any number of games.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Mayhem Teuton[/b] profile icon.

🎯 [b]Use a sheep to scout an animal.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Sheep Scouting[/b] behavior: your sheep will magically learn the [b]auto-scout[/b] ability in campaign missions and single player matches.[/quote]
There are also four new Easter Eggs to seek out in the game—two of which are permanent additions! Can you find them all?

[quote]🔲 🐘 ???

🔲 👑 ???

🔲 🥌 ??? [i](Event Exclusive)[/i]

🔲 🕚 ??? [i](Event Exclusive)[/i][/quote]
Don’t forget to [b]sign into Xbox Live[/b]; doing so will ensure that you get to keep all the mods and profile icons you unlock during the event! We hope you enjoy this celebration of the community, as well as everything else coming with today’s update!

[h3][b]The "5-Minute Disconnect" Fix[/b][/h3]After months of back-and-forth collaboration with the community, we’ve managed to isolate and implement several fixes for the notorious [b]“5-Minute Disconnect”[/b] issue
[list][*] Fixed an issue which resulted in specific routers disconnecting from the servers 4-5 minutes after starting a match.[/list]
The team worked hard to uncover all of the potential causes of the problem, but could not have reached this conclusion without the help of those affected. [b]We appreciate the time and energy spent by everyone who participated in the conversation, shared their experience with the issue, or who simply kept us updated about its impact on the community![/b]

[quote]Please note that local ISP and hardware issues can still result in disconnects from the game—we have, unfortunately, not solved “the internet” ([i]at least, not yet[/i]). Please continue to report new issues that impact your ability to play: making sure to include your network information, logs, and any other relevant details. We will continue to monitor for these reports and work to improve things on our end.[/quote]
[h1]◆ [b]GAME STABILITY[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] The game will no longer crash when using the “marco,” “polo,” or “i r winner” cheat codes when playing a custom campaign.
[*] Implemented fixes to address a variety of crashes.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]GAMEPLAY[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed an issue where players could research technologies instantaneously, at no cost, and/or more than once.
[*] The [b]Malay[/b] now properly advance through the Ages [b]66% faster[/b] than other civs instead of with 166% more style.
[*] Doubled the maximum [b]scrolling speed[/b] threshold for players who want to see more of the map in less time.
[*] [b]Siege Workshops[/b] constructed next to walls can no longer be used to spawn units on the opposite side of said walls in certain circumstances.
[*] Khmer [b]Villagers[/b] will now continue constructing houses after garrisoning and being sent back to work.
[*] Fixed a visual issue where the rubble of destroyed buildings could be seen through the Fog of War.
[*] Fixed an issue where attacking the sides (aka the “gatehouse towers” or “barbicans”) of a gate would not trigger the attack notification sound.
[*] Fixed a rare issue which allowed units to be queued and trained at the wrong building.
[*] Dolphins will no longer remain on the map once they’ve been depleted. ([i]“So long, and thanks for the food!”[/i])[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] The [b]Homeless[/b] achievement can now only be unlocked when a player wins a game after deleting their starting Town Center. This addresses an issue where it could be earned without fulfilling the requirements.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] The [b]Supplies[/b] technology is no longer available to the [b]Chinese, Cumans, Huns, Khmer, Lithuanians, Mayans, Mongols[/b], and [b]Tatars[/b].
[*] [b]Watch Towers[/b] can no longer be built in the [b]Dark Age[/b] if one is automatically generated at the start of the match (e.g. on the Fortress map).
[*] [b]Hussar:[/b] Reduced the length of the attack animation from [b]1.89[/b] to [b]1.35 seconds[/b] (equivalent to Light Cavalry). This [i]does not[/i] increase their DPS, but improves their ability to chase and harass targets.[/list]
[h3][b]Aztecs[/b][/h3][list][*] The civilization bonus which decreases the training time of military units now does so by [b]10%[/b] (was 15%).[/list]
[h3][b]Burmese[/b][/h3][list][*] The bonuses granted by the [b]Manipur Cavalry[/b] upgrade are no longer partially-blocked by the [b]Masonry[/b] tech.[/list]
[h3][b]Indians[/b][/h3][list][*] The team bonus to damage dealt by Camels to structures is no longer blocked by the [b]Masonry[/b] or [b]Architecture[/b] upgrades, and now applies to all buildings, as intended.[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Elephant Archer [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reduced the reload time of attacks from [b]2.5[/b] to [b]2.0 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Elephant Archer [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reduced the cost to train from [b]80[/b] to [b]70 gold[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Mayans[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]El Dorado:[/b] Increased the time to research the upgrade from [b]50[/b] to [b]70 seconds[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Saracens[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Zealotry:[/b] Reduced the cost to research the upgrade from [b]800[/b] to [b]700 gold[/b].[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]CAMPAIGNS[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] [b]Objective timers[/b] are now displayed properly after re-loading a saved game.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]RANDOM MAPS[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] The way starting [b]gold[/b] and [b]stone[/b] nodes are generated has been revised to prevent situations where they fail to spawn entirely.
[*] Updated how [b]straggler trees[/b] are generated so they don’t straggle right next to forests.
[*] Updated how [b]predator animals[/b] are generated on several maps.[/list]
[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Continental:[/b] Extra [b]gold[/b] and [b]stone[/b] nodes have been adjusted to spawn per player in 1v1 maps.
[*] [b]Hill Fort:[/b] Adjusted the generation of starting [b]gold[/b] and [b]stone[/b] to prevent them from appearing right next to a player’s Town Center.
[*] [b]Islands:[/b] The way [b]gold[/b] and [b]stone[/b] nodes are generated has been revised to prevent situations where they fail to spawn completely.
[*] [b]Islands:[/b] Acacia trees have been replaced by [b]Dragon[/b] and [b]Palm[/b] trees.
[*] [b]Islands:[/b] The fifth relic spawned in a 1v1 match now appears on one of the small islands in the middle of the map.
[*] [b]Nomad:[/b] The logic when generating shore fish has been updated to distribute the nodes more evenly.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Increased the starting food for each player by spawning four additional goats and two shore fish per person.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Slightly increased the number of forested and mountain slope areas generated on the map.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Distributed the extra gold nodes more evenly among players.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Starting fish will now appear further from where berries have sprouted in the map.
[*] [b]Ravines:[/b] The starting food on the map has been updated to include: [b]10 Ibexes, 10 Geese[/b], and [b]6 Berry Bushes[/b].
[*] [b]Scandinavia:[/b] Adjusted the natural balance of predators on the map. Bears and wolves now claim their own territories and have organized in more consistently-sized groups.[/list]
[h3][b]Random Map Scripting[/b][/h3][list][*] The [b]number_of_tiles[/b] and [b]land_percent[/b] commands no longer create larger lands than intended. (This affected a few standard maps, such as Arena.)[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Removed the grace period where players could resign from a ranked match without losing ELO points.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented players from joining another multiplayer lobby after playing a custom scenario in the same session.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented player chat from appearing when playing a custom multiplayer scenario.[/list]
[h3][b]Ranked Map Rotation[/b][/h3][previewyoutube=sh4Z1G2NWZU;full][/previewyoutube]
[code]Maps unique to each map pool are in [b]bold[/b].[/code]
The [b]1v1[/b] map pool is as follows:

The [b]Team[/b] map pool is as follows:

[*] At higher difficulty levels, AI-controlled military will now retreat outside of the range of enemy fortifications when appropriate.
[*] Implemented several improvements to the AI’s strategic decision-making in an effort to make it more efficient.
[*] Improved the ability of the AI to adapt to unorthodox map layouts.
[*] Improved the way AI players communicate with teammates: including how they respond to taunts and the messages they send in chat.[/list]
In addition to the above changes, we’ve made several adjustments to the computer logic when set to the [b]Extreme[/b] difficulty:
[list][*] Fixed several instances where an AI-controlled player would surrender despite still having strong allies.

[quote][h1]◆ [b]ONGOING INVESTIGATION[/b] ◆[/h1]As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief overview of some of the issues that have been raised for which we are actively working on solutions:

notes.title: World's Edge partners with Capture Age to bring it to Age II: DE
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=t5A3w6LCO08;full][/previewyoutube]
We are proud to officially announce the partnership between [i]World’s Edge[/i] and [i]Capture Age[/i]. 

[i]Capture Age[/i] is a ground-breaking spectating tool that completely changed how you can watch, enjoy and analyse [i]Age of Empires: II[/i]. Today we can confirm that [i]Capture Age[/i] will be coming to [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i].

Over the last three years, the [i]Capture Age[/i] team has been developing a new way to watch [i]Age of Empires[/i]. As fans of the [i]Age of Empires[/i] franchise, their knowledge and understanding of the game has forged a tool designed to display real-time information that engages viewers without detracting from gameplay.

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/1.jpg[/img]

The [i]Capture Age[/i] tool has been utilized during tournaments such as [i]Hidden Cup 2[/i] and the [i]Escape Champions League[/i] to deliver a new and unique spectating experience that changed the way we watch and understand [i]Age of Empires[/i].

Sadly, the tool was incompatible with [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] upon release. Now with the partnership between [i]World's Edge[/i] and the [i]Capture Age[/i] team, the tool is being redesigned from the ground up to complement and expand the viewer experience.

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/ca-de-overlay-wide.png[/img]

Recently, the [i]Capture Age[/i] team were responsible for the amazing overlay used during the [i]Red Bull Wololo[/i] and [i]Hidden Cup 3[/i]. The overlay tracked multiple players' resources, population and completed research in real-time, without having to swap between views or access menu systems.

As development progresses, [i]Capture Age[/i] will be a stand alone tool providing a huge list of extra features to get excited for!

[h3]✔ In-Depth, Real-time Statistics[/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/statistics-wide.png[/img]

[h3]✔ Enhanced Minimap with High Contrast Colors[/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/minimap-wide.png[/img]

[h3]✔ World Overlay with Monk Conversion Time Indicators[/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/world-overlay-wide.png[/img]

[h3]✔ Per Unit Statistics and Individual Unit Kills[/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/unit-kill-stats-wide.png[/img]

[h3]✔ Tournament Integration with Direct Scoreboard Integration[/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/unknown-1.png[/img]

[h3]✔ Event Panel with Tribute Amounts, Market Usages, Notable Events[/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/community-features-wide.png[/img]

[i]Capture Age[/i] will bring a whole new viewing experience to [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] and we are proud to be a part of it.

notes.title: On Now: The Greatest Medieval Technologies Event!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=E8oGGQQA_DQ;full][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Greatest_Medieval_Tech_Thumbnail_2.jpg[/img][/previewyoutube]
Come one, come all! The [b]Greatest Medieval Technologies Event[/b] is here to spotlight some of the most intimidating inventions in human history! From the evolution of siege technology to the advent of the crossbow, gunpowder, and the defensive gear used to protect against these new technologies, we’re taking a closer look at the instruments of war that helped define (and redefine) the battlefields of their time.

This month, you can play and complete challenges in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] to permanently unlock new icons, never before seen cheat codes, and cosmetics celebrating the greatest medieval technologies!

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/MedivalTech_Units_GIF_Small.gif[/img]

[b]Today through May 13,[/b] complete the in-game tasks within the time limit, and you can score a trebuchet-package of rewards, including:
[list] 	[*]Three new [b]Profile Icons![/b]
[*]Two new [b]Cheat Codes![/b]
[*]Three [b]exclusive visual mods![/b]
[*]New [b]Medieval Menu Background[/b] during the event![/list]
Here's the full list of game tasks and rewards for the [b]Greatest Medieval Technologies Event[/b]:

[quote]✅ [b]SIGN INTO XBOX LIVE[/b]
Unlocks the [b]Crossbow[/b] profile icon

[b]✅ TRAIN THREE ARBALESTERS IN A SINGLE GAME[/b]
Enable Event-Limited Cheat Code [b]“Going Above and Beyond”[/b] where all research can be repeated and stacked up to 256x

[b]✅ RESEARCH THE CHAIN MAIL TECHNOLOGY[/b]

Unlocks [b]Gold skin for Bombard Cannon[/b] mod

[b]✅ TRAIN THREE BOMBARD CANNONS IN A SINGLE GAME[/b]
Unlocks the [b]Hand Cannon[/b] profile icon and [b]Tracer FX for Gunpowder Units[/b] mod (affects hand cannoneer, janissary, and conquistador)

[b]✅ DESTROY AN ENEMY CASTLE WITH A TREBUCHET[/b]
nable Event-Limited Cheat Code: [b]"Tech Tech One Two Free"[/b]where all research costs are removed[/quote]
On top of that, if you [b]sign in to Xbox Live[/b] during the Event, you’ll get to keep all of the [b]cheat codes, mods[/b], and [b]profile icons[/b] you’ve unlocked!

Good luck sieging the castle!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team
